name: Priateľský nočný beh mestom Vranov
location: Základná škola Sídlisko II., Vranov nad Topľou, Prešov, Slovakia
description: The friendly night run through the city of Vranov is a traditional running event in Vranov nad Topľou that offers a nocturnal running experience through the city. The race takes place at the premises of the Sídlisko II Elementary School and is open to men, women, and children. The main category starts at 19:30, and the children's run begins at 17:00. The organizers are OZ S rukou v ruke, Sídlisko II Elementary School, the town of Vranov nad Topľou, and OZ Vranovské Vydry, who warmly invite all runners to enjoy a friendly atmosphere and a sporting experience.
course_highlights: Nočný beh mestom Vranov
Štart a cieľ pri Základnej škole Sídlisko II.
Kategórie pre mužov, ženy a deti
additional: Detský beh štartuje o 17:00 hod. Štartovné na mieste je 20 €. Nočná trať, registrácia online a na mieste, detský beh, štafetové behy

name: Mozdulj Csepel!
location: Kolonics György Szabadidőközpont, Hollandi út 8-10, Budapest, Hungary
description: Mozdulj, Csepel! is a free family running race organized by the Municipality of Csepel as part of the Active Csepel series. The race starts at the beautiful Csepel Danube bank, from the György Kolonics Leisure Center, and offers four distances for movement: 3.5 km, 7 km, 400 m children's run, and a special race for people with disabilities. The goal of the race is to share the community experience and the joy of movement for all ages, with an environmentally conscious approach and cup-free refreshments. Wearing a bib number is mandatory for the 3.5 km and 7 km distances, and chip timing ensures accurate results.
course_highlights: The race route runs along Kolonics promenade, on the Danube bank
Chip timing and absolute male and female podiums for the 3.5 km and 7 km distances
The children's run route passes under the two-arched bridge, with parental supervision allowed
additional: The event is cup-free, so participants are advised to use their own softcup, bottle, or cup. Medals are awarded to the youngest participants, while older runners receive a gym bag, an apple, and muesli at the finish line. Starting with a stroller is only permitted at your own risk. The special race for people with disabilities is a joyful run where walking and strolling are also allowed. Multiple distances require registration, environmentally friendly chip timing, awards, family and special categories, route along the Danube, outdoor event, rain or sunshine.

The race starts from the Dome Square and takes place on city streets that are closed to traffic and have a solid surface. Participants can choose from several distances, from children's races to a half marathon, dedicating a day to movement, community, and care. The registration fees fund developments and experiences for the supported youth.
course_highlights: City streets closed to traffic with a solid surface route
Start and finish at the Dome Square, an iconic Szeged location
Secured course with police and volunteers
additional: The race offers distances for various age groups and fitness levels, including children's races and adult distances. A parental consent form is mandatory for children. Bicycle escorts and multiple checkpoints ensure the safety of participants. After the race, special bathing offers await participants, and the official ice cream flavor will be mango-passion fruit. Race participants support the ÁGOTA® Foundation. The event features multiple distances and categories, with the course starting from the Dome Square and running through the city environment. Participation is possible through online registration.

description: The ÁGOTA® Run is a charity race in Szeged that supports young people living in child protection services. The race starts from the Dóm Square and takes place on city streets that are closed to traffic, with a solid surface. Participants can choose from several distances, from children's races to a half marathon, either individually or in teams. The event is not only a sports competition but also a community gathering that helps disadvantaged youth with increasing support year after year.
course_highlights: City streets closed to traffic, flat, paved route
Start and finish at Szeged Cathedral Square
Bicycle escort and police security at intersections
additional: The race offers options for various age groups and distances, including children's races (100 m, 400 m, 800 m), adult distances (3 km, 6 km, 12 km, 21 km), and a 4x3 km relay race. Bicycle escort and police security ensure safety during the event. Registration is available online, with limited on-site registration. Participants under 18 must have parental consent. After the race, special bath offers and gifts await participants. The participation supports child protection youth, with online registration available, multiple running options, and categories.

name: Beh Galantou – Beh oslobodenia
price_range: 15 € online, 12 € s GALAkartou; štafeta 40 € online, 32 € s GALAkartou; Samsung Run 10 €, 8 € s GALAkartou
description: Galantou Run - Liberation Run is a jubilee 40th edition of a traditional running event in Galanta, offering various disciplines for all age categories. The event is intended not only for athletes but also for everyone who wants to experience an atmosphere full of emotions, joy of movement, and self-overcoming. Each participant will receive a commemorative medal, hydration, and refreshments; children will additionally get a ticket to Water World Galandia and a package from COOP Jednota Galanta. The best runners will receive monetary rewards and valuable prizes, including televisions in special categories. After the run, a cultural program will be held at the City Cultural Center in Galanta.
course_highlights: Courses for beginners and advanced runners
Commemorative medal for every participant including children
More than 40 valuable prizes in the final raffle
additional: Registration opens on the day of the event at 8:00 AM and closes 20 minutes before the start of each category. Children will receive a ticket to Water World Galandia and a package from COOP Jednota Galanta. The top runners will receive valuable polished glass instead of trophies. Winners of special categories must hold a GalaKARTA. After the run, a cultural program will be held at the City Cultural Center. The event includes various disciplines, rewards, refreshments, and cultural activities. Registration is online, and street closures are expected during the races.

name: Ultramaratón Košice – Miskolc
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: The Košice - Miskolc Ultramarathon is a challenging international ultramarathon race taking place on April 18, 2026. The route runs from the center of Košice to Miskolc, offering runners a challenge with long and diverse terrain. The event is part of a series of running events organized by the Košice Marathon Club and is intended for endurance runners seeking a unique experience at the edge of their capabilities. The start is on Main Street in Košice, which adds a historic atmosphere to the race and support from local spectators.
course_highlights: The route runs from Košice to Miskolc through various terrains
Start and finish in the historic center of Košice on Main Street
International character of the race with crossing borders
additional: The race starts on Main Street in Košice between the DoubleTree by Hilton hotel and the Dargov department store. The event is part of the Košice Marathon series and organized by the Košice Marathon Club. Specific information about start waves, capacities, or fees is not provided. The race begins at 6:00 and 7:00, with registration deadlines and fees set. The race takes place on Main Street and Dolná brána in Košice, intended for runners aged 16 and older. Categories include individual, pairs, and relay teams.

name: Ultramaratón Miškolc - Košice
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: Ultramarathon Košice - Miskolc is a prestigious running event taking place on April 18, 2026. Participants run from Košice to Miskolc, covering a challenging ultramarathon route. The event is part of a rich running calendar in the region and offers a unique experience for endurance runners. The organizer is the Košice Marathon Club, which ensures professional preparation and organization.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon route from Košice to Miskolc
Challenging terrain requiring endurance and fitness
Crossing two countries - Slovakia and Hungary
additional: The event is part of a series of running events in Košice, including the International Peace Marathon and other accompanying activities. Organizers offer opportunities to participate as a volunteer, driver, or pacer. Runners have access to comprehensive organizational support and benefits associated with the entry fee. The route passes through cycle paths and has low traffic, with categories for individuals, two-person, five-person, and ten-person relays; start times are at 6:00 and 7:00.

name: BoleRuN
location: areál TJ Slavoj Boleráz, Boleráz, Slovakia
description: BoleRuN is a running event held at the TJ Slavoj Boleráz premises, offering courses for various age groups including children, youth, and adults. Participants can compete on distances from 50 meters up to 10 km, with the children's race starting at 1:00 PM and the adults' race at 2:00 PM. The organizer is the municipality of Boleráz in cooperation with the initiative Boleráz - Hýb sa. The event is suitable for all runners aged 9 and above who want to enjoy a sports day in a pleasant environment.
course_highlights: Adult course 10 km and 5 km
Youth course for ages 10 to 14 - 2 km
Children's course up to 9 years old from 50 meters to 1 km
additional: Children's race starts at 1:00 PM, adults' race starts at 2:00 PM. Categories are divided by age and distance. The organizer is the municipality of Boleráz and the initiative Boleráz - Hýb sa. Registration is likely closed as of April 2024; the event includes categories for children and adults, with electronic timing and a participant medal.

name: Šarišská míľa
description: The Šariš Mile is a running event organized by BK ZasRun in Šarišské Bohdanovce at the football field. The race is intended for various age categories including children, youth, adults, and Nordic Walking. The start is divided into a children's mile, running, and Nordic Walking for women and men, with participation in the race free of charge and an option for a voluntary contribution during registration. The event offers a pleasant atmosphere for runners of all levels and age groups.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the football field in Šarišské Bohdanovce
Categories for children, youth, adults, and Nordic Walking
Start divided into a children's mile, running, and Nordic Walking for women and men
additional: Participation in the race is free of charge, with an option for a voluntary contribution during registration. The children's mile starts at 16:00, women’s running and Nordic Walking at 16:20, men’s running and Nordic Walking at 16:45. Categories are divided by age and gender, including overall standings for Nordic Walking. The race begins at 16:00, is open to the general public, and suitable for all age groups.

name: Chlieb náš….
description: Our Bread is a craft bakery in Hronský Beňadik that produces sourdough bread using traditional methods from quality ingredients. It is committed to honest baking work, which is reflected in a crispy crust, lively sourdough, and soft interior of the bread. The bakery offers an authentic experience where you can choose fresh bread directly from the oven. In addition to the quality of the bread, the bakery is also known for its unique Baroque ceiling, which is one of the most original in Trnava.
course_highlights: Traditional baking of sourdough bread from quality ingredients
Crispy crust and soft interior of the bread
Unique Baroque ceiling in the bakery
additional: The bakery is open Tuesday to Friday from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM and Saturday from 7:00 AM to 11:30 AM, or until supplies last. The operation emphasizes honest craftsmanship and the family character of Trnka Gastronomy. The event is associated with traditional bread baking, organized at Dumas bakery in Hronský Beňadik, suitable for all interested in baking crafts.

name: Beh oslobodenia Turčianska Štiavnička
description: The Turčianska Štiavnička Liberation Run is a traditional race with a rich history, held to commemorate the anniversary of the village's liberation by the Soviet Army. This 32nd edition will take place on April 18, 2026, at the football pitch in Turčianska Štiavnička. The course, approximately 10 km long, mainly traverses mountain terrain and offers runners a challenging yet beautiful experience. Participants are divided into age categories, including children's categories and the best Štiavničans. Organizers welcome all runners and look forward to their participation.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs through mountain terrain with forest paths and a local park
Distance approximately 10 km, known as the 'Štiavnická ten' or 'Štiavnická ten'
Start and finish at the cultural house and football pitch in the village
additional: Online registration is open from April 1, 2026, to April 16, 2026. The race is divided into men's age categories, women's, and children's categories. Starting numbers are traditionally sewn and printed according to the original pattern from Ružomberok and are still used today. Before the race, a ceremonial laying of a wreath at the fallen heroes' memorial takes place. The races start at 10:00 and 13:15, with registration possible from April 1 to April 16, 2026. The event has historical significance and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: Banská Bystrica - Bežíme spolu v Banskej Bystrici
location: Park pod pamätníkom SNP, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
description: Running Together in Banská Bystrica is a running event held in the park under the SNP Memorial in Banská Bystrica. It offers four courses of different lengths, including a children's run, suitable for the general public including children up to 6 years old. The course is flat with no elevation gain, allowing for an enjoyable run for all age groups. The event supports people with disabilities, with 2 € from each registration fee going towards motivating them to stay active.
course_highlights: Flat courses with no elevation gain
Four courses: 10 km, 5 km, 3 km, and a children's run of 500 m
Start and finish in the park under the SNP Memorial in Banská Bystrica
additional: Support: 2 € from each paid entry fee will go towards supporting people with disabilities. The children's run is intended for children up to 6 years old (born 2020 - 2026) and requires the presence of a legal guardian. The registration fee is valid from April 7, 2026. The course is flat, ensuring an easy race experience. The course is flat, registration is online, the event supports people with health disabilities, and includes information about data usage consent.

name: Polus Tower Run
location: Polus Tower 2, Bratislava-Nové Mesto, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Polus Tower Run is a unique stair running event taking place on April 18, 2026, at the Polus Tower 2 office building in Bratislava. Participants climb the height difference on their own on two courses - a children's course with 4 floors and 116 steps, and an adult main course with 19 floors and 416 steps. Starts are individual at 30-second intervals, and times are measured electronically. The event is organized by the KOTRMELEC Sports Foundation and is conducted according to the current TWA rules.
course_highlights: Adults: 19 floors / 416 steps, length 400 m, elevation +80 m
PHZ (police, firefighters, rescuers): 416 steps / 19 floors, length 400 m, elevation +80 m
Children: 4 floors / 116 steps, length 200 m, elevation +21 m
additional: The children's start is at 11:00, the adults at 11:30. Race results are announced at 13:00. The course surface is 100% paving. Starts are individual at 30-second intervals with electronic timing. Awards are based on age categories for men and women. Stair race, multiple categories, online registration, limited to 300 participants, race for children and adults, various age groups and medals.

name: Fuss a struccal 4 / 7 / 14 / 21
description: The Fuss charity running festival with a ostrich will be held in Győr at Aranypart in 2026 for the third time. Participants can choose from several distances, open to all ages from the youngest to the oldest. The goal of the running festival is to support child care, especially the procurement of a special EEG device for the diagnosis of children with epilepsy and severe conditions. Well-known athletes and public figures will also participate in the event, creating a friendly, community atmosphere. The proceeds from the registration fees will support the Child Intensive Care Foundation.
course_highlights: The run takes place on the scenic hillside of Aranypart
Distances: 4, 7, 14, and 21 kilometers
Family-friendly event where four-legged pets can also participate
additional: Proceeds from the registration fees will be used to purchase a special EEG device for diagnosing children with epilepsy and severe conditions. Well-known athletes, artists, police officers, and volunteer firefighters in operational gear will participate, running in uniform. Families and pets will be among the runners, and spectators will cheer from the Aranypart hillside. The festival attracted over 600 participants, with registration fees supporting epilepsy diagnosis for children, and the event is organized as a charity for children's recovery.

description: The Vértes Terrain Marathon is a challenging trail running race through the scenic paths and forestry roads of the Vértes Mountains. The race offers multiple distances for runners, from ultramarathon to mini-marathon, each with varied elevation gains and well-marked routes. The event features refreshment stations, personalized bib numbers, timing, and a rich finish line celebration, allowing participants to enjoy the proximity to nature and the sporting experience. The race has a friendly atmosphere, and organizers pay special attention to the comfort and safety of runners.
course_highlights: Runs on paths and forestry roads of the Vértes Mountains
Ultramarathon 50 km with 1410 m elevation gain
Multiple refreshment stations, including Squeezy gels on ultramarathon and marathon distances
additional: Personalized bib number and timing (Traxpace). Hungarian-made metal finisher medals painted by people with disabilities. Feminine hygiene products available at stations and the center. Massage services for marathon and ultramarathon runners. Two types of finish line beer (non-alcoholic). No cups provided, participants must bring their own. Mandatory equipment: mobile phone, ID, at least 0.5 liters of fluids. Race packet pickup times: Ultra and Marathon 08:00-08:45, Half-Marathon and Mini-Marathon 08:45-09:45. Results announcement on race day from 12:30 to 15:00. Trail running in the Vértes Mountains, multiple distances, elevation gains, refreshment stations, registration opens from January 2025, held in Szár.

description: The Clear'97 Alpokalja Business Run is a community-building spring running festival in Szombathely, offering various distances for corporate, friends, and school teams in individual and relay categories. The race starts with a 2.5 km children's run and includes 5 km, 10 km, and 20 km distances, supplemented by relays. The event aims to promote sports and movement culture, featuring a unique finisher medal, electronic timing, and live result tracking. A health day is also part of the event, where mental health professionals and therapeutic demonstrations await participants. Free parking is provided at the Vasi Skanzen parking lot.
course_highlights: 2.5 km loops with relay zones, relay change every 2.5 km
Relay categories: women, mixed, general, and school relays
Electronic timing and continuously updated live results
additional: Free parking at the Vasi Skanzen parking lot. Unique finisher medals for the first 200 registrants, with options for previous medals. Electronic timing with the KORIM endurance timing system. Professionally taken, free downloadable race photos. Sponsorship gifts for category, relay, and overall winners. Bag storage at the race center. Selected health day programs with mental health professionals and therapeutic demonstrations. Relay teams require a minimum of 2 members, with change every 2.5 km, including separate categories for women, mixed, and school relays. The first school relay team registration fee is waived if registered by April 10. The race takes place in Szombathely, around Erkel Street 39. The event includes awards, live results, photos, and participation in various categories, including school teams.

name: XXIII. Motherson Szigetköz Félmaraton 2 / 5 / 10 / 21
location: UFM Aréna, Mosonmagyaróvár, Győr-Moson-Sopron County, Hungary
description: The 23rd Motherson Szigetköz Half Marathon is a traditional running race in Mosonmagyaróvár, promoting recreational sports. The race is part of the Olympic Five-Contest and offers point-scoring opportunities at distances of 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and the half marathon (21.1 km). The start and finish are at the UFM Arena, which provides changing, showering, and cloakroom facilities. Chip timing is provided for the race, and there is a time limit for the longest distance. Participants' bibs can include their name or nickname if they register by April 10.
course_highlights: Chip timing for individual races at 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
Time limit for the half marathon: 2 hours 30 minutes
Name or nickname printed on bibs if registered by April 10
additional: Bibs must be worn on the front at chest height; triathlon bib clips are permitted. The chip is located on the back of the bib and must not be removed or folded. The race timing is managed by Agni-Timing. There is a time limit for the longest distance; the 21.1 km must be completed within 2 hours 30 minutes, otherwise disqualification. The small bridge in front of the UFM Arena will be closed from 8:30 to 12:00 on race day. Registration is online and will be accepted only until April 11; the race is open to everyone, from beginners to professional runners.

name: Národný beh Devín - Bratislava (5.kolo BP SAZ)
description: TIPOS National Run Devín - Bratislava is the oldest sports event in Slovakia with over 100 years of tradition, taking place for the 78th time. Runners will complete an iconic route from the historic Devín Castle to the center of Bratislava, offering a unique atmosphere and a connection between history and sport. The event is suitable for hobby athletes as well as more demanding runners and attracts thousands of participants of various ages each year. The organizer is STaRZ of the city of Bratislava, which provides complete organizational information and registration.
course_highlights: The route goes from Devín Castle to the center of Bratislava
Road race with over 5,000 participants
Historical and iconic running tradition since 1921
additional: Online registration is possible until April 15, 2026, at 20:00. Group registration is available via email hromadne_prihlasky@starz.sk with billing details. A limited edition T-shirt is available for 13 EUR. The start list is available online. The event is organized by STaRZ of the city of Bratislava. The event includes various routes in Devín, registration is available online, and it is part of the Slovak Athletic Federation's running series. Participants can also watch results and statistics on the official websites.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 4. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is a regular running race over a distance of 2 miles (3.218 km), held at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. Organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, it is open to the general public, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on-site on race day from 9:30 AM, with the start at 10:00 AM. The competition is part of a series where runners earn points towards a traveling trophy based on categories and performances.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.218 km) at the Kuchajda swimming complex
Registration and check-in at the volleyball court
Categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans
additional: Registration is on-site on race day from 9:30 AM. In case of a tie in points, the better time after applying a coefficient and then shoe size determines the ranking. Participants can earn an extra point for improving their best time of the year. At the end of the year, the two worst months are discarded from the overall results (amnesty). The race takes place on a public road in the Kuchajda area, Bratislava; categories include children, juniors, women, men, and veterans; on-site registration is also available.

name: Beh 2 míle
description: The 2-mile run in Bratislava at Kuchajda is a regular running race over a distance of 2 miles (3.218 km), organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. Registration and check-in take place directly on-site near the volleyball court from 9:30 AM, with the start at 10:00 AM. The race is open to various age categories including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. The competition is part of the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team's traveling cup, where finishing times are adjusted according to age coefficients and runners are scored based on participation and performance.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.218 km) at Kuchajda swimming area
Registration and start near the volleyball court
Categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans
additional: Registration takes place on-site from 9:30 AM at the volleyball court. The competition for the Traveling Cup of the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team awards points based on participation and performance, with an option to exempt the two worst participations of the year. In case of a tie in points, age and the best time of the year determine the winner. The race is held at Kuchajda swimming area, Bratislava, with registration from 9:30 AM and start at 10:00 AM. The competition for the Traveling Cup of the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team involves scoring based on points and times, with categories for various age groups.

name: Sačurovská pätnástka – 20. Memoriál Heleny Slukovej
organizer: Obec Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, ZŠ Sačurov, MŠ Sačurov
description: Sačurovská pätnástka - 20. Memoriál Heleny Slukovej is a traditional running race held in the village of Sačurov in the Vranov nad Topľou district. The race starts in front of the elementary school building in Sačurov and offers categories for various age groups including children, youth, and adults. The main category starts at 13:00, children at 12:00. The organizers are the village of Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, ZŠ and MŠ Sačurov. The race is suitable for local runners and beginner athletes.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the village of Sačurov in front of the elementary school
Categories from preschool age to seniors over 70 years old
Evaluation of the best runners for the Vranov district
additional: Start fee is paid exclusively online. Men over 70 years and women over 60 years do not pay a start fee. Children's race starts at 12:00, main categories at 13:00. The evaluation of the best runners for the Vranov district is part of the event. The race is part of a community support event, with online registration available and various categories for all age groups.

name: Kajňanská desiatka – Memoriál Jána Osloviča
location: Obec Slovenská Kajňa, Slovenská Kajňa, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Slovenská Kajňa, MATORE s.r.o. Humenné, Bežecká akadémia Marcela Matanina
description: Kajňa Ten - Ján Oslovič Memorial is a traditional running race held in the village of Slovenská Kajňa. The race offers three disciplines: a long run of 10 km, a short run of 3.66 km, and a short Nordic walking of 3.66 km, all starting simultaneously at 13:00. The competition is divided into several age categories for men and women, allowing broad participation of runners of different ages and abilities. The organizer is the company MATORE s.r.o., which ensures quality organization and timing.
course_highlights: Long run of 10 km in the pleasant environment of Slovenská Kajňa
Short run and Nordic walking of 3.66 km with the same start
Multiple age categories for men and women
additional: Registration on-site is possible from 9:30 on race day. The participant limit for adults is 130. All disciplines start simultaneously at 13:00. The event includes multiple categories and age groups, registration is possible online and on-site, the start is scheduled for 13:00, and there are also children's races and accompanying activities.

The proceeds from the run will be used to support rehabilitation and treatment for a child with disabilities. The event is part of the Hungarian Backyard League and is organized as a age-group championship, where the best female and male runners are awarded in 11 age categories. The race takes place at Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya in Esztergom, and participants who complete up to 160 kilometers also receive recognition.

The start and finish are in Turna nad Bodvou, with a time limit of 12 hours. The race is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League and offers a challenging route with several refreshment and control points. Both the start and finish are at the parking lot next to the Hviezda cinema in Turna nad Bodvou. An electronic timer records arrivals at control points and at the finish. The route is 57 km long, with a 12-hour limit. Registration is open on April 24-25, 2026. There are refreshment stations, mandatory equipment, categories for men and women, and the race is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League.

description: Freedom Run Chtelnica is a traditional running race with an unchanging route, starting at Námestie 1. mája and leading through the picturesque environment of the Little Carpathians. The course combines asphalt sections with forest paths near the water reservoir Priehrada Chtelnica, a monument to the fallen from World War II, and the Chapel of St. Rócha. Runners can enjoy natural scenery and challenges such as the legendary "staircase" in the forest section. The event is suitable for runners seeking a combination of asphalt and natural terrain in a peaceful mountain environment.

Online registration closes on 24.04.2025 at 23:59; after this date, on-site registration on race day is possible if the participant limit has not been reached. Runners participate at their own risk and must have health insurance. The course is marked with white markings on asphalt and white ribbons in the forest. It is recommended not to use trail shoes due to asphalt sections. Registration is available online or on-site. The event is part of the celebrations of Chtelnica's liberation and is included in the 41st edition of the event.

The race starts from a new location in Bozsok and offers challenges at various distances, from a 7 km introductory trail run to the 102 km Alpokalja Ultra. The courses traverse varied terrain, with beautiful panoramas and refreshment points, requiring endurance and good physical conditioning from participants. The event also features family-friendly programs, allowing even the youngest to enjoy nature conservation and interactive exhibitions.
course_highlights: New starting point in Bozsok for the development of the race
23 km distance with 780 meters of elevation, with a panoramic view from the top of Írottkő
102 km Alpokalja Ultra, through the most scenic spots of the Kőszeg Mountains
additional: The race starts from a new location in Bozsok, with multiple refreshment and water points along the course. The 23 km distance includes 780 meters of elevation gain, offering panoramic views from the summit of Írottkő. The 102 km course can be completed in teams, providing a unique experience of crossing the finish line together. Interactive exhibitions and nature conservation programs await the youngest participants. The race is semi-self-sufficient, requiring mandatory equipment such as a mobile phone, water container, windproof or rain jacket, headlamp, and spare batteries. The event showcases the natural beauty of the Kőszeg Mountains, with varied terrain, starting from Bozsok, and provides opportunities for different age groups and skill levels to participate.

All runners are welcome to participate in a friendly, community-oriented running event.
course_highlights: Nature-close, diverse terrain around Bér, Virágospuszta
Challenging hilly sections and forest trails
Scenic landscape and fresh air for runners
additional: The race offers different distances for participation, and the event is aimed at nature enthusiasts and sports lovers. Detailed information can be found on the website.

The atmosphere is complemented by a musical performance and a family run for children up to 6 years old, making the event suitable for all age groups.

description: The Šamorín Running League is a series of running races organized by the 3klub Šamorín in the beautiful environment of the Pomlé forest park. The league is open to the general public without age or performance limits, with men, women, and children competing in various categories. The registration fee includes timing, race bibs, and refreshments at the finish line. Participants earn points throughout the year, and at the end of the league, the best runners are evaluated based on age coefficient. The league is ideal for those who want to compete regularly and improve their performance in a friendly atmosphere.

Various categories including children's races with shorter distances
Main runs for adults at 3 km, 5 km, and 1.5 km depending on the round

The official league evaluation occurs during the final round. Kindergarten children receive a medal after finishing without evaluation. The course is in the park, with online or on-site registration, and there are no age or performance limits.

description: The Chocholná-Velčice Liberation Run is a traditional sporting event that will be held for the 52nd time on Sunday, April 26, 2026. The organizers are the municipality of Chocholná-Velčice, Jednota Sokol, DHZ Chocholná-Velčice, and SOŠ dopravná Trenčín. The event is suitable for children and is wheelchair accessible, ensuring accessibility for all participants.

Wheelchair accessible event
Event suitable for children

The start location is in front of the fire station in Chocholná-Velčice. The event is part of the village's calendar of activities and is wheelchair accessible, suitable for children, and pets are allowed. The event is scheduled for April 26, 2026, includes various categories for all age groups, and is accompanied by side activities including a historical lecture and a commemorative ceremony.

Picturesque environment of the Prešov Region

Mixed terrain: asphalt and trail running

Runners can complete the courses through beautiful vineyards, on varied terrain with inclines and panoramic views. The event is family-friendly, with children's races for the little ones, and participants are rewarded at the finish with refreshments and a finisher medal. The unique atmosphere of the event is provided by the local wine region and community experience.

21 km half marathon with long inclines, panoramic view of Csókakő Castle, and downhill sections

Children's races are available; finisher medals are not guaranteed for on-site registrations.

The race aims to promote running, strengthen the running community, and support a healthy lifestyle.

The race is part of the Komárom Days event series, and the course crosses several points in the city, including Liberty Square and the vicinity of the North Komárom Sports Hall.

The race serves as a meeting point for the local community and international runners.

The event features a shorter, less hilly circuit and a longer circuit with greater elevation changes, allowing everyone to choose the distance suitable for them. The race is organized by the GYÖTRI Club, one of the region's prominent sports associations.

Trail running, routes between cellars, wine tasting, pre-registration and on-site registration, awards, open cellars, refreshments, and results announcement.

You can compete on two main routes - 12 km and 19 km, with a speed section called Conti Speed Section featuring a valuable prize.

Participants can complete the 21.1-kilometer distance individually or in 2-3 person relay teams, as part of the Budapest Europe Day Festival. The race course consists of three laps along a route passing through iconic Budapest locations, and each finisher receives a unique commemorative medal. Refreshment stations along the course, chip timing
additional: Race bibs, t-shirts, and relay batons can be picked up from May 5-8 between 11:00 and 19:00 at the Europe Experience Center (1052 Budapest, Szervita tér 8.), as well as on May 10 from 7:00 to 8:30 at Liberty Square. The relay zone is located between Nádor Street, Zoltán Street, and Steindl Imre Street. The race features chip timing, and relay batons are handed over by the last team members at the finish line. The race will not have full road closures; police and civil guard will manage traffic. Participants register in advance, and bibs and T-shirts can be collected from May 5-8 at the Europe Experience Center or on race day at Liberty Square. The event celebrates its fifth anniversary, welcoming runners who can choose distances from 300 meters up to 21 km, either individually or in teams. The event aims to create a shared sporting experience in a safe and friendly environment, in the most beautiful parts of Pilisvörösvár.

name: Wings for Life World APP RUN Bratislava
description: Wings for Life World Run Bratislava is a unique event where runners and wheelchair participants start simultaneously and race against a virtual Catcher Car that gradually catches up to them. The race has no finish line; runners run as long as they are not overtaken by the car. The course passes through Sad Janka Kráľa, one of the oldest parks in Europe, and combines various environments. The event supports spinal cord injury research, with 100% of registration fees going to this cause. The race starts precisely at 13:00.
course_highlights: The course passes through Sad Janka Kráľa, one of the oldest parks in Europe
A combination of different environments over a 2 km course
The virtual Catcher Car starts 30 minutes after the start and gradually increases speed
additional: The race is open to both runners and wheelchair participants, who run together. The virtual Catcher Car begins 30 minutes after the start at a speed of 14 km/h and gradually accelerates until it overtakes all competitors. Participation is only possible via the Wings for Life World Run mobile app. 100% of all registration fees are allocated to spinal cord injury research. Registration is online, the run is supported by the Wings for Life World Run app, and all proceeds go to spinal cord injury research.

name: Wings for Life World APP RUN Nižná Myšľa
description: Wings for Life World Run in Nižná Myšľa is a unique event where runners and wheelchair participants compete against a virtual Catcher Car that gradually catches up to them. The course starts from the archeoskanzen Nižná Myšľa, a well-known archaeological site, and passes through forests, unpaved roads, meadows, and the village, combining asphalt and natural surfaces. The race starts on May 10, 2026, at 1:00 PM, and all registration fees go towards spinal cord injury research. Join runners worldwide and challenge yourself in this global race without a finish line.

The loop passes archaeological sites and scenic landscapes of the Košice Basin and Slanské Hills
additional: The virtual Catcher Car departs 30 minutes after the start at a speed of 14 km/h and gradually increases its pace until it overtakes all runners. Nordic walking is welcome. The course includes asphalt, forest roads, and unpaved paths; start at the archeoskanzen, on-site parking, registration via the app.
