description: The Zsámbék Run is a family-friendly race offering three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon (21.2 km). The course runs through the towns of Zsámbék and Tök, on asphalt and gravel roads, with the second half of the half marathon being trail running around the Nyakas Hill. The varied route features beautiful views and multiple refreshment stations. The event aims to allow everyone to find a suitable distance while enjoying the natural beauty of the Zsámbék Basin.
course_highlights: Varied route on asphalt, gravel, and forest trails
5 refreshment stations on the half marathon, 3 on the 10 km
Beautiful views from Nyakas Hill and the Zsámbék Basin
additional: Start times are staggered, but due to a common section at the beginning of the course, faster runners may catch up with slower ones. Chip timing and a personalized finisher medal are provided. The registration fee includes a bib number, medical services, and a finisher gift. The race is limited to 550 participants. Cancellations, transfers, and distance modifications can be made via email within specified deadlines. The course runs entirely on solid surfaces, with short cobblestone and gravel sections. Multiple refreshment points offer water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and biscuits. The race will take place on May 31 at the Piactér in Zsámbék, with the main goal of promoting sports and tourism among participants.

name: KASTÉLYKÖR FLOW
organizer: Laktát Sport Team és Kállai Krisztina
description: The V. Kastélykör Flow is a charming running event in Füzérradvány, around the Károlyi Castle. The race combines the enjoyment of nature and the historic environment of the castle, making it an ideal choice for both hobby and experienced runners. The event is organized by Laktát Sport Team and Krisztina Kállai, who warmly welcome participants on May 31, 2026.
course_highlights: Running in the beautiful park of Károlyi Castle and its surroundings
Natural, varied terrain
Cultural and historical environment
additional: The race takes place at Károlyi Castle, registration is required to participate, and detailed information is available on the Facebook event page.

name: Beh Rajeckým rínkom
description: The Rajecký Rínok Run is a traditional running race organized by the Rajec Marathon Club, held at SNP Square in Rajec. The race offers runners the opportunity to experience the beauty of nature and the surroundings of Rajec during the day in May. The event is suitable for the general public, including children and minors, who must have the consent of a legal guardian. Organizers emphasize safety and quality preparation for participants.
course_highlights: The route runs through the picturesque Rajecký Rínok
Start and finish at SNP Square in Rajec
Natural environment with gentle elevation
additional: Participants under 18 must bring a signed declaration from a legal guardian. Personal data of participants are processed in accordance with applicable personal data protection legislation. The event takes place in Rajec, with registration fees starting from €3 for early registrations. It is suitable for all age groups, including children, and is part of the sports day in the town.

name: Beh na Zniev
description: Zniev Run is a mountain race held in Kláštor pod Znievom, offering a challenging course of 5,650 meters with an elevation gain of 475 meters. The race is open to a wide range of categories from children to veterans, including men, women, juniors, and youth. The main race starts at 14:00 in the area of the former gymnasium. The organizers are the Municipal Office of Kláštor pod Znievom, Strive sport, TRIMAT, and the Slovak Athletic Federation, and the race is part of the Slovak Mountain Running Cup.
course_highlights: Course length of 5,650 meters with an elevation gain of 475 meters
Course runs around Kláštor pod Znievom, district of Martin
Part of the Slovak Mountain Running Cup
additional: The start of children's categories is at 14:30, youth categories at 15:00. Categories are divided by age and gender, including several age groups from the youngest pupils to veterans. The organizers are the Municipal Office of Kláštor pod Znievom, Strive sport, TRIMAT, and the Slovak Athletic Federation. The race is part of the Slovak championships in mountain running, suitable for both professional and recreational runners, with online registration available or on-site registration.

name: Pivovarsko-hradná sedemtisícovka
location: areál TJ Slavoj V. Šariš, Veľký Šariš, Prešov, Slovakia
description: The Pivovarsko-hradná Seven Thousand Race is a running event organized by the town of Veľký Šariš in cooperation with the Šariš Brewery and the Sports Committee of the Municipal Council in Veľký Šariš. The race takes place at the TJ Slavoj Veľký Šariš sports complex and offers categories for various age groups and Nordic walking. The start is scheduled for 15:00 for running and 15:05 for Nordic walking. The event is suitable for the general public, including youth, juniors, women, and men of different age categories.
course_highlights: The 7000-meter course runs through the picturesque surroundings of Veľký Šariš
Participants can compete in various categories including juniors, adults, and Nordic walking
The event is part of the local sports tradition and is organized by the town in cooperation with the local brewery
additional: Categories include youth, junior women, women, and men in various age groups. The Nordic walking start is 5 minutes later than the running race. The organizer is the town of Veľký Šariš in cooperation with the Šariš Brewery and the Sports Committee of the Municipal Council in Veľký Šariš. Contact person: PhDr. Mária Gáborová, phone: 051/321 41 24, 051 776 22 33, 0948 593 266. The race takes place at the TJ Slavoj V. Šariš sports complex, registration is also possible on-site, and the event is open to the general public, including Nordic walking participants.

name: XXIV. Büchl Éjszakai Futóverseny
location: Győr, Rónay Jácint u., Győr-Moson-Sopron, Hungary
description: The 24th Büchl Night Running Race will be held on June 6, 2026, in Győr, at the Tulipános Elementary School. The race offers options for multiple distances, including a children's run, 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km individual runs, a 3-person relay for the half marathon, and 7 km Nordic Walking. The race provides a unique finisher medal, chip timing, refreshments, and medical assistance. The courses are well marked and secured with police presence. The start package is available for longer distances, and registration is finalized through prior registration and bank transfer.
course_highlights: Well marked route with guides and police security
7 km distance on a route through Sziget, Downtown, and Révfalva
14 and 21 km distances consisting of 2 or 3 laps on a designated course
additional: Registration becomes final upon bank transfer of the registration fee. On race day, pre-registered participants can pick up their bibs at two times: June 5, 2026, from 15:00 to 18:00 and June 6, 2026, from 9:00 to 12:00 at Dózsa György promenade 51. For on-site registrations, the unique finisher medal for this year's race is not guaranteed; only medals from previous years will be available while supplies last. The registration fee is non-refundable, but 50% of the paid amount can be credited towards a future race registration upon prior agreement. The race offers awards, race pack pickup, security services, and options for registration transfer and modification. Necessary equipment and support are provided on-site.

name: Büchl Éjszakai Félmaraton
location: Bisinger József park, Győr, Győr-Moson-Sopron County, Hungary
description: The Büchl Night Half Marathon is a traditional night running race in Győr, offering multiple distances for running enthusiasts, including a kids' run, individual distances, and relay races. The race is centered at Tulipános Elementary School and is well-organized, featuring chip timing, refreshment stations, medical support, and police security. Participants receive a unique finisher medal, and race kits are provided for the 14 km and 21 km distances. The aim of the race is to provide an enjoyable and safe running experience for all age groups.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.3 km kids' run, 7 km, 14 km, 21 km individual races
3-person half marathon relay and 7 km Nordic Walking distance
Marked route with guides and police security
additional: Pre-race number pickup is available on two dates: the day before the race and on race day. Unique finisher medals are for pre-registrants, with chip timing, downloadable certificates, refreshment stations, and medical support. After paying the registration fee, the registration is final; no refunds are available, but 50% of the fee can be credited towards a future race with prior arrangement. The race features chip timing, finisher medals, refreshment options, marked routes with guides, and medical support. Pre-registration is recommended.

name: Bükk Hegyi Maraton
location: Majális park, Miskolc, Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén County, Hungary
description: The Bükk Mountain Marathon - Ádám Kisgyörgy Memorial Race is Hungary's oldest mountain trail marathon, scheduled to take place on June 6, 2026, in Miskolc, Majális Park. The race offers various distances, from a marathon to a mini-marathon, so everyone can find an ideal challenge. Runners compete amidst the natural beauty of the picturesque Bükk Mountains, while the race progress can be continuously followed at the 'forest stadium' at the race center. The event aims to foster sports friendships, promote a healthy lifestyle, and showcase the natural values of Bükk.
course_highlights: Variable quality forest roads and asphalt sections in the Bükk Mountains
330 meters of elevation gain per lap on the 10.6 km course
Participants return to the forest stadium after each lap, allowing spectators to follow the race continuously
additional: The race center is located at Miskolc, Majális Park-Királyasztal, where relay team members start their journey from the forest stadium. The course is almost entirely on variable quality forest paths, with a marathon time limit of 6 hours. The mini-marathon distance can be completed by running or hiking. Participants return to the race center after each lap, enabling spectators to follow the race continuously. Mountain trail race with multiple distances, suitable for amateur and professional athletes, set in a natural environment.

name: Ceglédfürdő Futófesztivál
location: Ceglédi Gyógyfürdő, Cegléd, Pest County, Hungary
description: The 5th Cegléd Spa Running Festival will be held on June 6, 2026, at the Cegléd Spa and Leisure Center. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and introduce the joy of running to all age groups. Participants can choose from several distances, from a 300-meter toddle for the youngest to a half marathon and relay races. Runners can enjoy the view of the beautiful lake and the spa while running on a track similar to a tartan surface. Programs, awards, and entry to the spa associated with the race further enhance the experience.
course_highlights: The course runs within the Cegléd Spa and Aquapark area on a tartan-like running track
Multiple laps around the lake, allowing six opportunities to admire the spa's beauty
Music points and various styles of sound enrich the running experience
additional: On race day, the 300 m toddle and 800 m kids' run start at 8:20 AM, the 2 km fun run and walk at 8:40 AM, and the other distances (from 3.5 km to 28 km, including relays) at 9:30 AM. The half marathon and 28 km distance have a time limit of 2 hours and 45 minutes. Participants receive changing, shower, and key locker facilities at the beach changing rooms. Finishers get a race pack and medal, as well as a ticket to the Cegléd Spa on race day. Registration fees are non-refundable in case of cancellation and depend on the payment time. Payment by card and bank transfer are available. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with wellness and leisure programs. Organizers pay special attention to ensuring everyone has a good time and can spend the day actively.

name: Crazy5K
location: Budaörsi Repülőtér, Budaörs, Pest County, Hungary
description: The CRAZY5K is a unique 5 km obstacle course race featuring 10 large inflatable obstacles. The race focuses on fun rather than performance, making it an unforgettable day to enjoy with friends, family, or colleagues. A special family race is also available, specifically for families with children under 10 years old, with surprises prepared for the kids. The event takes place at Budaörs Airport, where parking is also available. The registration fee includes a bib number, a T-shirt, a finish pack, a custom medal, refreshments, access to the changing rooms, and medical supervision.
course_highlights: 5 km distance with 10 giant inflatable obstacles
Entertainment and playful challenges alongside the race
Family race for children under 10, with surprises
additional: The registration fee includes a bib number, a T-shirt (to be picked up on site), a finish pack, a custom finisher's medal, a refreshment station, free use of changing rooms, medical supervision, as well as access to women's and men's changing rooms. Parking is available on site at a cost of 1000 HUF per car. Obstacles can be bypassed, but for safety reasons, it is recommended to do so in a wide arc. Group registration discounts are available: 10% for 10-19 participants, and 15% for over 20 participants, applicable only to runners starting in the same time slot. Registration can be transferred for a fee of 2000 HUF per person, and on-site transfers are possible depending on availability. Inflatable obstacles, family race, entertainment, registration options.

name: Banskobystrický maratón
location: Námestie pred Europa SC, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
price_range: 33 € to 108 € v závislosti od kategórie a termínu registrácie
description: The Banská Bystrica Marathon is the largest periodic sports event in central Slovakia, offering a magical evening atmosphere and a fast, experiential certified course. Participants can choose from several disciplines including the marathon, half marathon, 10K run, 5K STEFE run, and relay races. The course is well secured with refreshment stations and sound systems, ensuring a quality experience for all participants. The event is suitable for active runners and families who want to enjoy movement and a sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Magical evening course with certification
Half marathon consists of 3 fast laps with 12 refreshment stations
Super-fast 10K with minimal elevation
additional: The half marathon has 12 refreshment stations and the entire course is sound-equipped. The relay race consists of 3 segments of 7 km each. The STEFE five-kilometer run is designed for families and active runners. The event takes place on June 6, 2026, starting at the Square in front of Europa SC, with several aid stations and various categories for all age groups.

name: Poludnica Run
description: Poludnica Run is a mountain race in the Low Tatras with a course length of 23 km and an elevation gain of 1600 meters. The route mainly follows marked hiking trails, through beautiful south-facing single tracks in the forest, a rock city, and the Poludnica peak with panoramic views of Liptov and the Tatras. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League and the Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia, serving as a qualifying race for the World Skyrunning Championships. The atmosphere is friendly, and the course is considered one of the most challenging in Slovakia within its category. The last edition of this event will take place in 2026.
course_highlights: 23 km long course with an elevation gain of 1600 m
Route follows marked hiking trails, single tracks, and a rock city
Poludnica peak with panoramic views of Liptov, Western and High Tatras
additional: Registration opens on March 23, 2026. Check-in and pickup of race bibs are on race day from 07:00 to 08:40 at the start area. The mass start is at 09:00. The maximum number of participants is 200. There is a refreshment station at 19 km. The course is considered one of the most difficult in Slovakia within its category. After the results are announced at 14:00, a raffle will take place with tickets costing 2 €. The event is part of the seasonal ranking and ITRA point collection, with the possibility to earn points for the World Championships. The event also includes a raffle, a hot meal, and free parking.

name: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Vyšná Myšľa, Košice, Slovakia
description: Vyšná Myšľa Running Race is a running event organized by the Vyšná Myšľa Running Club and the municipality of Vyšná Myšľa. The race takes place on the football field in Vyšná Myšľa and offers categories for various age groups of men, women, and children. It also includes a relay race for pairs over 2 x 3 km. The children's categories start at 14:00 and the adults at 16:00. The event is suitable for the general public, including club members and residents of the municipality, who benefit from a reduced entry fee.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the football field in Vyšná Myšľa
Categories for men, women, and children by age
Relay race for pairs over 2 x 3 km
additional: Children start at 14:00, adults at 16:00. Entry fees are waived for Men E, Women I, members of BKO Vyšná Myšľa, residents of Vyšná Myšľa, and children. The event includes categories for children, adults, and relays, with the possibility of online registration as well as on-site registration. The course is situated on the football field and in the surrounding area of the village.

name: Trail Run
description: Trail Run in Družstevná pri Hornáde is a running competition offering a course with a natural character and diverse surfaces. The race takes place on June 6, 2026, with options to choose between 8 km and 15 km loops, which pass through asphalt, concrete, forest, and field roads with an elevation gain of up to 309 meters. The event also includes children's categories with various distances, making it suitable for a wide age range of runners. The start and finish are located at the multifunctional playground on Okružná Street in Družstevná pri Hornáde.
course_highlights: 8 km loop with an elevation gain of 162 m
15 km loop with an elevation gain of 309 m
Course surface includes asphalt, concrete, forest, and field roads
additional: Registration is only possible online with payment via bank transfer or card, or payment on-site during registration. The program also includes children's categories with various distances and Nordic walking at 16:00. Registration begins at 13:30 and ends at 15:30, with children registering until 14:30. The event is supported by the e.SK foundation and aims to promote trail running in Slovak nature. Details about the route and registration will be published later.

name: Starostovská desiatka
location: Futbalové ihrisko Kišovce, Hôrka, Poprad, Slovakia
description: The Mayor's Ten is a running race held in the village of Hôrka, Poprad district, at the Kišovce football field. The race offers a 10 km course with categories based on age and gender, as well as a 5 km hobby category and races for children and pupils. The main categories start at 16:30, and children's categories begin at 13:00. The organizers are the Hôrka Municipal Office and TJ Baník Hôrka, who welcome runners of all ages and levels.
course_highlights: 10 km course with categories based on age and gender
Hobby category for 5 km without age restrictions
Races for children and pupils with their own start
additional: Children's categories and pupils start at 13:00 and are free of charge. On-site registration costs 15 €. Registration is possible online and on-site, with start times at 13:00 and 16:30. The registration fee includes a hot meal and drinks.

name: Beh pre dobrú vec
description: Run for a good cause is a running event in the village of Pača, offering a course length of 4.4 km. The race is intended for a wide age range from younger to older runners, with categories for men and women. It is a community run that combines sport and a good cause, allowing participants to compete in various age groups. The event is part of the pretekaj.sk platform and offers simple online registration.
course_highlights: Course length of 4.4 km in the village of Pača
Simple loop with one circuit
Categories for men and women aged 15 and older
additional: Registration is conducted via the pretekaj.sk platform, where it is necessary to create an account to manage entries. Partner clubs may offer loyalty or membership cards for quick registration. The event includes categories for men, women, and children, with start times scheduled at 9:30 and 10:30. The course is mostly asphalt with sections on gravel roads.

name: Beh na vrchol Minčola
organizer: Turisti a priaznivci behu na Minčol v spolupráci s Mestom Lipany
description: The run to the summit of Minčol is a traditional race in Lipany, offering a challenging course of 7,300 meters with an elevation gain of 649 meters. The race is open to a wide range of categories from the youngest children to seniors and also includes a competition as part of the Vychodniarska Mountain Running League 2025. The organizers are the Lipany Municipality in cooperation with hikers and supporters of running to Minčol. The race is suitable for all who enjoy uphill running and want to test their strength in a beautiful natural environment.
course_highlights: Course length of 7,300 meters with an elevation gain of 649 meters
Start in Lúčka above the municipal office in Lipany
Part of the Vychodniarska Mountain Running League 2025
additional: Categories for competitors from preschool (2017 and younger) to seniors, including categories for Nordic Walking. The organizer is the town of Lipany in cooperation with hikers and supporters of running to Minčol. The registration fee is increased on the day of the race. The race is part of the Vychodniarska Mountain Running League 2025. Terrain: mountain trail, registration online or on-site, part of the Vychodniarska Mountain Running League 2025.

name: Single-Trail run 30

Race in the natural environment of Ruská Nová Ves
Categories for men and women without age restrictions

The course leads through challenging terrain, registration is possible online and on-site, with the start and finish at Hostinec pod zámkom.

The goal of the running gala is for participants to escape everyday life, enjoy the freedom of movement, and be part of a community experience. At the finish line, runners will receive a unique finisher medal and a running shirt to make the day memorable.

Unique finisher medal and running shirt at the finish line

name: Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Futás 9 / 21

Organizers warmly welcome runners to enjoy nature and community experience together.

Passing through Pécs, Orfű, and Abaliget
Includes a children's race and a dog-friendly race
additional: Race packet includes a chip bib with a safety pin. On-site registration and race packet pickup will be on June 7, 2026, from 08:30 to 09:30. A special bus departs from Abaliget to Pécs, with a ticket price of 1500 HUF; reservation required at registration. Participants under 18 need a parental consent form. PTE employees and students receive a 50% discount with early bird registration. Multiple distances, discounts for PTE staff and locals, bus transfer, children's race.

description: The Pécs-Orfű-Abaliget Run is a road half marathon connecting the towns of Pécs, Orfű, and Abaliget, with an elevation gain of 465 meters. course_highlights: 465 meters of elevation gain on a paved course
Passing through Pécs, Orfű, and Abaliget
Kids' run of 400 meters at the Abaliget beach
additional: Race packet includes a chip bib with a safety pin. On-site registration and race packet pickup will be available on June 7, 2026, from 08:30 to 09:30. A special bus departs from Abaliget to Pécs, with a ticket price of 1500 HUF; advance reservation is required. Participants under 18 need a parental consent form. Parking is limited; public transportation is recommended. Distances: 21 km, 9 km, kids' run, dog-friendly run; refreshment stations, changing rooms, showers, swimming opportunities at Abaliget, lunch after the race, race without a cup.

Unique finisher medal and running shirt at the finish

name: Bathory Run

Start at the football field in Sedliska
Multiple age categories including children and youth

Organizers: Obec Sedliska and MV Running team Sedliska. The race takes place on the football field, registration is online, with starts scheduled at 11:00 for children and 13:00 for adults.

name: Spoznaj Trebišov behom – Charity Run

The event is organized by Majcher-Production s.r.o. and is suitable for the general public who want to stay active and contribute to charity.

The charitable nature of the event combines sport with community support

description: The Šamorín Running League (ŠBL) is a series of running races organized by the 3klub Šamorín, intended for the general public without age or performance limits. Participants are evaluated in categories: men, women, boys, and girls, with shorter distances for children. The league takes place throughout the year and includes the traditional Pomlé Run event. The registration fee covers race numbers, timing, refreshments, and league evaluation. The final round will feature an official overall league assessment with awards for the best runners.
course_highlights: Lesopark Pomlé in Šamorín as start and finish point
Various categories with shorter and longer distances (100 m to 5 km)
Running courses in natural surroundings with refreshments at the finish
additional: Children's categories start gradually from 10:00 (preschoolers 100 m, younger pupils 700 m, older pupils 700 m) and adults start at 10:30. Registration takes place from 9:00 until 30 minutes before the category start on the meadow in Lesopark Pomlé. WC and changing rooms are available at the Amphitheatre. The registration fee includes race numbers, timing, refreshments at the finish, and a raffle. Kindergarten children receive a medal after finishing but will not be scored. The event is part of a series running from March to October 2026, with various categories for all age groups, located at Lesopark Pomlé.

name: Šebešská pätnástka
location: Nevického chatu, Vyšná Šebastová, Prešov, Slovakia
price_range: 12,- € online pred 27.5.2025; 20,- € na mieste; 4 km zadarmo
description: The Šebešská Fifteen is a running race organized by the MTC Vyšná Šebastová club in cooperation with the Vyšná Šebastová municipal office and sports associations. The main course measures 15.5 km with a climb to Nevický Chata, complemented by a recreational 3 km route and children's disciplines for various age categories. The race takes place annually on the first Sunday of June with a morning start and a rich cultural and social program that attracts hundreds of visitors. The event is part of several running competitions and leagues, with organizers emphasizing the development of sport and building the reputation of the village. Šebešská Fifteen received the Running Diamond award in 2011 and 2012.
course_highlights: Main course 15.5 km with a climb to Nevický Chata
Recreational route 3 km suitable for the general public
Children's disciplines for preschoolers to juniors
additional: The race is accompanied by a rich cultural and social program, a raffle, and performances by musical groups. It is also part of regional running competitions and the Eastern Slovak Grand Prix of endurance (VVCV). Race director Ján Tomčo is an active runner and founder of the MTC Vyšná Šebastová club, bringing a spirit of fair play and competitiveness to the event. The course includes a climb to Nevický Chata, with children's disciplines and a vibrant cultural program, awards, and recognitions.

name: Angličák night run Pezinok
description: Angličák Night Run Pezinok is a night running race over 5 kilometers held at the Rozálka Health Area in Pezinok. Runners can enjoy a fast and dynamic run along a route passing through the Malokarpatská region with artificial lighting, creating a unique atmosphere. The event is open to everyone aged 15 and older and is divided into start corridors based on performance. Organizers emphasize safety, so the use of headphones is prohibited, and reflective elements or headlamps are recommended. Registration is available online and is tied to the runner's name, with pre-registration possible until June 9, 2026.
course_highlights: 5 km night run with artificial lighting
Route passes through Rozálka Health Area, Malokarpatská region, and Radničné námestie
Start corridors based on previous race times
additional: The minimum age of participants is 15 years as of the calendar year 2025. Pre-registration of a ticket for another person is possible until June 9, 2026, for a fee of 10 euros. The use of headphones during the run is strictly prohibited. Reflective elements and headlamps are recommended due to the night run. The start fee is non-transferable and tied to the participant's name. The route goes from Rozálka Health Area through Malokarpatská, Majakovského Bridge, Okružná Street, SNP Bridge, Kupeckého, Holubyho, and ends at Radničné námestie. Registration is only possible online, pre-registration is required, and the start fee is linked to the participant's name.

name: The Run Slovakia
description: THE RUN SLOVAKIA 2026 is a national relay race across Slovakia taking place over three days. Runners collectively cover more than 530 km from Košice to Bratislava, passing through beautiful natural scenery, historical landmarks, and picturesque towns. The event offers a unique sporting atmosphere, team cooperation, and many unforgettable experiences. The route passes through significant sites such as Spiš Castle, High Tatras, Orava Castle, and Little Carpathians, with participants also experiencing a rich accompanying program.
course_highlights: Route length of 530 km from Košice to Bratislava
Passage through important natural and historical landmarks such as Spiš Castle, High Tatras, Orava Castle
Total ascent of 7308 m and descent of 7376 m
additional: The total number of participating teams is limited to 100. Registration is conducted via a web application that allows real-time tracking of runners, current results, navigation, and notifications from the organizing team. The race is intended for team runners, with the possibility to view results in real time. Registration is open, various promotional items are available, and there is a mobile app for performance tracking.

name: Brutálfutás 15.0
description: The Brutálfutás 15.0 is a light obstacle course race in Nyáregyháza, where participants can complete a 2, 3, or 7-kilometer course that combines a military training ground and obstacle race. The race is not about performance but about good mood and unforgettable experiences, with mud and water guaranteed. Participants are greeted with a unique finisher medal and lots of mud, and can also register as charity runners. The event attracts participants from hundreds of settlements across the country and is a truly entertaining, family-friendly event.
course_highlights: A mix of military training ground and obstacle race
Lots of mud and water, unforgettable obstacles
Unique finisher medal and party atmosphere
additional: Registration is only possible online at nevezes.futanet.hu, with payment by bank card or SZÉP card. The race takes place at the Nyáregyháza MotoCross track, easily accessible from the M5 motorway. Student discounts are available upon presentation of a school attendance certificate and student ID for school-aged students. Classic running gear is not required for the race; good mood and a sense of adventure are most important. Cross-country running, online and on-site registration, unique finisher medal, challenging obstacles, and a mud-filled course.

name: Bábolna Bio Sunset Run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ovis futam -> ingyenes, de regisztrációhoz kötött

description: The Bábolna Bio Sunset Run is a charming evening running race scheduled for June 13, 2026, in the center of Bábolna, in front of the Strand and Thermal Bath. During the race, runners will pass by the riding hall as well as the famous Bábolna Arboretum and Animal Park. The race starts at sunset with special atmospheric lighting, and participants can choose from three distances, including a relay half marathon. Runners receive a premium start package with BioTechUSA refreshments, and everyone finishing within the time limit will receive a unique finisher medal.
course_highlights: The running course passes by the riding hall
Crosses the Bábolna Arboretum and Animal Park area
Evening start at sunset with extra atmospheric lighting
additional: BioTechUSA refreshments are provided at refreshment points during the race. Start packages include an optional ECO or premium package, with the premium package containing a Mizuno event T-shirt. At the finish line in the Athletes Garden, finishers are greeted with a unique finisher medal. The race starts in the evening at sunset, making summer heat less of an issue. There are time limits for the 5.25 km, 10.5 km, and half marathon distances; there are no time limits for the preschool and family runs. The race office is located in Budapest, on Tüzér Street, with opening hours and a phone contact. The event takes place in an environmentally friendly and family-friendly atmosphere, with the opportunity to purchase discounted bath entry after the race.

name: Edelényi Kastélysziget Esti Körök 3 / 7 / 14 / 21
description: The Edelény Castle Island Evening Circuits is a charming running race held around the L'Huillier-Coburg castle. The race offers options for runners at multiple distances, so everyone can find a suitable challenge. The event is an ideal choice for those who enjoy the special atmosphere of the castle park and the experience of running in the evening. The organizers welcome participants with professional timing and a convenient registration platform.
course_highlights: Running in the park of L'Huillier-Coburg castle
Evening atmosphere and unique environment
Multiple distances: 3 km, 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km
additional: Registration is available at korido.hu, where chip timing (RFID, HuTag) is provided. Participants can choose from several distances, and the organizers will automatically send confirmation of registration and payment. Race bibs are provided, along with safety pins, and payment can also be made via SimplePay card. The race takes place over various terrains, including forest and asphalt sections, with RFID timing. Registration is done through korido.hu.

name: Kecskeméti Sport Fesztivál
description: The Kecskemét Sports Festival is a traditional community sports event in Kecskemét, around the Benkó Hill. The aim of the event is to promote leisure physical activity and sports, welcoming participants in a friendly atmosphere with various running programs. In addition to running, charity events and community programs are also held, linking sports and social responsibility. Organizers warmly invite runners to enjoy the joy of movement and the proximity of nature together.
course_highlights: Running track around Benkó Hill in a pleasant natural environment
Community, family-friendly running events
Charity running programs and additional sports events
additional: The event also includes charity activities where proceeds support local foundations. There is usually a raffle among runners, and organizers provide refreshments and meals for participants. The event features ultramarathons, light runs, and other sports activities that encourage active participation of the location and community.

name: UTBT (Ultra Tokaj-Bodrogkeresztúr-Tarcal)
description: The Ultra Tokaj - Bodrogkeresztúr - Tarcal running race is a challenging 63 km ultra distance that winds through the picturesque vineyards and hills of the Tokaj-Hegyalja region. The race offers three different distances, catering to both beginners and experienced runners seeking their ideal challenge. The event is not just a race but an experience set in one of Hungary's most beautiful wine regions. Starts are mass start, and participants receive refreshments along the route and at the finish line.
course_highlights: 63 km ultra distance through vineyards and hills
Legendary route of Tokaj-Hegyalja
Refreshments on the route and at the finish line
additional: The race includes individual and team categories, with teams of 2-4 members. Starts are mass start, with the latest start times for teams announced by June 5, 2026. Registration fees can be paid by credit card or bank transfer. Participants receive a downloadable electronic certificate, and related programs and discounts are available. The time limits are: Ultra 8 hours, Marathon 6 hours, Half Marathon 3 hours. Age restrictions vary by distance, between 12 and 18 years. Three different distances are available; registration details are not provided. The race takes place around the Festival Theatre area.

name: BRUTÁLFUTÁS
description: The Brutálfutás is a light obstacle course race in Nyáregyháza, offering unforgettable muddy and watery experiences on 2.3 and 7 kilometer distances. The race is a mix of military training ground and obstacle race, where fun and community experience are at the forefront. Participants, coming from hundreds of towns across the country, are greeted with a unique finisher medal and lots of mud. The event is not about seriousness but about entertainment and challenge, so anyone can find a suitable distance for themselves.
course_highlights: A mix of military training ground and obstacle race
Mud and water courses of 2.3 and 7 kilometers
Unique finisher medal and lots of mud
additional: Registration is only possible online at nevezes.futanet.hu. Payment can be made by bank card or SZÉP card. A BSI account registration is required for registration. Participants will receive a unique finisher medal and lots of mud. The event welcomes participants with online registration, charity elements, and a festival atmosphere. The race offers both challenges and community experience.

name: Ultra Nízke Tatry
description: The Ultra Low Tatras is the first edition of a mountain running event that traverses the ridge of the Low Tatras from west to east. The course is 49.7 km long with an elevation gain of 2650 meters and follows marked tourist trails from Donovaly to Srdiečko. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar and also serves as a Memorial for Milan Styka, a notable runner and mountaineer who tragically died in 2025. The start is scheduled for June 13, 2026, at 7:00 AM in Donovaly at the Donovaly Brewery.
course_highlights: 49.7 km long course with 2650 m elevation gain
Ridge of the Low Tatras from Donovaly to Srdiečko
The route follows red, green, and yellow tourist trails passing by M.R. Štefánik Chalet and Kosodrevina
additional: Registration is possible online from December 20, 2025, at 00:00 and also on-site at the Donovaly Brewery on June 13, 2026, from 16:00 to 21:00, and on the morning of the race from 6:00 to 6:45. The provisional cut-off time at Chopok after 37 km is 15:00 (8 hours after the start). The organizer reserves the right to change the route due to weather conditions and to set time limits. The course passes through mountain terrain, with information available about registration, the commemorative nature of the event, possible route changes due to weather, and time limits depending on conditions.

name: Strečnianska mašľa
description: Strečnianska Mašľa is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance walk around Strečno, taking place on June 13, 2026. The race offers two routes - a challenging 50 km course with an elevation gain of approximately 2985 meters and a shorter 25 km course, suitable for runners with dogs. The routes run along marked hiking trails through both parts of Malá Fatra and through a section of the national park, with start and finish at the Radinové football pitch in Strečno. Organizers provide start packages, prizes for the best participants, and quality conditions for competitors.
course_highlights: 50 km route with an elevation gain of approximately 2985 m through Malá Fatra
Routes run along marked hiking trails and through the national park area
Start and finish at the Radinové football pitch in Strečno
additional: Participant limit: 300 for 50 km, 300 for 25 km, 50 for 25 km with a dog. Starting number and chip are assigned by the organizers. Mandatory equipment includes a first aid kit, valid ID, mountain rescue insurance, a charged mobile phone, a personal drinking container, a whistle or bells (recommended for the 50 km route), a map or GPS device, sunglasses, and sunscreen. Accommodation is available in changing rooms or tents at the football pitch. Lodging is also available at Pizzeria Alžbetka and SIP ŽSR Strečno. The race features certified routes, registration opens on March 1, 2026, and is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League. The course passes through the Malá Fatra national park.

name: Krosak pod hradom
organizer: Mgr. Ján Podstavský, Vladimír Adam, Ing. Ladislav Ondrik, Vladimír Sikorai, Gabriel Sabo, Štefan Karafa
course_highlights: Trať vedie po poľnej a lesnej ceste s asfaltovým povrchom
Veľký krosák je 10 km (2 x 5 km okruh)
Pretek sa koná v malebnom prostredí Trnavy pri Laborci
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov začína od 8:00 hod. na Obecnom úrade, detské kategórie od 7:30 hod. Nové registrácie v deň pretekov sú možné len do vypredania voľných štartových čísel. Platba na mieste je 25 €. Podujatie sa koná 13. júna 2026, s štartmi o 09:00 a 11:00, a zahŕňa kategórie na 10 km, 5 km a Nordic Walking, s dôrazom na charitatívne účely a komunitnú účasť.

name: Kysucký maratón
location: Čadca, Čadca, Matičné námestie - pred Domom kultúry Čadca, Slovakia
price_range: 35 EUR do 1. 5. 2026, 40 EUR po 1. 5. 2026, 25 EUR pre účastníkov z okresu Čadca
description: Kysucký marathon is the second oldest marathon in Slovakia and an important sports and social event in the Kysuce region. The course runs through the picturesque Kysuce valley along the Kysuca River, with a safer and more attractive route on a running cycle path from 2025. The event includes, besides the marathon, a half marathon, marathon relay, and a mini marathon for children. The start and finish are at Matičné Square in Čadca in front of the Cultural House. Runners compete in various age categories, and participants have access to refreshment stations and facilities including changing rooms and wellness services.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque Kysuce valley along the Kysuca River
Safe and attractive route on a running cycle path (Bystrická cycle trail)
Marathon turnaround at the square near the Slovak Orloj in Stará Bystrica
additional: The start and finish of the race are at Matičné Square in Čadca in front of the Cultural House. There are 8 refreshment stations along the course. Refreshments are provided after the race. Participants have access to changing rooms, a swimming pool, and a sauna at the local swimming pool. The marathon time limit is 5 hours for 40 km; exceeding this time may affect placement in the results. The course is on certified routes, with refreshment stations on the course, changing rooms, a pool, sauna, and post-race refreshments. Online registration is open until June 1, 2026. Organizer insurance is not included.

name: Beh Hodkovským parkom

price_tiers.distance: Beh pre zdravie 4 km a Nordic walking 4 km

description: The Hodkovce Park Run is a running event held at the Hodkovce Castle grounds in Žehra, offering a course mainly on rural and forest paths with an asphalt section. The race is divided into categories including an 8 km competitive run for different age groups of men and women, as well as non-competitive categories such as a 4 km health run and Nordic walking without age restrictions. The organizer is DOMOVINA n.o., which ensures a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization for all participants. The entry fee is available online at a discounted price, encouraging early registration.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs on rural and forest paths with an asphalt section
The race takes place at the Hodkovce Castle grounds in Žehra
Categories for various age groups and non-competitive variants of running and Nordic walking
additional: The entry fee is €7 for online registration until June 12, 2025, and €9 on-site. The course is suitable for different age categories and includes non-competitive variants of running and Nordic walking. The start and finish are located at the DSS DOMOVINA premises in Žehra, part of Hodkovce. The event features various categories for all age groups, with registration open until June 12, 2025. The course includes forest, rural paths, and asphalt sections.

name: Beh Kalváriou
description: Kalvária Run is a charity running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Kalvária in Považská Bystrica. The event offers routes for adults and children, with the course surface consisting of forest paths. This fourth edition of the race is an opportunity to experience community, movement, and joy, with the proceeds from the run donated to children in need. The organizers emphasize quality organization and support for charitable causes.
course_highlights: Forest paths in the Kalvária environment
Routes for adults and children
Beautiful varied course with nice weather
additional: Registration is only possible online via vysledkovyservis.sk. On-site registration on the day of the race will not be available. After paying the entry fee, the participant's name will appear in the list of registered participants and a confirmation will be sent via email. There is an option for a voluntary contribution during registration to support Hugovi and Simonke. The participant limit is 500 adults and 250 children. The event is governed by the rules of the Slovak Athletic Federation. Registration is only available online; the event has a charitable purpose; the participant limit is 500 adults and 250 children; races are scheduled for 10:00 for children and 12:15 for adults.

name: Lemešanská bežecká liga 2. Letné kolo
location: Lemešany, Lúka nad obcou Lemešany, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Lemešany, Športová komisia obce Lemešany, Záhrada pohybu
price_range: dospelí: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste; občania obce: 5 € online, 10 € na mieste; deti a juniorské: 3 €; detské behy zdarma
description: Lemešanská running league 2. Summer round is a running event held in Lemešany on a meadow above the village. The race is divided into several categories based on age and gender, including children's categories and Nordic walking. The start for the main categories is at 5:00 PM, children's categories start at 5:10 PM. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant summer running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Various categories for all age groups including children and adults
Online registration with low entry fee
Children's runs on the meadow are free
additional: Categories: Men A (18-39 years), Men B (40 and over), Women F (18-39 years), Women G (40 and over), Girls/Boys 1 (12-14 years), Girls/Boys 2 (15-17 years), Children up to 12 years (only accompanied by an adult), Nordic Walking men/women. Children's runs on the meadow are free, online registration until June 12, 2026, additional €2 fee per bib, start at 5:00 PM and 5:10 PM.

name: Beh na chatu pri Zelenom plese – Memoriál K. Jakeša
location: Tatranský Mlyn pri Zelenom plese, Vysoké Tatry, Prešovský kraj, Slovakia
description: The Run at Chata pri Zelenom plese is a mountain race designed for sports and nature enthusiasts, suitable for both amateur and professional athletes. The event has been held regularly since 2005 during the second weekend of June and commemorates Karel Jakeš, a prominent Czechoslovak mountaineer. The course leads through challenging mountain terrain with significant elevation gain, making the race a challenge for all participants. The goal is to connect various sports groups and offer them a unique experience in the beautiful environment of the High Tatras.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 7.7 km
Total ascent 651 m
Total descent 18 m
additional: The event is organized with financial support from the Ministry of Tourism and Sports of the Slovak Republic. The race unites athletes, runners, climbers, skiers, mountaineers, cyclists, and ski mountaineers into one sporting community. Registration for the 20th edition has closed. The race will take place in June 2026, with registration available on the official website. The course starts at the bus stop Biela voda and ends at Chata pri Zelenom plese, suitable for runners of all levels with a love for mountain challenges.

name: X. Sopron Trail 5 / 10 / 25
organizer: Sopron Város Polgármesteri Hivatal Sportfelügyeleti Csoportja, SMAFC Tájfutó Szakosztálya, SMAFC Tájfutó Sportjáért Alapítvány, Sopron-Trail
description: The Sopron Trail 2026 mountain running race will be held in the picturesque surroundings of Sopron-Brennbergbánya on June 14, 2026. The race aims to promote trail running and showcase the wild parts of the Sopron Mountains. Participants can choose from several distances, including 5.9 km, 10.7 km, and 25.9 km, with the Alpokalja Trail King series also included. The race features a special extra challenge on a timed uphill section, where the best male and female runners will receive a prize. The race headquarters is located at the Brennbergbánya Cultural Center, which has restrooms and showers available.
course_highlights: Wildly scenic terrain in the Sopron Mountains
Timed uphill section on the 10.7 km and 25.9 km distances
Refreshment points on the 10.7 km and 25.9 km distances, environmentally friendly with no cups
additional: The start and finish are at Brennbergbánya main square. The award ceremony is scheduled for Sunday at 12:30 at the finish line. Showers and restrooms/WC are available at the race headquarters. Due to environmental reasons, no cups will be provided at the refreshment points; participants are advised to bring their own water bottles or cups. Registration is done online via the E-registration system, with the deadline on June 13, 2026, at 12:00 PM. The race offers special prizes for the challenging uphill sections. The organizers implement eco-friendly solutions.

name: Lussonium Trail 1 / 5 / 14
description: The Lussonium Trail is a family-friendly trail running race between the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering stunning panoramic views and challenging ascents. The race takes place in a friendly, cheerful atmosphere where runners can meet each other year after year. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal, but registration without a medal is also possible. The event is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to earn points and exchange them for rewards. The start/finish area is located at the Lussonium Romkert, where parking, restrooms, a playground, and a first aid station are available.
course_highlights: Stunning panoramic views between Paks-Dunakömlőd hills
Challenging ascents and varied terrain
Exciting start/finish location at Lussonium Romkert
additional: The race will be held with a minimum of 100 participants and a maximum of 400 entries, including up to 100 preschool and elementary school children. Parking, restrooms, a playground, and a first aid station are available on site. The finisher medals can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal. The event is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program. The race takes place at Lussonium Romkert in Dunakömlőd, offering sports opportunities for families and individual runners alike.

name: CROSSKOVÁCSI Dockyard Terepfutó verseny
description: The Crosskovácsi Dockyard Trail Running Race is a diverse trail running event offering various distances in the picturesque surroundings of Nagykovácsi, near the Teleki-Tisza Castle. The race is held over four distances: mini (3 km), short (7 km), mid-distance (13.5 km), and mountain half marathon (21.7 km), each starting with a 1 km warm-up lap in the castle park. The courses traverse varied terrain with significant elevation gain, and participants can refresh at aid stations. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. The race uses electronic timing, and organizers pay special attention to participants' safety and medical care.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 7 km, 13.5 km, 21.7 km (mountain half marathon)
Significant elevation gain: 85 m+ on mini, 595 m+ on mountain half marathon
Two refreshment stations on the course, three on the mountain half marathon, use of personal soft-cup recommended
additional: The race starts twice: at 9:00 for the Mountain Half Marathon, and at 9:30 for the Mini, Short, and Mid-distance races. Use of a personal "soft-cup" is mandatory at aid stations during the mountain half marathon. The race is timed electronically, with rescue systems provided by off-road vehicles and medical personnel. Registration is available on SPORTNAPTAR.HU, with pre-registration from December 6, 2025. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. The event features multiple distances, refreshment stations, medical services, parking, and an auto-free start/finish area.

name: LUSSONIUM TRAIL
description: The Lussonium Trail is a trail running race held among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering stunning panoramic views, challenging ascents, and an impressive start/finish location. The race takes place in a friendly, family-like atmosphere, where participants of all ages can test their strength over various distances. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal, with an option for a cheaper registration without a medal. The event is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program, and on-site parking, restrooms, a playground, and first aid are available.
course_highlights: Stunning panoramic views among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd
Challenging ascents on the trail
Impressive start and finish location at Lussonium Romkert
additional: The race will be held with a minimum of 100 participants and accepts up to 400 registrations, including a maximum of 100 preschool and elementary school children. On-site parking, restrooms, a playground, and a first aid station are provided. Finish medals can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal. The event is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program. Multiple distances, family and children categories, hilly terrain, medals, and refreshments are available for participants.

name: Račiansky kros – leto
location: Knižková dolina, Bratislava – Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Račiansky kros SUMMER is a running event in Bratislava-Rača offering three courses of varying lengths and elevation gains. The main course is 16 km with an elevation gain of 503 meters, another course is 9.5 km with an elevation gain of 335 meters, and there are also children's runs. The courses mainly pass through forest terrain with asphalt sections and are well marked in three ways. The event is suitable for different age categories and offers awards for the best in each category. The start is in Knižkova Dolina and the time limit is 3 hours for the main course.
course_highlights: Course 16 km with an elevation gain of +503 m, time limit 3 hours
Course 9.5 km with an elevation gain of +335 m, time limit 2 hours
Surface: 80% forest, 20% asphalt, marked with pink ribbons, white arrows, and laminated arrows on trees
additional: The course is marked in three ways: pink ribbons with race print on trees, white chalk arrows on the ground, and laminated arrows on trees (blue, pink, orange). Refreshment stations: 2 on the 16 km course, 1 on the 9.5 km course. Mandatory equipment includes a bib number attached visibly to the chest. Results are announced shortly after crossing. The course is mainly forest with asphalt sections; registration is possible online or on-site; children's runs with medals and prizes are part of the event; it is part of the Račiansky kros series with multiple editions throughout the year.

name: Vranovská desiatka
location: Dom kultúry vo Vranove nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
organizer: Mesto Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský športový klub Vranov nad Topľou, Mestský dom kultúry
description: Vranovská desiatka is a traditional running race in the town of Vranov nad Topľou, offering courses of 10 km and 5 km. The race is organized by the Town of Vranov nad Topľou, the Municipal Sports Club, and the Municipal House of Culture. Categories are divided by age and gender, with the top three runners from Vranov also being recognized. The start and finish are at the House of Culture in Vranov nad Topľou. The race is suitable for the general public, from recreational runners to competitors.
course_highlights: Courses of 10 km and 5 km in the town of Vranov nad Topľou
Categories by age and gender including recognition of the top Vranov runners
Start and finish at the House of Culture in Vranov nad Topľou
additional: The race categories are divided into 10 km (men and women by age groups) and 5 km (men and women without categories). The registration fee is €15 for online registration and €20 for on-site registration. Organizers are the Town of Vranov nad Topľou, the Municipal Sports Club, and the Municipal House of Culture. The contact person is Eva Fedorňáková at phone number 0917 127 502. The race offers categories for 10 km and 5 km, with start at the House of Culture. Registration is possible online or on-site.

name: Čeľovská sedmička
description: The Cheľovská Seven is a running event held in the village of Čeľovce, Trebišov district, in front of the Cultural House. The race is designed for various categories including men, women, families, and children, offering a summer walk and a competition for the youngest runners. The event is part of the Beh.sk running community and promotes an active lifestyle in a pleasant village environment.
course_highlights: The event takes place in front of the Cultural House in Čeľovce
The event is intended for various age groups and families
The date of the event is June 14, 2026
additional: The start location is in front of the Cultural House in Čeľovce. Categories include men, women, families, and children, including the youngest runners and a summer walk. The race is part of local activities and is suitable for all age groups, including children and families.

name: Tatranská 15
organizer: Obecný úrad Mlynčeky, Športoví nadšenci z Mlynčekov
description: Tatranská 15 is a running race organized by the Municipal Office of Mlynčeky and sports enthusiasts from Mlynčeky. The race takes place on the football field in Mlynčeky and offers an opportunity for runners to experience the atmosphere of a sporting event in a beautiful environment. The registration fee is available at a discounted price for early registration, and it is also possible to register on the day of the race. The organizers welcome all runners and sports enthusiasts to this traditional event.
course_highlights: 15 km course in the picturesque nature of Mlynčeky
Part of OCR races including Barbarian and Spartan
Favorable registration fees, €10 for registration before 21.6.2024
additional: The registration fee is paid upon presentation on the day of the race. The organizer is the Municipal Office of Mlynčeky and sports enthusiasts from Mlynčeky. The start location is the football field in Mlynčeky. Registration fee: €10 for registration before 21.6.2024, €12 for registration on the day of the race; location: Football field, Mlynčeky

name: I. Szentivánéji Futótűz 5 / 10 / 21
description: The I. Midsummer Flash Run is a night running festival in Balatonszárszó, at the Lakeside Park, held on Midsummer Night. Participants can choose from several distances, including a half marathon, shorter races, and an evening walk along the Lake Balaton. The event celebrates the start of the summer season and welcomes runners, families, and community sports enthusiasts. The race is part of the Ötpróba program, which offers points collection opportunities for valuable rewards.
course_highlights: Night run along Lake Balaton
400m children’s race on a traffic-free route in Lakeside Park
5.25 km course with refreshment points around 2.6 km
additional: Number pickup at 10:00 AM in Lakeside Park. The relay exchange takes place at the finish gate with a chip timing bib, and it is recommended to use a bib holder. The registration fee includes refreshments (grape sugar, biscuits, salty pretzels, mineral water, syrup, gummy candies). Residents of Balatonszárszó receive a 30% discount, and seasonal discounts are also available based on previous participation. Technical shirts can be purchased separately for 8,500 HUF. The event supports the Ötpróba program, offering discounts for local participants and season pass holders, as well as various running opportunities and awards for participants.

name: SZENT LÁSZLÓ TEREPFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The Saint László Trail Run is a traditional trail running race in the Gerecse Mountains near Baj, organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. The race is held in honor of Saint László, the patron saint of soldiers and infantry, and has been held regularly since 2010, with the exception of 2013 when it was canceled due to flooding. Runners can test their strength on varied terrain, forest trails, and hilly areas. The event is a lively, community-oriented occasion, suitable for those interested in outdoor activities and sports.
course_highlights: Varied terrain of the Gerecse Mountains
Forest trails and hilly sections
Nature-oriented, challenging running course
additional: The race is organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association, which operates several sections including athletics, triathlon, orienteering, outdoor activities, sport shooting, and other sports. The event traditionally takes place in June, and the 2026 race will be the XVI. edition. Maps and previous results are available on the organizers' website. Mountain trail running, annual event, multiple distances and categories, detailed information not provided.

name: Skyrun Kubínska
price_range: 25,- € online, 35,- € na mieste (Skyrun); 15,- € online, 20,- € na mieste (Skyshort)
description: Skyrun Kubínska is a mountain run in the beautiful nature of Orava, offering courses of 24 km and 11 km. The race is dedicated to the memory of Barnabáš Üvegeš, and participants can enjoy challenging terrain with views of the surrounding nature. Runners will experience a combination of mountain trails and natural scenery, making this event a unique experience.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in the Orava region
Two course options: 24 km and 11 km
Challenging terrain with beautiful views
additional: Trail race with mountain terrain, dedicated to Barnabáš Uvegeš, taking place in June 2026.

name: Beh Ludrovskou dolinou
organizer: Obec Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, Ružomberskie Strely o.z.
price_range: 5 € pre dospelých, zadarmo pre deti a mládež
description: Run through Ludrovská Valley is a running event organized in Ludrovská Valley near the football stadium in Ludrová. The race offers starts for children's categories on grass and for adults on forest paths and asphalt. The event is suitable for a wide age range of runners from children to seniors, with categories divided by age. The organizers are Obec Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, and Ružomberskie Strely o.z., who ensure a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Children's categories run on grass
Other categories run on forest paths and asphalt
Start and finish location is the football stadium in Ludrovská Valley
additional: The start of children's categories is at 9:30 AM, main categories at 10:30 AM. Categories are divided by age and gender, including youth and several adult age groups. Organizers are Obec Ludrová, OŠK Ludrová, and Ružomberskie Strely o.z. Contact for the organizer: Peter Laco, phone 0905 284 430. The course includes grass, forest paths, and asphalt; start times are 9:30 and 10:30; registration is possible on-site; categories for different age groups; race distances range from 60 meters to 10 km.

name: Prešov Running Series 2. kolo
description: Prešov Running Series Round 2, known as Šariš Run, is a running event held on the banks of Rybníky in Veľký Šariš under the historic Šariš Castle. This location is a new addition to the series and has gained great popularity among runners. The event is full of sporting spirit, community, and love for nature, offering a rich accompanying program including musical performances, health stalls, a relaxation zone, and activities for children. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, making running an unforgettable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: The course runs along the Rybníky banks in Veľký Šariš under Šariš Castle
A new location in the heart of Šariš with great success among runners
Natural environment with a community and family atmosphere
additional: The event offers a rich accompanying program including a musical performance by the band Hrdza, stalls with health services and joint nutrition, a relaxation zone, medieval costumes with a photo booth and royal throne, activities for children, and a raffle. The course includes a 10 km race, children's runs, a program with music, stalls, activities, and a raffle, all set in a location under Šariš Castle.

name: Beh cez Zalužické poľa
price_range: 20€ on-line, 21€ na mieste pre hlavné kategórie; 3€ on-line, 4€ na mieste pre deti
description: The Run through Zalužické Fields is the second edition of a running event scheduled for June 20, 2026, in the Zalužice area. This run offers participants the opportunity to experience the nature and beauty of Zemplín during the summer season. The event is part of the Zemplínsky Extrém series, which features various running challenges in the region.
course_highlights: The route passes through natural fields around Zalužice
Location in a picturesque setting of Michalovce district
Part of the Zemplínsky Extrém series with multiple running events
additional: The race takes place on asphalt, field, and grassy paths; registration is available online and on-site, with categories for different age groups

name: toRunská vrtuľa
organizer: Zuzana Jankovičová, Lívia Skurská, Monika Tomisová
description: toRunská vrtuľa is a charity running and community day in the beautiful environment of the Dubník water reservoir in Stará Tura. The event focuses on movement and helping others, with all proceeds from the entry fees dedicated to the rehabilitation of girl Simonka Zigová. Running pairs have 8 hours to complete as many laps around Dubník as possible, with a friendly and supportive atmosphere. Organizers and volunteers ensure the event runs without any fee, emphasizing the community and charitable aspect of the event.
course_highlights: Circuit around the Dubník water reservoir approximately 2.4 km long
Running pairs have 8 hours to complete as many laps as possible
Pleasant natural environment and community atmosphere
additional: Registration is possible as a pair or solo runner. Children up to 14.99 years old register on-site for a symbolic entry fee of at least 5 €, and the first 100 children receive a start package. The first 170 registered and paid runners will receive a start package and a medal. During the run, hydration and healthy refreshments are provided. Runners must report each completed lap at the check-line station, where their lap will be recorded. The event concludes with the announcement of results around 6:00 PM. The event is organized to help young girl Simonka Zigová by the toRun Stará Tura running club. It is a charitable, community, and fundraising event with online registration available.

name: Tatry charity run
location: Relax Park Jazierko, Tatranská Lomnica, Slovakia
organizer: Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, mesto Vysoké Tatry, TANAP

description: Tatry Charity Run is a running event organized in Tatranská Lomnica, at Relax Park Jazierko. The course mainly runs on asphalt and paved terrain, ensuring a comfortable run for all participants. The race is open to the general public and offers categories for men and women of various age groups. The organizers are the Sports Foundation Kotrmelec, the town of Vysoké Tatry, and TANAP, who ensure the smooth running of the event. Registration is available online with a limit of 300 runners, and on-site registration on the day of the race is also possible.
course_highlights: 80% asphalt and paved terrain
Start and finish at Relax Park Jazierko, Tatranská Lomnica
Categories for men and women of different age groups
additional: Maximum online registration capacity is 300 runners. If capacity is not filled, on-site registration on the day of the event is possible at a price of €30. Categories are divided by age and gender. The course is 80% asphalt and paved. Registration is possible online until June 15, 2026. The maximum number of participants is 300.

name: Beh k Iliašovskej kapličke
price_range: 10,00 € (5 € pre obyvateľov Iliašoviec, deti do 12 rokov zadarmo)
description: The run to Iliašovská Chapel is a running event held in Iliašovce at the FK56 football field. The race offers two main routes of 5.6 km and 10.8 km, which mainly lead through field and forest paths. The race starts at 10:00 AM for the main category and at 1:00 PM for children. The event is suitable for a wide age range of runners, including children, and offers a pleasant atmosphere in nature.
course_highlights: Mainly field and forest paths
Two main routes: 5.6 km and 10.8 km
Start at FK56 football field in Iliašovce
additional: Children's start is at 1:00 PM. Categories are divided by age and gender for both routes. Contact the organizer: Mgr. Ladislav Petrek, phone: 0901 712 711. The route goes through field and forest paths; registration is possible by phone at 0901 712 711 or by email at info@bik.sk.
