description: Domašská desiatka at Eve is a traditional running race held in the recreational area of Domaša, Eva near Vranov nad Topľou. The race offers courses of 5 km and 10 km, which are part of the Vranov nad Topľou district championships in road running. Runners can enjoy a course with refreshment stations, and after finishing, they receive a starter pack with a medal, food, and a drink. Organizers provide medical services, and the race takes place with unlimited traffic, with each participant running at their own risk.
course_highlights: The course runs through the recreational area of Domaša, Eva
There are 3 refreshment stations on the 5 km course and 6 on the 10 km course
Vranov nad Topľou district championships in road running for 5 km and 10 km
additional: Registration takes place on the day of the race from 7:00 to 9:45 in the recreational area of Domaša, Eva near Pizzeria Palermo. Each runner must wear a non-transferable bib number on their chest. After the last runner finishes around 12:15, refreshments will be available at the finish line (food, large Kofola or large beer). Category winners will receive material prizes and symbolic trophies. The course is 90% asphalt and 10% unpaved; the race is scheduled for July 5, 2026; registration is possible online or on-site for a higher fee.

name: VII. Csillagok útján… éjszakai futás
description: The VII. Starry Night Run is a special night run event held at the Platán Beach in Balatonboglár, where runners and walkers are expected on July 11th in the summer Balaton lakeside environment. The new location offers the advantage of a wider start-finish corridor, a solid paved surface throughout, and full lighting along the route. Participants can choose from distances of 3.5 km, 7 km, and 10.5 km, as well as walking and a 500-meter distance for children. The event warmly welcomes all ages and running levels to experience the magic of night running together.
course_highlights: Balatonboglár Platán Beach in a beautiful Balaton lakeside setting
Wide start-finish corridor and solid paved surface
Full lighting along the entire route ensuring a safe night run
additional: Walking is also an option for the 3.5 km distance, and children can compete over 500 meters. Full route lighting ensures safe night running. The new location features a wider start-finish corridor and a solid paved surface. The event is part of Balaton's summer activities, and the organizers aim to increase interest in active leisure activities in the region.

name: DRÁVA FÉLMARATON
location: Barcs, Városháza, Barcs, Somogy County, Hungary
description: The Dráva Half Marathon is a traditional 21-kilometer running race held between Barcs and Heresznye, now in its fifth edition. Participants from several counties take part in the race, which is divided into separate categories for men and women. The route is diverse, and in previous years, record times have been set, demonstrating the race's seriousness and popularity. The event is organized by the local Dráva Running Club and the Heresznye municipality, providing a friendly yet competitive atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer distance between Barcs and Heresznye
Diverse route allowing for record times
Participants from six counties
additional: The event also features multiple sports, including running, hiking, and cycling, and races are generally held in July between Barcs and Heresznye.

name: KÖCSI-TÓ FUTÓVERSENY
description: The Köcsi Lake Running Race is a traditional, family-friendly running event near Balatonalmádi-Káptalanfüred, around the picturesque Köcsi Lake. The race warmly welcomes all who wish to run or walk, allowing participants to enjoy the proximity of nature and the community sports experience. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sport and Environmental Protection Association, which is committed to sports and environmental protection. The race offers multiple distances, so everyone can find a suitable challenge.
course_highlights: Nature-close running track around Köcsi Lake
Family-friendly, community atmosphere
Multiple distances for different age groups
additional: Results are available for 1 km, 6 km, and 12 km distances, categorized by age groups. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sport and Environmental Protection Association, which also supports several health and environmental projects. Participants can access photos on the website. Multiple distances for children and adults, refreshment stations, beach bathing options, finisher medals.

name: Nízkotatranská stíhačka
description: Nízkotatranská stíhačka (NTS) is an ultra trail race for individuals with a main course of 98 km leading from Telgárt to Donovaly across the main ridge of the Low Tatras and a half-distance route ending at Čertovica. The race is a qualifying event for Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc and is ITRA certified. It is organized by the civic association Time Out - OZ in cooperation with STS HIKING and Slovak Ultratrail. NTS offers a challenging mountain course with beautiful views and challenges for experienced mountain runners.
course_highlights: Main route of 98.5 km runs along the main ridge of the Low Tatras from Telgárt to Donovaly
Half-distance route of 49 km ending at the Čertovica mountain pass
Challenging mountain terrain with beautiful views and control points
additional: Participant registration is on Friday, July 10, 2026, from 18:00 to 22:00 at ZŠ Telgárt, where the briefing also takes place. The race starts on Saturday, July 11, 2026, at 06:00 from Telgárt. The organizer provides luggage transport (drop bags). The participant limit is 200. To register for the main route, qualification requirements must be met. During the race, control points and refreshments are provided. NTS is part of the Slovak Ultra Trail and is ITRA certified. The race is intended for experienced ultramarathon runners, with online registration and qualification criteria. The event also includes shorter routes of 49 km, and the race takes place on July 11 and 12, 2026.

name: Rozbehni Majerovce
description: Run Majerovce is a running event held in the village of Majerovce, Vranov nad Topľou district, in front of the Municipal Office. The race offers categories for children and adults with main runs of 5 km and 10 km. The start of the children's categories is at 09:15 and the main race at 10:15. The organizer is Martin Folenta together with the village of Majerovce, who warmly invite runners of all age groups for a pleasant sports day.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the village of Majerovce in front of the Municipal Office
Main courses are 5 km and 10 km for adults
Separate categories for children with their own start
additional: The start of the children's categories is at 09:15, the main race begins at 10:15. Categories are divided by age and gender, including men and women in various age groups. Registration on site is possible with an increased entry fee. The races start at 09:15 and 10:15, the course likely runs along local roads, registration is available online and on-site.

name: Beh Rajeckou dolinou KL Auto
location: Námestie SNP Rajecké Teplice, Rajecké Teplice, Slovakia
description: Run through the Rajecka Valley KL Auto is a running event set in the picturesque environment of the Rajecka Valley, offering a combination of asphalt and trail paths. The course mainly runs on trail paths with approximately 20% asphalt surface, creating a pleasant and diverse running experience. The event is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere, attracting runners of various levels. The start is at SNP Square in Rajecke Teplice, and the organizer is Ján Valúch ml., who is available for information and support.
course_highlights: The course consists of 20% asphalt roads and 80% trail paths
Start at SNP Square in Rajecke Teplice
Picturesque environment of the Rajecka Valley
additional: The registration fee is €12 for online registration and €20 on the day of the event. The organizer is Ján Valúch ml., reachable at phone number 0904 255 310 and email valuch.jan@gmail.com. The event is part of a sports day in Rajecke Teplice, featuring a beautiful course and a great atmosphere.

name: Beh malý Caesar
location: Námestie SNP, Rajecké Teplice, Žilina, Slovakia
description: The St. Andrew's Run and the Little Caesar Children's Run are traditional events in Rajecké Teplice, bringing a sports and family atmosphere to SNP Square. The St. Andrew's Run is an asphalt race over a 4.5 km course with online registration, while the Little Caesar Children's Run is intended for children aged 1 to 9 years and is free of charge. The event also features a competition for the best-decorated children's stroller, enriching the overall experience for participants and spectators. The event takes place in the afternoon with registration and start at the square.
course_highlights: Asphalt course 4.5 km long for St. Andrew's Run
Children's categories for age groups 1-3, 4-6, and 7-9 years
Competition for the best-decorated children's stroller directly on the square
additional: Registration for St. Andrew's Run is from 14:30 to 16:30, with the start at 17:00. For the Little Caesar Children's Run, registration is from 14:00 in the foyer of the Municipal Office. The number of spots for the children's run is limited to 150. The event takes place at SNP Square in Rajecké Teplice. The children's run is open to all age groups, with online or on-site registration; the event is suitable for the whole family.

name: LÁZBÉRCI SRI CHINMOY MARATON
location: Lázbérci Természetvédelmi Terület, Lázbérc, Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén, Hungary
description: The Lázbérci Sri Chinmoy Marathon is a nationwide running event in Hungary, held in the spirit of Sri Chinmoy, the peace philosopher. The race traditionally offers the experience of running close to nature and provides participants with a unique opportunity to experience physical and spiritual harmony. Runners can test their strength and endurance on diverse terrains in a scenic environment. The event has a friendly, family-like atmosphere, and all running enthusiasts are warmly welcomed.
course_highlights: Close-to-nature, diverse terrain
Scenic environment in the Lázbérci landscape
Organized in the spirit of peace philosopher Sri Chinmoy
additional: The event will be held in 2026, and the organizers aim to unite the community of peace and running.

name: Malý Štrbský maratón
organizer: Obec Štrba, Obec Liptovská Teplička, Športový klub Štrba
price_range: 20,- € to 25,- € depending on registration date, free for some categories
description: The Small Štrbský Marathon is a traditional running race held annually on the second Sunday of July in the village of Štrba under the Tatras. Participants can choose between two main routes - 31 km and 10 km, which run along an asphalt road between Štrba and Liptovská Teplička. The event is part of the Tatry v pohybe project and attracts runners from several countries, with the atmosphere in the square in front of the Cultural House always lively and sports-oriented. The organizers are the municipality of Štrba, the municipality of Liptovská Teplička, and the Štrba Sports Club.
course_highlights: 31 km route along a third-class asphalt road from Štrba to Liptovská Teplička and back
Refreshment stations at 8, 12, 16, 20, 25, and 28 kilometers
10 km route introduced as a new feature from 2021
additional: The participant limit is 500 runners overall, with priority given to the 31 km route (limit 200) and the 10 km route (limit 300). The race takes place without traffic restrictions, so increased caution is required. Medical support is provided by the Tatra Mountain Rescue Service, NsP Poprad, and the local Red Cross. Participants run at their own risk. The organizer arranges transportation from selected train connections from Tatranská Štrba. The route includes 48 km, 10 km, and children's races; it is part of the Eastern Slovak Youth Running League; registration has set dates and age categories; Nordic Walking is part of the event.

name: LUSSONIUM TRAIL
description: The Lussonium Trail is a trail running race held among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering stunning panoramic views, challenging ascents, and a friendly, family-like atmosphere. The race caters to both children and adults across multiple distances, with unique finisher medals that can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal. The start/finish point is located at the Lussonium Ruin Garden, where parking, restrooms, a playground, and a first aid station are available. The race is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to earn points and exchange them for rewards.
course_highlights: Stunning panoramic views among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd
Challenging terrain with steep ascents
Exciting start and finish location at the Lussonium Ruin Garden
additional: The race will be held with a minimum of 100 valid registrations and accepts up to 400 runners, including a maximum of 100 in the preschool and elementary school categories. Parking, restrooms, a playground, and a first aid station are available on site. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal. Registration without a medal is also possible at a lower cost. The race is a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program. Medals and refreshments will be available for participants, and the event has a friendly atmosphere, making it ideal for families.

name: Kordícky Extrém
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Kordícky Extrém is a challenging mountain run that takes place through the picturesque surroundings of Kordíky in the Banská Bystrica district. The course is designed for runners seeking extreme challenges in nature with significant elevation gain and technical sections. The event is part of the Marathon Tour series and offers a unique running experience in a beautiful mountain environment. Organizers welcome all runners who want to test their endurance and courage in this extreme terrain.
course_highlights: Mountain environment with significant elevation gain
Technically demanding sections on natural trails
Picturesque views of the Kordíky area
additional: Several categories and registration options including online and in person, the event is associated with a large social gathering with food and entertainment.

name: Mesciské pancaky
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Mestisko, okres Svidník, Slovakia
description: Mesciské Pancaky is a running event in Mesciské, Svidník district, offering courses of 5 km and 10 km without age restrictions for men and women. The course mainly runs on asphalt, with sections on grassy areas and field roads, providing a varied surface for runners. The race starts at the football pitch in Mesciské. Registration is available online or on-site at the event.
course_highlights: Surface: 60% asphalt, 20% grassy area, 20% field road
Two categories: 5 km and 10 km with no age restrictions
Start at the football pitch in Mesciské
additional: Categories are open to all ages for both men and women. The start location is the football pitch in Mesciské. The course surface is a combination of asphalt, grass, and terrain. The event is open to all age groups, with registration available online and on-site, and the course features a mix of asphalt, grass, and terrain.

name: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra
location: Hrabovo, Národný park Veľká Fatra, Slovakia
description: Run the Veľká Fatra trail race in the Veľká Fatra National Park, offering runners unforgettable views of the Low Tatras, forest single trails, and special forest roads. The routes pass through the UNESCO site Vlkolínec and include a cable car and Sidorovo. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races, where runners earn points based on performance and race length. There are three routes with different distances and elevation gains, suitable for various levels of runners.
course_highlights: Unforgettable views of the Low Tatras
Forest single trails and special forest roads
The route passes through the UNESCO site Vlkolínec
additional: The course includes speed sections called Conti Speed Section over 150 meters, marked with Continental flags. Runners can earn points for the UTMB Index Races based on performance and race length. The routes have different elevation gains: 730 m for 18 km, 405 m for 11 km, and 267 m for 5 km. The courses are mainly on soft natural surfaces. The race is part of a series supporting environmental and charitable projects, with details on registration, entry fees, and accompanying activities available on the official website.

name: FUTABUDA a Dunakanyarban
description: The FUTABUDA in the Danube Bend is a self-funded, non-profit running race scheduled for Sunday, July 19, 2026, at 10:00 AM in Dunabogdány. The race offers two challenging distances: 6.1 km with 205 meters of elevation gain and 14 km with 356 meters of elevation gain. Runners receive a unique, metal finisher medal measuring 60x60 mm, and the top performers are awarded in both age categories and overall. The race is part of the Ötpróba series but is independent of it, and on-site registration modifications are available. The participation is limited to a maximum of 200 runners.
course_highlights: 6.1 km distance with 205 m elevation gain
14 km distance with 356 m elevation gain
Unique, 60x60 mm metal finisher medal
additional: Registration is also possible on-site with an increased fee. The distance can be changed before the start, but only those who do not change it during the race will be listed in the results. There is no time limit for the race. During registration, participants must provide their year of birth, chosen distance, and if available, their race bib number from home. Those without a bib will receive a paper bib. Participants' names will appear on the start and results lists, and photos and videos taken during the event may be used on the website. Two distances, elevation differences, awards, age categories, unique metal finisher medals, online and on-site registration, limited to 200 participants.

name: FUTABUDA
description: The FUTABUDA is a running race held in the Danube Bend, starting on Sunday, July 19, 2026, at 10:00 AM at the Dunabogdány, Kisoroszi ferry dock. The race features two distances: 6.1 km and 14 km, with significant elevation changes, posing a challenge for runners. Participants receive a unique metal finisher medal, and the top performers are awarded prizes. The event is part of the Ötpróba series but is independent of it. Registration is simple and can be done online or via email, with on-site registration available at an increased fee.
course_highlights: 6.1 km distance with +/- 205 m elevation change
14 km distance with +/- 356 m elevation change
Unique, 60x60 mm metal finisher medal for finishers
additional: At registration, participants must provide their name, year of birth, chosen distance, and optionally a bib number. The distance can be changed before the start, but only those who do not change it during the race will be listed in the results. There is no time limit. The race is a nonprofit, self-funded event with a limit of 200 participants. Prizes are awarded for breaking male and female course records, the absolute 1st to 3rd places, and the top 3 in each age category. On-site registration is available at an increased fee. Bib numbers can be collected on-site or via advance transfer after 9:30 AM. The event offers medals, prizes, and awards in various categories. Registration is possible online and on-site, providing a varied experience depending on weather conditions.

name: YOUNG RUN Nestlé
location: Námestie J. C. Hronského, Prievidza, Prievidza, Slovakia
description: YOUNG RUN Nestlé is a running event in Prievidza offering courses of 21 km, 10 km, and 5 km. Participants are divided into categories based on age and gender, with relay disciplines available for children. The race starts at Námestie J. C. Hronského with different start times depending on the course. The organizers are YOUNG RUN, Nestlé, and the City of Prievidza, ensuring a quality sports experience for all age groups.
course_highlights: Course of 21 km, 10 km, and 5 km in the center of Prievidza
Categories for different age groups including juniors and veterans
Relay races for children with circuits of 2 x 5 km and 2 x 2.5 km
additional: Race start times: 8:00 AM for 21 km, 8:15 AM for the TRUE circuit and relay, 9:20 AM for STARTIN, 9:55 AM for children. Categories are divided by age and gender with specific birth years. The organizer provides contact phone number +421915574850. The event includes VIP zones, online timing, support for people with disabilities, and 600 medals for participants.

name: Ipelský Beh
location: Lučenec - Kalonda, Hrádza na Ipli, Lučenec, Slovakia
description: Ipelský Run is a running event held in the locality of Lučenec - Kalonda, on the dam of the Ipeľ River. The course mainly runs on grass and includes a 100-meter section of an unused railway track. The race is open to various age categories of men, women, and youth, including Nordic walking. The organizers are the city of Lučenec, the municipality of Kalonda, and OZ-Novohrad, who warmly invite runners of all levels to participate in this traditional event.
course_highlights: Surface of the course mainly grass
100-meter section of an unused railway track
Location on the dam of the Ipeľ River in Lučenec - Kalonda
additional: Online registration is possible until July 18, 2025, with a discounted entry fee of €13. On-site registration will be €18, subject to available capacity. Categories are divided by age and gender, including Nordic walking for men and women. The organizer is Marian Duzbaba (tel.: 0907 146 181). The race is organized in various categories including Nordic Walking, with the possibility of online registration and races on different routes including 10 km and 6.5 km asphalt track. The event is part of the regional sports calendar and is suitable for all age groups.

name: Bančanská desiatka
description: Bančanská desiatka is a traditional running race in the Banský district of Vranov nad Topľou, held in front of the Cultural House in Banské. It is a popular sporting event with a long-standing history that attracts a record number of participants each year. The race is known for its difficulty and beautiful uphill course, organized by the Banské Sports Club. In addition to the main race, there are uphill time trials and other accompanying events.
course_highlights: Uphill run in the village of Banské - Mláčky
Traditional start in front of the Cultural House in Banské
Challenging course profile with a new course record of 14:35 minutes
additional: The organizer is the Banské Sports Club, which has a long-standing tradition since 1985. The event is held regularly, with the 30th edition of Bančanská 10/5 taking place in 2025. The event also includes uphill time trials of JANTEX Banské - Mláčky, which have their own history and categories. The race includes 10 km and 5 km relay categories, with online or on-site registration, and a rich accompanying program including an inflatable castle and performances.

name: GAJA-VÖLGY TRAIL
description: The Gaja Valley Trail is a trail running event organized by the Gaja Valley Association for the second time on July 25, 2026, in Fehérvárcsurgó, around the Károlyi Castle. Runners and hikers can choose from three different distances, with the focus not on competition but on the joy of movement, community experience, and close contact with nature. The event aims to promote running at all levels, from beginners to advanced, in a pleasant summer forest environment. The start and finish are at the visitor center of the Károlyi Castle, and the sound of the Gaja stream and the silence of the valley create a special atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Path along the castle, water reservoir, and bubbling Gaja stream
Spectacular forest trails in the Gaja Valley
The Károlyi Castle visitor center as the start and finish point
additional: The Gaja Valley Trail is not a race, with no timing, so beginners, amateurs, and hobby runners can participate. Every participant receives a finisher medal. The event has a community atmosphere, promoting a healthy lifestyle and close contact with nature. In addition to trail running, the event also features hikes and cycling endurance tours. The location is easily accessible, the terrain is varied, and rich in natural values.

name: Dobra Run a Dobrá dvojka
description: Dobra Run and Dobrá dvojka is a running event located at Domaša, Vranov nad Topľou district, offering courses of 7 km and 2 km. The race is suitable for various age categories of men and women, including children. The organizer is Matore s.r.o. Humenné and BAMM Bratislava, providing participants with a pleasant atmosphere and the opportunity to compete in different age groups. The starting fee is available online or on-site until the participant limit is reached.
course_highlights: Courses of 7 km and 2 km suitable for various age categories
Categories for men and women by age from 18 years and older
The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Domaša
additional: The starting fee can be paid online or on-site until the participant limit is reached. Categories are divided by age and gender, including children's categories. The organizer is Matore s.r.o. Humenné and BAMM Bratislava. Contact person: Ing. Dušan Matanin, phone: 0905 271 190. The race takes place in summer, with the possibility of pre-registration or on-site registration, suitable for all age groups.

name: Night city run Piešťany
description: Piešťany Night City RUN is a traditional night run held at Freedom Square in Piešťany. Participants have the opportunity to take part in a 10 km course that runs through the city and offers a unique night running atmosphere under the auspices of the Town of Piešťany. The event is open to various age categories and all participants will receive a commemorative medal. During the race, electronic timing is provided, and the ceremonial announcement of results takes place in the evening after the run.
course_highlights: Night run through Piešťany with lamp-lit atmosphere
Start and finish at Freedom Square
Electronic timing provided by SunBell s.r.o.
additional: Registration takes place from 16:30 to 19:45 at the Building of the School of Physiotherapy, Rehabilitation, and Balneology. Parking is available at Aupak and at the Catchment Parking Lot on Nálepkova Street. The first 100 runners have the lowest entry fee. After the race, there is a raffle and a ceremonial results announcement at 21:45. Children from 15 years old can run independently, younger participants need parental consent. The event is open to all runners, including children who can participate for free. The race includes a medal, refreshments, and a recommendation to use a headlamp during the run.

name: Extrém maratón Košice – Furča
description: Košice - Furča Extreme Marathon is a challenging running race organized by the O5 Running Club Furča Košice. The race takes place in the pleasant environment of Furča, where runners can enjoy the course challenges and the atmosphere of a traditional marathon. This race is intended for endurance runners seeking an extreme experience within the marathon distance. Organizers ensure quality conditions and support for all participants.
course_highlights: Challenging course in the Furča environment
Traditional marathon with an extreme character
Organized by O5 Running Club Furča Košice
additional: The marathon starts at 10:00 AM. Information about the course certification is available on the website. Registration for the Furča Marathon 2026 has closed. The course is designed for experienced runners; registration is possible until the day of the race. The event includes an ultramarathon with difficult terrain and elevation gain.

name: MONORERDEI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
location: Makkos Park, Monorierdő, Pest County, Hungary
description: The Monorierdő Running Festival is a friendly and family-oriented race held every year in Monorierdő at Makkos Park. Participants can choose from several distances, and the course starts and finishes at Makkos Park. The event's highlight is the live music refreshment point, where the band "The Little Pea" energizes the runners twice. The race aims to promote the joy of sport and movement, and everyone is warmly welcome to join the running community.
course_highlights: The race starts and ends at Makkos Park
Live music refreshment point with "The Little Pea" band
Various distances available to suit runners' preferences
additional: The train station is only 200 meters from the race venue, making it easily accessible by train. Participants are advised to choose a train that ensures timely arrival for bib pickup. The event is part of the Ötpróba series, with online registration available until July 18, and additional sports and leisure events are organized for participants related to the race.

name: Beh na chatu pod Chlebom, mem. J. Morgoša
organizer: BS TATRAN Turany, LK NÁDEJ Turany
description: The Chleb Hut Run, J. Morgoš Memorial, is a mountain running race held in the locations of Turany, Šútovo, and Zajacová. The course is 3.1 km long with an elevation gain of 680 meters and runs along mountain roads and trails. The race is part of the Turčianska Running League 2025 and is designed for various age categories of men and women. The organizers are BS TATRAN Turany, the town of Turany, and LK NÁDEJ Turany. The race offers a challenge for runners who enjoy more demanding mountain terrain.
course_highlights: Course length 3.1 km with an elevation gain of 680 m
Surface includes mountain roads and trails
Race in mountain environment Turany - Šútovo - Zajacová
additional: Categories: Juniors, Juniorettes, Men up to 40, Men up to 50, Men over 50, Men over 60, Men over 70, Women up to 35, Women over 35, Women over 50. The competition is part of the Turčianska Running League 2025. Mountain terrains, online registration or on-site registration available, categories for different age groups.

name: CSERNYE TRAIL
description: The Csernye Trail is a trail running race that will be held for the sixth time in Bakonycsernye in 2026. Participants start from the starting area next to the sports field and can choose from various distances, which lead through diverse terrain, forests, and hills. The organizers promise excellent organization and a pleasant running experience, while participants can enjoy the natural beauty of the Bakony. The race is family-friendly and recommended for both beginners and advanced runners.
course_highlights: Trail running on diverse forest and grassy routes
Beautiful views of Bakonycsernye and its surroundings
Various distances, including a strictly trail half marathon
additional: The race center has toilets, washbasins, and showers. Parking is available on the grassy area next to the football field. Technical shirts or T-shirts can be ordered at a flat rate of 4600 HUF during registration. There is a participant limit: a total of 300 people for the three longer distances, and an additional 100 for the Bulifutam. Registration for the race is open from March 12, 2026, to July 30, 2026; the start is scheduled for August 1, 2026, at 09:00. Race packets can be picked up between 07:00 and 08:30 at the venue or at the Cultural Center. Detailed routes and schedules are available on the official website.

name: ORFŰI TÓ – SHOW FUTÁS
location: Orfűi tó és strand nagyparkoló, Orfű, Baranya, Hungary
description: The Orfű Lake-Show Run is a traditional race organized by the Melitta Leisure Sports Association, held around the large parking lot near Lake and Beach in Orfű. During the race, participants must circle Lake Pécs once or twice on a public road, in the same direction as the clock, not on the promenade. The race is a family-friendly event where participation is at everyone's own risk, and both professionals and amateurs can compete. The event is supported by Barta Textile House and offers valuable prizes to runners, not only based on time results.
course_highlights: 6.2 km loop around Lake Pécs on a public road
12.4 km distance by circling Lake Pécs twice
The race takes place on the public road, not on the promenade
additional: Timing and results announcement are only available for the race, with winners awarded a trophy. Material prizes are distributed by raffle, giving all participants an equal chance. The event also serves as a family program, with well-equipped playgrounds available for children. Participants run at their own risk; the venue is around Lake Pécs and the large parking lot of the beach. The event date is August 3, 2024.

name: Bear Foot Poľana
price_range: € 1 - € 40 (podľa vlny registrácie a dostupnosti na mieste)
description: BEAR FOOT POĽANA 2026 is a mountain run set in the wild and unique environment of the Poľana mountain range, which is the highest and best-preserved volcano in Central Europe. The race offers two main courses: 24 km with a cumulative ascent of over 1300 meters and 10 km with over 600 meters of elevation gain. The route passes through tourist-attractive sites such as the Bystrô Waterfall, the Celtic hillfort Kaľamárka, and the Predná Poľana peak, allowing runners to enjoy the beauty of deep forests, mountain streams, and pastures. The race is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association league and is limited to 150 runners for each course.
course_highlights: 24 km course with over 1300 m of cumulative ascent passing through Bystrô Waterfall and the Celtic hillfort Kaľamárka
10 km course with over 600 m of ascent, start and finish at the Mountain Hotel Poľana
Surface of the course is a combination of hiking trails, forest roads, and mountain meadows
additional: Check-in for participants is from 7:30 to 9:30; late registration is not possible. Throughout the course, it is mandatory to use a bell or a rattle. There are three refreshment stations at 4.4 km, 10 km, and 15 km. The registration fee includes refreshments during and after the race, a unique start number, a participant package, and timing services. The limit for participants is 150 for each course. The race covers 24 km with over 1300 meters of elevation gain, with a participant limit of 150, and is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League. Registration is limited. The race will take place on August 1, 2026.

name: Porubska 11-ka
description: Porúbska 11-ka is a running race held in the village of Porúbka in the Bardejov district, characterized by a slightly hilly, upland to flat terrain at an altitude of 196 meters. The course runs through the Carpathian mountain range area, offering a combination of plains and hills, ideal for runners seeking a pleasant and natural run. The race is organized by the village of Porúbka and is part of local sports activities with a tradition and community spirit. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Slightly hilly, upland to flat surface
Altitude of 196 meters
The route passes through the Carpathian mountain range area
additional: The race takes place on August 1, 2026; registration is possible via Google Forms; the routes lead through nature around Porúbka; the event is supported by the local community and sports enthusiasts.

name: Island Gladiator Slovakia
description: Island Gladiator Slovakia is an OCR race that tests your strength, endurance, and determination in the authentic natural environment of Slovakia. The course runs through meadows, forests, streams, and hills with various technical sections and obstacles such as walls, crawling, pulling, balancing, and carrying loads. The race is open to men and women, beginners and experienced athletes, with a time limit of 3 hours. Each participant receives an official T-shirt, medal, start package, and electronic timing. Island Gladiator is not just a competition but a challenge to overcome oneself and become a stronger gladiator.
course_highlights: The course runs through meadows, forests, streams, and hills
Technical sections with obstacles such as walls, crawling, pulling, balancing, and carrying loads
Time limit of 3 hours to complete the course
additional: Each participant receives an official T-shirt, a unique medal, electronic timing, a start package with surprises from partners, hydration, and refreshments at the finish line or on the course. Failing to overcome an obstacle results in a penalty of 20 burpees or a penalty lap. External assistance is only permitted with the organizers' consent. The race starts at 09:00 in waves, registration is possible through their website, and early discounts are available.

name: KERESZTÚRI ÖNTÚLSZÁRNYALÁS FESZTIVÁL
description: The Keresztúr Overachievement Running Festival is a family-friendly race that combines the closeness of nature with the spirit of surpassing oneself. The race takes place in the Keresztúr Forest near Budapest and offers challenging distances including 5.2 km, 10.5 km, half marathon, 31.6 km, and marathon, as well as the special Yes, I can! event. This event is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has been supporting running enthusiasts since 1977. The goal of the race is for every participant to experience sports camaraderie and the joy of exceeding their limits.
course_highlights: Keresztúr Forest, nature-close running track
Forest nature trail and running circuit with short road sections
Yes, I can! race with hourly starts, approximately 5,274 m per lap
additional: On-site registration is available on race day between 6:30 and 7:30. The registration fee does not include a T-shirt, but there is an option to pre-order a commemorative technical T-shirt. The Yes, I can! race consists of 6 laps, with starts every hour; the lap starting at 13:00 focuses on surpassing oneself. Participants support each other in completing the race, and late starts will result in disqualification. Multiple distances are available for participation, and registration on-site is possible. Detailed fee and T-shirt information can be found on the organizer's website.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 8. kolo
description: The 2-Mile Run Bratislava is a regular running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. The race covers a distance of 2 miles (3.218 km) with categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place directly on-site from 9:30 AM, and the start is at 10:00 AM. The competition is part of a series where runners earn points towards the Traveling Cup based on their performances and participation in each round.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.218 km)
Presentation and start near the volleyball court at the Kuchajda complex
Categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans
additional: Registration is on-site at the volleyball court from 9:30 AM. The competition for the Traveling Cup of the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team awards points based on performances and participation. In case of a tie in points, the best time is the deciding factor, followed by shoe size. Children have a separate category with a shorter distance of approximately 200 meters. The race takes place on a public road at Kuchajda, with on-site registration also possible. The start is scheduled for 10:00 AM. There is also a category for children with shorter distances.

name: Malý Kavečianský maratón
organizer: TJ Mladosť Kavečany a MÚ MČ Košice - Kavečany
price_range: 21 km: 15,- € online, 20,- € na mieste; 7 km: 12,- € online, 17,- € na mieste; zadarmo pre ženy nad 60 rokov a mužov nad 70 rokov
description: The Small Kavečiansky Marathon is a running event in Kavečany near Košice, offering courses of 21 km and 7 km, as well as children's runs. The race starts at the football stadium and is designed for a wide range of categories from children to veterans. The organizer is TJ Mladosť Kavečany in cooperation with the City District of Košice - Kavečany. The event is suitable for runners of various age groups and performance levels, with registration fees available at affordable prices and the possibility of online registration.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the football stadium in Kavečany
Courses of 21 km and 7 km suitable for different age groups
Children's runs starting at 9:10 AM
additional: Women over 60 years and men over 70 years have free registration. Categories include children's, pupil, youth, absolute, and age groups for men and women. Children's runs start at 9:10 AM. The course includes city streets and the football stadium; online registration until August 1, 2025; start at 9:00 AM for all categories.

name: JAZZFŐVÁROS-FUTÁS
description: The Jazz Capital Run in Kecskemét is held at the Zoltán Benkó Leisure Center and offers a running experience as a sporty addition to the jazz festival. The event traditionally emphasizes the joy of running and community experience, open to all age groups and running types. The race is not only a sports event but also strengthens the local community, allowing participants to move in a beautiful environment with fresh air. The organizers also value charity, making the run an opportunity for support.
course_highlights: Runs take place in a beautiful natural environment under lovely trees
The race is a sporting side event of the jazz festival
The run is also a community and charity event
additional: The event is open to everyone, with community programs and charity actions connected to it alongside the run. Runners can enjoy movement in a pleasant natural environment with good air quality. Multiple distances are available for participation, with online or on-site registration. Participants receive a T-shirt with the race logo and snacks and mineral water at the finish line. The festival programs are free for runners.

name: Východniarska

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Poplatok za štart jedného účastníka je 70 EUR

description: Východniarska is a mountain ultra trail and long-distance walk for individuals, following the popular Východniarska Hundred. The route runs through the eastern part of the Slovenské Rudohorie mountains, mainly through the Volovské Vtáky, and offers a challenging 85 km run with an elevation gain of +4200 m. The start is in Kluknava and the finish in Kysak, with a time limit of 22 hours. The event is open to the public for participants aged 18 and over and requires proper registration and payment of the start fee.
course_highlights: 85 km long route with +4200 m elevation gain
Crossing the Volovské Vtáky in the Slovenské Rudohorie
Control and refreshment stations along the route with time limits
additional: Registration for competitors is on Thursday in Košice from 16:00 to 20:00 and on Friday, August 7, 2026, from 18:00 to 23:00 at the Biela Dama Čierny Rytier Hotel Castle. Before the start, there is an option to stay overnight in the gymnasium at the Elementary School in Kluknava; participants should bring their own sleeping mats and sleeping bags. Dropbags can be sent to the refreshment station at Vyšný Klátov (56 km), which are handed over on the morning of the race before 8:30 in the elementary school gym in Kluknava. Transportation to Kluknava is available by train and bus; it is recommended to arrive by train to Margeciany and then take a bus to Kluknava. The route is 85 km long with a 22-hour time limit, mandatory equipment including an emergency blanket, GPS, personal cup, and others; dropbags can be sent to the 56 km station. The event also offers the possibility to stay overnight in the gymnasium and transportation by train or bus to Kluknava.

name: Rajecký In-line polmaratón
description: The Rajeck Inline Half Marathon is a competitive inline skating race held in Rajecká on SNP Square. The course runs from Rajecká to Čičmany and back, with the finish line at the marathon turnaround in Čičmany. Participants are required to wear a helmet throughout the race and to have rented chips, which must be returned at the finish line. The organizer provides refreshments, changing rooms, showers, and free transportation back to Rajecká for inline skaters. The final stretch of the finish line is reserved for runners, so participants must respect the organizer's rules.
course_highlights: The course runs from Rajecká to Čičmany and back
Races are held on the right lane of the road
The final finish stretch on SNP Square in Rajecká is reserved for runners
additional: Participants must wear a helmet and have a start number attached to their right thigh during the race. Rented chips must be returned at the finish line. Refreshments (sandwiches) are provided on the square in Rajecká based on the start number. Changing rooms and showers are available at the gym on Lipová Street. A minibus for personal belongings will be available from 8:00 to 8:30 at the start area. Inline skaters must use the free bus back from Čičmany to Rajecká and are not allowed to enter the start and finish areas designated for runners; violation may result in disqualification. The race has a limit of 120 participants, registration depends on the payment date, and fees vary according to the registration period.

name: Rajecká štafeta
description: The Rajeck Relay is a running event organized by the Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is a relay race that is part of the Rajecký Marathon and offers athletes the opportunity to compete in teams. The organizer provides race bibs, timing, and complete care for participants during the race. The event is suitable for runners of various levels and promotes community spirit and sports enthusiasm in the region.
course_highlights: Relay categories for men, women, and mixed teams
Takes place at SNP Square in Rajec, in the picturesque surroundings of Žilina
Registration is paid, with prices ranging from 90 to 120 euros depending on the registration period
additional: The organizer processes participants' personal data in accordance with GDPR and the personal data protection law. Registration is conducted online via the organizer's website. Participants receive race bibs upon check-in, and their results are published on official websites and sports portals. relay race, registration fees increase closer to the event date, terrain details not specified

name: SZUFLA FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The SZUFLA Running Festival is a traditional community running event organized annually by the Szigethalmi Ultrafutók Lelkes Alakulata on the second weekend of August. The 2026 anniversary, the 20th running festival, will be held in Tököl Park Forest, featuring a variety of distances including ultramarathon, relay, half marathon, shorter runs, and hiking. The race has a friendly atmosphere, and in addition to runners, many programs await children. The event aims to promote sports and support the local community, with a special focus on helping people with disabilities.
course_highlights: 6.178 km loop course in Tököl Park Forest, with 30 meters of elevation gain
Relay race over 52 km with 2-4 person teams
Refreshment points every 3 km with a generous selection
additional: The race features chip timing, with a chip deposit fee of 2000 HUF, which is refundable at the finish or can be donated to charity. Starts are staggered, with on-site registration beginning at 7:00 AM on race day. Several children's programs are available, including face painting, glitter tattoos, creative corner, and bouncy castle. The race closes at 3:00 PM, which is also the cutoff time. Refreshment points are located every 3 km with a wide selection. Participants can register online or on-site; the event includes ultramarathon, half marathon, and shorter distances. The festival emphasizes community and love for sport.

name: Beh na Kráľovu studňu
location: Motorest Javorina Lenartov, Lenartov, Bardejov, Slovakia
description: The Run to Kráľova Studňa is a traditional uphill race held in the picturesque surroundings of the village of Lenartov near the historic Kráľova Studňa, the meeting place of the three kings. The course takes you through beautiful nature and offers a unique mountain terrain running experience with rich history and scenic views. The event is part of the local mountain running league and attracts runners from the entire region. Organizers create a friendly atmosphere and welcome all participants regardless of performance.
course_highlights: Uphill run in mountain terrain around Kráľova Studňa
Historic meeting place of the Hungarian and Polish kings
Beautiful views and natural scenery around Lenartov
additional: The run is part of the Eastern Slovakian mountain running league. The event has a long-standing tradition; in 2025, it held its 14th edition, and in 2024, its 13th. The atmosphere is friendly, and all runners are welcome, including the oldest participants. After the run, refreshments and a cultural program are provided nearby. The course includes asphalt, forest, and mountain sections; registration is available online or on-site; part of the Eastern Slovakian mountain running league 2025.

name: Chminianskonovovesský beh
location: Futbalové ihrisko OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves, Chminianska Nová Ves, Prešov, Slovakia
organizer: ThLic. Mgr. Pavol Uličný a obec Chminianska Nova Ves
description: Chminianskonovovesský run is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Chminianska Nová Ves and ThLic. Mgr. Pavol Uličný. The race takes place at the OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves football pitch in the Prešov district and offers categories for different age groups of men, women, and youth. It is a community sports event that promotes an active lifestyle and sports enthusiasm in the region.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves football pitch
Categories for men, women, and youth according to age
Organized by the municipality of Chminianska Nová Ves and Pavol Uličný
additional: The race is held on August 15, 2026, starting at 18:00, registration on-site, refreshments and food provided after the race.

name: Runica Nevoľné
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Nevoľné, Žiar nad Hronom, Slovakia
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Runica Nevoľné is a running event held at the football field in Nevoľné, Žiar nad Hronom district. The race offers a unique experience in the heart of Slovakia, where runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization. The course is suitable for runners of various levels and the event is part of the Marathon Tour running series. Organizers welcome all runners who want to experience sporting enjoyment in a beautiful environment.
course_highlights: The course runs around the football field in Nevoľné
Pleasant environment in the Žiar nad Hronom district
Part of the Marathon Tour running series
additional: Registration is possible online and in person, the event takes place at the football field in Nevoľné, and includes mountain trail and children's race.

name: Štafetový beh 345 km od Tatier k Dunaju Jasná – Bratislava
location: Demänovská dolina, Jasná, Liptovský Mikuláš, Žilina, Slovakia
description: The Tatras to Danube relay race is the largest relay race in Slovakia, covering a distance of 345 km. Teams consisting of 6 or 9 to 12 members start in Jasná in the Low Tatras and run nonstop through day and night to finish on the banks of the Danube in Bratislava. The course is mostly asphalt with a total elevation gain of approximately 3990 meters and a descent of 4870 meters. Runners complete 36 segments of varying lengths and difficulty, with each member of a 12-person team running three segments. The race is a challenge for team spirit and endurance in the beautiful environment of Slovakia.
course_highlights: Distance of 346 km with an elevation gain of approx. +3990 m and -4870 m
95% of the course is on asphalt, roads of class 2 and 3
36 segments ranging from 7 to 12 km with varying difficulty
additional: Teams can have 6 or 9 to 12 members. In a 12-member team, each runner completes 3 segments spaced 8-10 hours apart, totaling about 30 km over two days. The organizer provides detailed segment characteristics including maps, elevation profiles, and descriptions for runners and motor vehicles. The team captain registers as a user and represents the entire team. The race runs nonstop day and night. The course is 345 km, starting in Demänovská Dolina, with the race being nonstop for team groups, scheduled for August 2026. Registration is divided by categories and dates, with different fees.

name: SÁRKÁNYFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The Dragon Run is an exciting running race organized by Tata Mass Sport and Tájfutó Honvéd Sports Club. The race is a trail run on a varied and challenging route that combines the proximity of nature with the sport experience. The event has a friendly atmosphere, is open to all ages, and also strengthens the community experience among runners. The race takes place in Súr, Hungary, and the organizers place great emphasis on smooth execution and participant satisfaction.
course_highlights: Trail running on a varied, nature-close route
Challenging sections and diverse terrain
Friendly, community-oriented race
additional: The race is part of county running competitions, with categories in trail running and trail races, on various distances.

name: Jazerný maratón
description: Lake Marathon is a running challenge held in Košice on the Nad Jazerom housing estate, offering courses from 5 to 42 km. The race takes place on a 2.5 km section along the Hornád River dyke with a quality asphalt surface and minimal elevation gain, making the course suitable for runners of various levels. The event has a 15-year tradition and is ideal for those seeking a fast and enjoyable run in nature close to the city. Organizers welcome all runners who want to test their strength over different distances.
course_highlights: 2.5 km loop along the Hornád River dyke
Quality asphalt surface
Minimal elevation gain suitable for fast running
additional: Option to choose a course length from 5 km up to the marathon distance of 42 km. The course runs along the dyke with minimal elevation gain, allowing for a fast and comfortable run. The event takes place on August 16, 2026, registration is available online, and it is suitable for recreational and competitive runners.

name: Cestou Grófa Júliusa Andrássyho
description: The Count of Gróf Július Andrássy Run takes place in Trebišov at the City Cultural Center and offers various categories including running, summer walk, cycling, Nordic walking, and a virtual race. The start is scheduled for August 21, 2026, at 16:15 for children and at 16:25 for the main category. The event is suitable for all age groups, including children up to 7 years old and older children up to 13 years old. The organizer is Ing. Michal Majcher, who ensures a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization of the race.
course_highlights: Start and finish location at the City Cultural Center in Trebišov
Multiple categories including running, walking, cycling, and Nordic walking
Virtual race as a new feature for participants outside the event location
additional: The registration fee is paid on-site. Categories include children up to 7 years old, children 8-13 years old, the main category, summer walk, cycling, Nordic walking, and a virtual race with the option to purchase a medal. The event includes several categories, including children and virtual races. Registration is possible on-site, and the course is situated around the cultural center in Trebišov.

description: The Keszthely Kilometers is a traditional running race on the shores of Lake Balaton, scheduled to take place on August 22-23, 2026, in the rear park of the Festetics Castle. Participants can choose from several distances, ranging from 3 km to half marathon, in individual and relay categories. Additionally, children's races are available for the youngest participants, with different distances for each age group. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and the Balaton lakeside environment offers a unique experience for runners.
course_highlights: Takes place on the shores of Lake Balaton, in the rear park of Festetics Castle
Distances from 3 km to half marathon, individual and relay races
Children's races for different age groups, family-friendly program
additional: The race office is located on-site, by Lake Balaton, at the Mole, where bib pickup and on-site registration are also available. A separate registration desk is available for children's races. Participants are advised to arrive in good time due to traffic restrictions and parking difficulties. Children's races are held at different distances for each age group, and the youngest can participate with parental supervision. Results are announced after each race. The event features multiple distances, children's and adult races, relay races, on-site registration, parking and traffic restrictions, and weather-dependent start times.

name: Rusínska 100 a 66
description: Rusínska 100 and 66 is a late summer ultramarathon and long-distance walk with start and finish in the town of Stropkov. The routes lead through the Ondava Uplands in the Zemplín region and continue into the Šariš region via the town of Svidník, passing through the area of Rusyn villages and along the border with Poland. The R100 route partly passes through the protected landscape area of the Eastern Carpathians. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League and is certified by ITRA, included among the races of the ITRA National League. The organizer is o.z. Klub bežcov Stropkov, which ensures warm hospitality and quality organization.
course_highlights: Routes lead through the Ondava Uplands and across the northern part of the Low Beskids
Passage through the protected landscape area of the Eastern Carpathians
Region with historic sacral buildings, lookout towers, and cultural monuments
additional: The event takes place on August 23-24, 2025. Rusínska 100 and 66 are part of the 11th edition of the Slovak Ultratrail League. The routes are designed for ultramarathon runners and long-distance hikers, passing through challenging terrain rich in history and natural beauty. Organizers and volunteers provide warm hospitality and quality support for participants. The routes mainly follow forest and trail paths, with several sections of asphalt; registration is open from May 1 to September 20, 2025; the event emphasizes the natural beauty and historical monuments of the region.

name: Hradný gaštanový beh Modrý Kameň

description: The Castle Chestnut Run at Modrý Kameň is a running event held in the park in front of the entrance to Modrý Kameň Castle. The race offers various categories including a hobby race for children and juniors over 5 km, the main race for adults over 10 km, and Nordic walking over 5 km. The course runs on asphalt, meadows, forest, and field roads, providing a diverse and enjoyable running experience. The organizer is the town of Modrý Kameň in cooperation with the civic association Bežci VK. The start for children is at 10:00 AM, and for adults at 11:00 AM.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt, meadows, forest, and field roads
The race takes place in the park in front of Modrý Kameň Castle
Various categories including hobby, juniors, and Nordic walking
additional: A 50% discount on the entry fee for the age category 60 years and older. Registration on site is possible at least 30 minutes before the start of the main race and Nordic walking with an additional fee of 17 euros. The course includes asphalt, meadows, forest, and field roads; categories for children, hobby runners, and competitive runners; starts at 10:00 AM and 11:00 AM.

description: The Čachtice Half Marathon is a traditional half marathon race taking place on August 22, 2026, in the village of Čachtice. The course mainly runs on asphalt through the streets of Čachtice to Višňové and Hrachovište, with a short section on a forest trail. The profile of the course is slightly hilly with a maximum elevation of 90 meters. The start is at the town square in Čachtice and the finish is in the area of the Elementary School in Čachtice. Refreshment stations are provided at several points along the course.
course_highlights: Asphalt surface with a short section of forest trail
Slightly hilly profile with a maximum elevation of 90 m
Refreshments at 6 km, 10.5 km, 12 km, 15 km, and at the finish
additional: The maximum number of participants for the half marathon is 250, and for relay teams a maximum of 10 relays. The relay race is a separate category for teams of 3-4 members. Participant registration is on the day of the race from 06:30 to 08:30 at the area of the Čachtice Elementary School. Prizes include monetary awards for 1st to 3rd place in categories and a raffle tombola based on starting numbers. Online registration is available until August 20, 2025. The maximum number of participants is 250, and the race features multiple control points with refreshments.

name: Forbaský beh pomoci
location: areál Ščava, Forbasy, okres Stará Ľubovňa, Slovakia
description: Forbaský Run of Help is a charitable running race held at the Ščava area in Forbasky, Stará Ľubovňa district. It is an event with voluntary entry fee that supports aid and solidarity. Runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere while contributing to a good cause. The organizer is Valer Kuffa, who is available for information and participant support.
course_highlights: Race held at the Ščava area in Forbasky
Charitable run with voluntary entry fee
Enjoyable atmosphere and support for aid
additional: The entry fee is a voluntary contribution, details at https://www.behpomoci.sk/fbp-2025/dobrovo%C4%BEn%C3%BD-pr%C3%ADspevok. The organizer is Valer Kuffa, phone: +421 949 765 543. Race categories for different age groups, registration via voluntary donation.

description: Lukačovská 5 is a running race held on a football field in Lukačovce, Humenné district. The race offers a main 5 km run and children's runs, with categories divided into men, women, and a non-competitive Nordic Walking category. The organizer is the municipality of Lukačovce, which ensures a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization of the race. The children's race starts at 10:00 AM and the main run begins at 11:00 AM.
course_highlights: Race on a 5 km course in a pleasant environment on a football field in Lukačovce
Categories for men, women, and a non-competitive Nordic Walking category
Limit of 80 participants for the main run
additional: Children's races start at 10:00 AM, the main race at 11:00 AM. The participation limit for the main race is 80 runners. The organizer is the municipality of Lukačovce represented by Ing. Martin Sabol - mayor of the municipality. Contact persons: Ing. Martin Sabol (race director, phone: 0948 922 600) and Adrián Turik (phone: 0948 228 212). The event also includes children's categories, registration is possible online or on-site, and the surface is likely flat, suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Harhovská desiatka

description: Harhovská desiatka is a running event in Spišský Hrhove offering a 10 km course and a shorter 3.5 km course for recreational and beginner runners. The races are divided into several age categories for men and women, including a special category for residents of Spišský Hrhove. The organizer is the municipality of Spišský Hrhove, and the race starts in front of the Municipal Office. The registration fee is paid at the presentation and is €10 for the 10 km race and €5 for the 3.5 km course.
course_highlights: 10 km course for advanced runners
3.5 km course for recreational and beginner runners
Start in front of the Municipal Office in Spišský Hrhove
additional: Registration fee is paid at the presentation on the day of the race. Categories are divided by age and gender, including a category for residents of Spišský Hrhove. The 10 km course is certified by the Slovak Athletic Federation, the race takes place in summer, and registration is possible online and on-site.

name: Brezovský letný beh
location: Športové ihrisko, Rimavské Brezovo, Bardejov, Slovakia
description: Brezovský health run is a traditional running race in the village of Brezov, Bardejov district, offering a course that runs on asphalt, field, and forest paths. The race is open to men and women, including youth up to 15 years old and over 15 years old. Organizers have prepared two starting categories with a large and small package, allowing participation in this sporting event in a pleasant environment near the Municipal Office in Brezov. The race is suitable for runners of various age groups and performance levels.
course_highlights: Surface of the course: asphalt, field road, forest road
Start location: near the Municipal Office in Brezov
Categories: men/women, youth up to 15 years old and over 15 years old
additional: The course includes asphalt, rural, and forest paths; the race is intended for men, women, and youth; registration is subject to a fee

name: Behaj lesmi Čičmany
price_range: €17 - €24 per race, discounts for multiple registrations
description: The Čičmany Run is a trail race set in the picturesque environment of the Slovak folk village Čičmany, offering a course through the Strážovské Hills with stunning nature, untouched forests, and expansive meadows. The race is part of the Run Through the Forest series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, ensuring international recognition and rating. Participants can compete on various routes, including a long 20 km race with an elevation gain of 718 meters, a medium 11 km Lesnícka route with a 380-meter elevation gain, and a short 5 km route. The event also features a special Conti Speed Section where top runners can win valuable prizes.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Strážovské Hills with an elevation gain of up to 718 meters on the 20 km route
The race takes place in the authentic environment of the Slovak folk village Čičmany with painted wooden houses
Part of the course is the Conti Speed Section over 150 meters with prizes for the best runners
additional: Participants can pre-register and change the registration fee online via their SportID profile. The course features the Conti Speed Section with prizes for top runners. The race is part of the UTMB Index Races, allowing runners to earn points for international trail race rankings. The event is included in the UTMB Index, with options to download GPX files, categories for different age groups, and online registration available.

name: Minimaratón
location: Atletický štadión na Štiavničkách, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT OZ, Minimaratón OZ
description: Mini Marathon is a unique running event exclusively for families with children, held at the athletics stadium in Štiavničky, Banská Bystrica. The event offers various categories based on children's age, from the youngest runners to older children, including mothers with strollers. The course is adapted to age groups, with loops of 400 m and 200 m. In addition to the sporting experience, there is an accompanying program with activities for children and meetings with athletes. Each participant receives a commemorative start number, a medal, and refreshments after finishing.
course_highlights: Course for children born 2011-2020 and mothers with strollers - 400 m loop
Shortened 200 m course for children up to 5 years old
SNP Athletics Stadium in Štiavničky - a beautiful oval and environment
additional: Registration is possible online until August 22, 2026, in person on August 21, 2026 at Europa SC and on August 23, 2026 at the stadium from 8:00. The start fee does not include refunds or transfers to the next edition. Refreshments and medical services are provided after the race. There will be no cloakroom or changing rooms available. At 11:50, a draw for valuable prizes will take place for all finishers. terrain: athletics stadium; online and in-person registration; medals and prizes for participants; 11th anniversary; accompanying program including an airplane flyover and family activities.

name: Beh na boso Tatry
location: Golfový rezort Black Stork, Veľká Lomnica, Slovakia
description: Barefoot Tatra Run is a running event set in the beautiful environment of the Black Stork Golf Resort in Veľká Lomnica. Participants can choose between non-competitive runs for children and adults, and a competitive 5 km run. The course runs over mowed grass, through paths and stones, creating a cross-country character. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant atmosphere in the Tatras' nature. The organizer is OZ Beh na boso Tatry, which ensures a quality race experience.
course_highlights: The course runs over mowed grass
Crosses paths and stones covered with a carpet
Cross-country course in the environment of Black Stork Golf Resort
additional: The non-competitive runs start at 9:30 AM, and the competitive 5 km run begins at 10:30 AM. Categories are divided by age and gender. Non-competitive runs include 250 meters for children up to 12 years old and 1 km for children and adults. The course includes mowed grass, paths, stones, and a cross-country section; registration is also possible on-site; the event supports charitable activities and offers refreshments and accompanying activities for children.

name: BUDAI NIGHT TRAIL
location: Sportcsarnok, Kamilla utca 1-3, Telki, Pest County, Hungary
description: The Buda Night Trail is an exciting trail running race held at night through the scenic forest trails of the Buda Mountains. Participants run with headlamps on their heads, providing a unique experience in the dark across varied terrain. The race offers two distances, 13.5 km and 17.3 km, both with significant elevation gain. The event has a friendly atmosphere, and the start is at Telki, at the Sports Hall.
course_highlights: Night trail running through the forest trails of the Buda Mountains
Headlamp running across diverse terrain conditions
Marked route with significant elevation gain (490 m+ and 527 m+)
additional: Start time: 19:30 for the 17.3 km distance, 20:00 for the 13.5 km distance. Race pack pickup: 18:00-19:15 (M distance), 18:00-19:45 (S distance). Cut-off time: 23:00 (S distance), 23:30 (M distance). Registration is only available online, no on-site registration. The maximum number of participants is 600 across both distances. The event takes place in nature, in darkness, with headlamps, offering a special experience for participants.

name: MOVE SZOMBATHELY SUNSET RUN
description: The MOVE Szombathely Sunset Run is a unique evening and night running race in the main square of Szombathely, offering opportunities for children and amateur runners alike. The special atmosphere of the race is provided by the sunset and the ambiance of the city center, creating a pleasant and motivating running experience. The event aims to make running accessible to all ages while also providing a community experience.
course_highlights: Running in Szombathely main square
Evening, post-sunset atmosphere
Distances suitable for children and amateurs
additional: The race's uniqueness lies in the evening and night run, which has not been held before in Szombathely. Organizers also share preparation tips for the 6 km distance, emphasizing gradual training and 3-4 sessions per week for successful completion. Night running event, location in Szombathely's main square, starting at 17:00 and 19:00.

description: The SUHANJ! 6 is a charity running race that supports people with disabilities and aids the nonprofit work of the SUHANJ! Foundation. The race takes place at the Margaret Island Athletics Centre, where participants run as many laps as possible within 6 hours on a 3.5 km flat, accessible loop. The race starts at midnight, guaranteeing a sunrise view. Entries are open for individual and team categories, with teams consisting of 2-10 members and unlimited relay changes allowed. Additionally, the Midnight Half Marathon starts at midnight on the SUHANJ! 6 course, with a limit of 200 participants.
course_highlights: 3.5 km long, completely flat, accessible loop
2,500 meters asphalt road on the central road of Margaret Island
400-meter synthetic track at the Margaret Island Athletics Centre
additional: Number pickup is available from August 25-29 between 08:00 and 20:00 at the SUHANJ! Fitness (Budapest, 13th district, Tátra Street 6). Use of a headlamp during the race until dawn is mandatory. Participants are advised to use their own cup or bottle at refreshment points. The race center provides changing rooms, showers, toilets, baggage storage, and a dedicated refreshment zone. From 22:00 to 23:00 before the race, the SUHANJ! Handbike Grand Prix for athletes with disabilities takes place at the MAC track. After the race, breakfast and a charity raffle await participants. The race supports the work of the SUHANJ! Foundation; participation is possible via online registration, and the program includes a map-based course, breakfast, and raffle.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly, circuit-style running race held in Dióskert, Törökbálint. Participants complete the half marathon distance over four laps, but it is also possible to run fewer laps. The registration fee is voluntary, 500 HUF per lap, which supports the event costs. Every participant receives an apple, hot tea, and mulled wine, and the top three male and female finishers will receive a special medal. The award ceremony takes place at 12:00 PM.
course_highlights: The course is located in Dióskert, Törökbálint
The half marathon consists of 4 laps, but fewer laps can be chosen
Friendly, voluntary registration fee of 500 HUF per lap
additional: Registration is on-site. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and the top three male and female finishers will receive a unique medal. Participants are welcomed with an apple, hot tea, and mulled wine. The award ceremony is at 12:00 PM. The race allows for fewer laps, on-site registration, commemorative medals, awards for the top three male and female finishers, and refreshments: apple, hot tea, and mulled wine.

description: The Neck Cutter Marathon is a challenging trail running race in the Kiskunság region, near Ballószög, offering the marathon distance but under more difficult conditions. The race features various distances, including 14 km, 22.5 km, and 42 km runs, as well as a mountain bike race. The course is naturalistic, passing through agricultural dirt roads and forest sections, with refreshment points every 4-5 kilometers. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and foster community spirit. Participants are required to respect nature and follow the rules; mountain bikers must wear helmets.
course_highlights: Naturalistic trail, agricultural dirt roads, and forest sections
Refreshment points every 4-5 kilometers with water, fruit, and grape sugar
Red sawdust track for children's races, with no elevation change
additional: Refreshments every 4-5 kilometers with water, grape sugar, fruit, and alcoholic drinks at the finish. Helmet wearing is mandatory for mountain bikers. T-shirt orders are possible until August 10th, priced at 5000 HUF. The race takes place on agricultural dirt roads, and participants must observe traffic rules. Respect for nature is mandatory; littering will result in disqualification. The event features chip timing, various running and cycling races, and hikes, providing opportunities for participants to explore natural beauty and engage in sports.

description: The UFÓ Ócsa Run is a popular city race held in the town of Ócsa, around the Gábor Egressy Leisure Center. The race offers challenges at multiple distances, including 10.5 km and 21 km runs, which pass through the town's landmarks. The event features unique chip timing, and the rankings are based on gross time. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with age restrictions and a limited number of participants.
course_highlights: City environment, route passing through Ócsa's landmarks
10.5 km loop, to be completed multiple times for longer distances
Varied terrain: asphalt, dirt paths, wine cellar area
additional: The race uses a unique chip timing system that measures both net and gross times. Placements are determined based on gross time. The maximum number of participants is 550. Residents of Ócsa are eligible for a discount on the registration fee, which must be verified with a residence card. Registration is free for those born in 1960 or earlier. The race is part of the Ötpróba point collection system, and there is an opportunity to support the local community and promote sports on site.
