description: Draždiak Run is a running event held in Bratislava, in the Veľký Draždiak area, Petržalka. Participants can expect courses running over gravel and hiking trails, suitable for various age groups and levels. The event includes children's runs, a 5 km race for adults, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog. The organizer is the Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, which ensures a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Surface: gravel path and hiking trail
Start location: beach at Barracuda kiosk, Veľký Draždiak, Petržalka
Courses for children, adults, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog
additional: The children's races start at 10:00. Categories include children's run, 5 km run for men and women in various age groups, 5 km Nordic walking, and a 1.8 km family run with a dog. The registration fee for children is lower than for adults. Online registration is available until August 21 at a discounted price, followed by more expensive online registration until September 4, 2025, and finally on-site registration at the highest price if quota is not filled. Online registration is open until August 21, 2026. The start is at 10:00, and the course includes gravel, grassy, and asphalt sections, with various categories including a family run and Nordic Walking.

name: Beh pod Sninským kameňom
location: Rekreačná oblasť Sninske rybníky, Snina, Slovakia
description: Run under Sninský Kameň is a running event in the recreational area of Sninské rybníky in Snina, offering routes for children and adults. The races are held on asphalt and field roads, with children's categories covering distances from 50 to 600 meters depending on age. The main category starts at 4:30 PM and is divided by age groups of men and women. The organizer is BehajmeSpolu o.z. in cooperation with the town of Snina, with an entry fee of €15 for online registration and €20 on-site.
course_highlights: Surface: asphalt and field roads (10%)
Recreational area of Sninské rybníky - OMW Snina
Multiple age categories from children to seniors
additional: Children's categories start at 3:00 PM, the main category begins at 4:30 PM. Categories are detailed according to age and gender, including juniors and various age groups of men and women. The event features routes for children from 50 m to 600 m, with the main race covering 6000 m. Children's start is scheduled for 3:30 PM and the main run at 4:30 PM.

name: 36. BorsodChem Bódva-völgyi Maraton
description: The 36th BorsodChem Bódva Valley Marathon is a traditional running race held around Edelény. The race offers various distances, providing opportunities for runners of all levels to find a suitable challenge. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and provides professional timing with an RFID chip system. Participants can enjoy the natural beauty of the Bódva Valley and the diverse terrain.
course_highlights: Varied distances: from 500 meters to marathon
Natural, diverse terrain in the Bódva Valley
Professional chip timing (RFID, HuTag)
additional: Registration is available on korido.hu, where automatic confirmation and SimplePay card payment options are also provided. Bibs are distributed with safety pins. The event features multiple distances and race categories, so every family member can find a suitable option. Several distances are available for the race, but specific details and registration fees are not included in the sources.

name: EMU 6 DAYS RACE / GOMU 6 DAYS WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP
description: The EMU 6-Day Race, also known as the GOMU 6-Day World Championship, is one of the most prestigious multi-day ultramarathon events in the world, held in Balatonfüred. During the race, participants run for six days, testing their endurance and stamina. The event is traditionally the highlight of multi-day ultrarunning, where world records have been set. Runners face a unique challenge that tests both physical and mental strength.
course_highlights: Six days of continuous running on the Balatonfüred course
Venue of world records in multiple categories
A challenging multi-day ultramarathon race
additional: The focus of the event is on achieving multi-day ultramarathon records; details of the race and terrain type are not specified.

name: Z Ľubotína na hrad Plaveč
description: Lubotin Run to Plaveč Castle is a traditional running race starting in the village of Ľubotín near the Multifunctional House. The race offers categories for men, women, juniors, Nordic walking, and a 4 km hobby run. The main category starts at 17:30, with children's categories beginning at 16:30. Organized by the villages of Ľubotín and Plaveč, it welcomes runners of all ages and levels. The race is suitable for those who want to experience running in a beautiful environment with the finish at Plaveč Castle.
course_highlights: Start in the village of Ľubotín near the Multifunctional House
Finish at the historic Plaveč Castle
Route suitable for hobby runners and Nordic walking
additional: Children's categories start at 16:30, main category at 17:30. Categories are divided by age and gender, including Nordic walking and a 4 km hobby run on an asphalt road. Residents of Ľubotín and Plaveč, women over 60, and men over 70 have free starting fees. There is an option for a discounted start package of 20 € for participants also taking part in the Jastrabskými vŕškami 2025 run. The event includes categories for various age groups, including juniors and Nordic walking, with online and on-site registration, and discounts for early registration. It also features a children's run and races on an asphalt track.

name: SÜMEG TRAIL
location: Kisfaludy tér, Sümeg, Veszprém County, Hungary
description: The Sümeg Trail running race is a prominent sporting event in the city of Sümeg, attracting running enthusiasts for the fifth year. The race offers challenges across four different distances, which participants can complete in the unique and beautiful environment of the city. The event also features numerous sports and health screening programs, including yoga classes, meditation, and other physical activities. The Sümeg Trail is a lively, community-oriented event that promotes sports and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Sümeg's special and beautiful course
Four types of distances: sweet, treat, spicy, and strong challenges
Sports programs and health screenings in the Courtyard of the Memorial House
additional: On the day of the race, the program is enriched with yoga, warm-up sessions, health screening programs, singing bowl meditation, skill games, jiu-jitsu training, and performances by local dancers. The event also offers environmentally friendly and cultural programs, and the venue showcases the natural beauty of the surrounding area.

name: Marathon Chopok
description: The Chopok Marathon is a challenging mountain run in the beautiful environment of the Low Tatras, testing your abilities on various surfaces and terrains. The race takes place on September 5, 2026, starting at 7:00 from Srdiečko and finishing at Chopok at an altitude of 2004 meters above sea level. There are two main routes available: the SkyMarathon Chopok with a length of 43 km and an elevation gain of 2600 meters, and the shorter Sky Race Jasná Trail with a length of 21 km and an elevation gain of 1400 meters. On the longer route, there is also an option to participate in relay teams. The course runs along both the southern and northern sides of Chopok, including the main ridge, offering beautiful views and diverse terrain.
course_highlights: 43 km course with 2600 m elevation gain across the Low Tatras on both the southern and northern sides of Chopok
Crossing the main ridge with diverse surfaces requiring appropriate footwear
Finish at Chopok at an altitude of 2004 m above sea level with the possibility of quick access by cable car
additional: Option to start in relay teams on the long route with 4 or fewer members in segments of approximately 10-11 km. The race is included in the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar for 2026. The courses are the same as in previous years, allowing performance comparisons. Spectators can watch the runners at various points along the course. Trail race with relay team options, start at 07:00 and 10:00, part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar, the course runs from Srdiečko to Chopok and back.

name: Kokava Trail
location: Kokava nad Rimavicou, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
description: Kokava Trail is a certified trail run starting and finishing in Kokava nad Rimavicou, which takes a loop through the Veporské vrchy and Stolické vrchy mountain ranges. The race is held on two routes - the main route is 78 km long with an elevation gain of +3330 m and a time limit of 18 hours, while the shorter Pasiečky Trail is 23 km with +1200 m elevation gain and a 7-hour limit. The course is diverse, with 45% meadow sections, 45% forest trails, and 10% asphalt, without difficult technical passages but including several steeper descents and ascents. Participants will appreciate six refreshment stations and mandatory equipment, which includes an insulating foil, headlamp, mobile phone with a charged SIM card, GPS device, reflective vest, and sufficient fluids. Winners in the categories Men, Women, Men 50+, and Women 50+ will receive medals and material prizes during the awards ceremony at the cultural house.
course_highlights: Diverse surface: 45% meadow, 45% forest, 10% asphalt
Elevation gain of +3330 m on the 78 km main route
6 refreshment stations along the course
additional: Mandatory equipment includes an insulating foil, headlamp with new batteries, a charged mobile phone with an active SIM card, a GPS device with the race route (power bank required for mobile navigation), reflective vest or bands, at least 1.5 liters of fluids, your own cup or bottle with a wide mouth, proof of identity, and a visible starting number. The top three in categories Men, Women, Men 50+, and Women 50+ will be awarded. The course does not contain difficult technical sections but includes several steeper descents and ascents. There are 6 refreshment stations on the route. Two routes: 78 km and 23 km, mandatory equipment, certified course, mountain terrain, online registration, part of the Slovak Ultratrail League.

name: Prešov Running Series 3. kolo
description: Prešov Running Series Round 3 is part of a series of running events in Prešov taking place throughout 2026. The event is suitable for all age groups and skill levels, from beginners to professionals. The courses are designed to foster community, promote a healthy lifestyle, and bring joy through movement. Included in the registration fee are a timing chip, medal, refreshments, and an accompanying program. Children who are members of the Prešov Running Team can run for free.
course_highlights: Courses for various skill levels from beginners to professionals
Event on Main Street in Prešov with a community atmosphere
Accompanying program and refreshments for all participants
additional: The registration fee includes a bib with a chip, timing, medal, refreshments, accompanying program, medical service, race organization, and photos. On-site registration is possible depending on capacity, but early online registration is recommended. It is advised to pick up the bib the day before at OC Novum. Children who are members of the Prešov Running Team can participate for free after paying the annual membership fee. The series includes three races at different locations in Prešov with themes of fantasy, history, and sport; registration is mandatory; maps, medals, and children's categories are available; a raffle is also part of the event.

name: 6 hodinovka pod Šarišským hradom
description: The 6-hour race under Šariš Castle is an endurance running event held in Veľký Šariš, Prešov district. The race is open to individuals and relay teams, with categories divided by age and gender. The registration fee is the same for all runners, and the event offers an opportunity to test your endurance in a six-hour run in a beautiful setting beneath the castle. The organizers are Gejza Sabanoš and Ondrej Fedor, who ensure the smooth running of the event.
course_highlights: The race takes place around the historic Šariš Castle with a beautiful view of the surrounding landscape
Opportunity to participate in various categories including relay races
A long, six-hour endurance challenge for runners of all levels
additional: The race includes various categories and relay options; the course is situated around the castle, but details about the terrain are not specified

description: The Rohals Sports Club cordially invites you to the 16th edition of the Novoveská Hut Run, which will take place in Novoveská Hut. For adults, a new course measuring 12.2 km is prepared, leading to Vojtechova Samota and back, the same for women and men. For those who prefer shorter distances, a 5 km course is available. Children and young runners will compete on shorter routes in the streets of Hut according to age categories. After the run, participants can recharge with goulash, children can enjoy a puppet show, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest.
course_highlights: New course for adults leads to Vojtechova Samota (Šadroň) and back
The distance for adults is 12.2 km, uniform for women and men
Shorter routes for children in the streets of Novoveská Hut according to age categories
additional: Registration for youth is from 11:30 to 12:45, for juniors and adults until 14:45. Start is only possible in one category. After the run, goulash is provided, children can enjoy a puppet show, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest. In the adult categories, participants compete for points in the Spišská Nová Ves District Running League. The courses are 12.2 km and 5 km, with categories for different age groups, registration on the day of the event, and accompanying activities for children and adults.

name: Ozorovská dvanastka
description: Ozorovská dvanástka is a running race held in Malé Ozorovce, offering courses for children and adults. The race is organized by OZ Zorovčan in cooperation with the municipality of Veľké Ozorovce, and participants can compete on 6 km and 12 km courses with categories based on age and gender. The start for children is at 9:00 AM and for adults at 10:00 AM. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere near the cultural house.
course_highlights: Course runs in Malé Ozorovce with parking in front of the cultural house
Two main courses: 12 km and 6 km with categories by age and gender
Children's start at 9:00 AM, adults at 10:00 AM
additional: The race categories include children's categories and age divisions for men and women on the 12 km course (Men A up to 39, B 40-49, C 50 and over; Women F up to 39, G 40-49, H) and a 6 km course for men and women. The event takes place on September 5, 2026, with starts at 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM. The course includes local roads, with registration available online or on-site.

name: Horský kros Gerlach
description: The Gerlach Mountain Cross is a traditional mountain uphill run that starts from the village of Gerlachov, passes through the Velická Valley, and ends at the Sliezsky Dom mountain hotel. The course is 8,400 meters long with an elevation gain of 879 meters, and runners traverse a rocky trail and sometimes an asphalt road. The event is suitable for runners who enjoy challenging mountain terrain and beautiful views of the High Tatras. The race also includes children's runs and the option to purchase an entry with original Gerlach Mountain Cross socks.
course_highlights: Course length of 8,400 meters with an elevation gain of 879 meters
Rocky trail and sometimes an asphalt road
Finish line at the Sliezsky Dom mountain hotel
additional: Maximum capacity of 200 runners. The time limit at Velický Bridge (5.7 km) is 1:30 hours. During the race, refreshments are provided on the course and at the finish line, with transportation of belongings to the finish, and food after the race. Children's races (100-500 meters) are not scored; each child receives a medal and a sweet treat. There is an option to purchase an entry with HKG socks for €7. The race takes place in mountain terrain, registration is possible at the municipal office, and children's races are included.

description: The Tatry Run is a running event held in the picturesque environment of Štrbské Pleso in the High Tatras, beneath the Tatras Tower observation tower. The race offers a start for children at 2:00 PM and for adults at 4:00 PM, with the course running on natural terrain along the lake's shoreline and cross-country ski trails. Categories are divided by age and gender, allowing broad participation of runners from various age groups. The organizers are Barbora and Slavomír Ogurčákovci in collaboration with the civic association Žiť Tatry, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Natural surface along the shore of Štrbské Pleso lake
Cross-country ski trails of Štrbské Pleso
Picturesque environment of the High Tatras under Tatras Tower
additional: Children start at 2:00 PM, adults at 4:00 PM. Categories divided by age and gender. Organized by Barbora and Slavomír Ogurčákovci in cooperation with the civic association Žiť Tatry. The course surface is natural, running around the lake and along cross-country ski trails. Registration from March 15, 2025, to September 4, 2025; categories for different age groups.

name: Veľatský lesný beh
description: The Veľatský Forest Run is a traditional running event organized by the civic association OZ Stopa in the village of Veľaty. The race takes place at the FK Veľaty sports field and offers courses of various lengths for men and women aged 15 and above, with children's runs held directly on the football pitch. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, voluntary registration as a donation, and provided refreshments. Throughout the day, volunteers accompany the runners, and results are measured with timing systems, followed by the announcement of winners and distribution of material prizes.
course_highlights: Courses in the forest environment of Veľaty village with lengths of 6 km, 11 km, and 16 km
Children's runs on the FK Veľaty football pitch
Changing rooms, showers, and toilets directly at the start location
additional: Registration is possible online until September 4, 2024, after which on-site registration is available until 9:30 AM. The start fee is voluntary and in the form of a donation to OZ Stopa. After the last runner finishes, results are announced and prizes are awarded. Parking is secured in designated parking lots with guidance from organizers. The race is conducted according to athletics rules, with participants running at their own risk. Children run immediately after the start of the main disciplines. The course includes forest, asphalt, and gravel sections; the event is open to all age categories; registration can be done online or on-site; the event includes refreshments and commemorative items.

name: 41. Wizz Air Budapest Félmaraton
location: Budapest, Pázmány P. rakpart, Budapest, Hungary
description: The 41st Wizz Air Budapest Half Marathon is Hungary's largest half marathon, taking place on September 6, 2026, in Budapest. The race runs along a beautiful and varied route through the most scenic parts of Budapest, with over ten thousand runners participating. The course is fast, panoramic, and the atmosphere is lively, with music points and enthusiastic supporters cheering on the runners. The half marathon is an ideal distance for both beginners and advanced runners, featuring a unique finisher medal at the finish line.
course_highlights: Fast course through Budapest's most beautiful areas
Varied, panoramic route
Joyful music points and enthusiastic crowd
additional: Currently, registration is only open for the 21.1 km individual race, but the 10 km, pairs, and trio categories will be available soon. Online registration is exclusively via credit card at nevezes.futanet.hu. A BSI account registration is required to register. The finisher medal is unique and can be collected at the finish line. Tips related to the race include preparation for warm weather, hydration, and race readiness, as well as the option for virtual participation.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 9. kolo
description: The 2-Mile Run Bratislava is a regular 2-mile running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool area in Bratislava. The race is open to the general public, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans, who are divided into categories. Registration takes place directly on-site at the volleyball court from 9:30 AM, with the start at 10:00 AM. The competition is part of a series of races where runners earn points towards the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team's Traveling Cup based on their performance and age.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 2 miles (3.218 km), children approximately 200 m
The course runs within the Kuchajda swimming pool area in Bratislava
Registration and start at the volleyball court
additional: Registration is on-site from 9:30 AM. The start is at 10:00 AM. Categories: children (13 years and under), juniors, women, men, veterans (women and men). Competition for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team's Traveling Cup with scoring based on age coefficients and number of participations. In case of a tie, the best time and shoe size determine the winner. The race is part of a series held in Kuchajda, Bratislava, with on-site registration available. The race includes various categories such as children, juniors, adults, and veterans, and aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and community.

name: Dukelský beh mieru
description: Dukelský Peace Run is one of the oldest and most significant running events in Slovakia, held annually on the first Sunday of September. The course runs from Dukla to the center of Svidník and measures 19 kilometers with an elevation change from 479 meters above sea level at the start to 244 meters above sea level at the finish. Runners pass through a historic route associated with the Carpatho-Dukla Operation, commemorating the victims and the fight for peace in 1944-1945. The event has a rich history and strong emotional significance, attracting both competitive runners and amateurs.
course_highlights: Course length of 19 km from Dukla to Svidník
Start at an altitude of 479 m above sea level, finish at 244 m above sea level
Historic route connected with the Carpatho-Dukla Operation
additional: Registration for 2026 is still in preparation. The course is known for its historical significance and challenge for runners, passing through a route once traversed by soldiers during the Carpatho-Dukla Operation. The event also features accompanying race categories such as the Great Health Run and the Small Health Run. The course is approximately 19 km, starting at the Dukla Pass and ending in the pedestrian zone of Svidník. The event includes short runs and inline races, with online registration available until August 2025.

name: III. Pannonhalma Decem Futás 5 / 10
description: The III. Pannonhalma Decem Run is a friendly and diverse running race set in the picturesque surroundings of Pannonhalma, Fenyvesalja. The event offers two distances, 5 and 10 kilometers, providing running enthusiasts the opportunity to enjoy nature and well-marked routes. The aim of the event is to offer a motivating and enjoyable sports experience for all ages while allowing participants to explore the beauty of the local landscape. The race is part of the Ötpróba series, which includes multiple sports and events as part of a leisure sports program.
course_highlights: 5 and 10 km distances around Pannonhalma Fenyvesalja
Nature-oriented, diverse terrain
Well-marked and safe routes
additional: Participants receive medals, gifts, and refreshment stations; the venue is easily accessible and emphasizes community experience.

name: XI. Moonlight Run
description: The 11th Moonlight Run is a charming running race in the city of Szob, scheduled for September 12, 2026. Participants will receive timing, a bib number, and a unique finisher medal. Refreshments are provided on the course and at the finish line, and traditional bread with onions awaits runners at the finish. The event takes place under medical supervision, and organizers prioritize the experience of participation.

Refreshments on the course and at the finish line
Unique finisher medal for every participant
additional: Medical supervision is provided during the race. Traditional bread with onions is served at the finish. Every participant receives a unique finisher medal. Refreshments are available on the course and at the finish line. Participants receive a certificate of participation, and refreshments are provided at the finish; the event is conducted in Hungarian.

The event traditionally welcomes participants with significant early bird discounts and is held in a friendly, family-like atmosphere. name: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky
description: The Run Through the Forests Topoľčianky are nocturnal trail races in the beautiful wine-growing region of Topoľčianky, taking place on September 12, 2026. Runners will enjoy routes passing around the Topoľčianky Castle and Hrušov Castle, with forest paths and an atmosphere under the stars. The race is part of the Run Through the Forests series and is included in the international UTMB Index, which increases its prestige. There will be two main routes - 11 km and 22 km, with a fast section called the Conti Speed Section offering a valuable prize.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the wine-growing region with views of Topoľčianky Castle and Hrušov Castle
Forest paths with soft surfaces suitable for trail running
Night run under the stars with a marked Conti Speed Section
additional: The race features the Conti Speed Section - a 150-meter fast segment with a chance to win a voucher for tires and a running jersey. The event is nocturnal, providing a unique atmosphere and experience. The routes are 80% on soft terrain and 100% in fresh air. It is part of the Run Through the Forests series with multiple events across Slovakia and the Czech Republic. The race offers several routes including a children's race with prizes starting from 5 EUR when purchasing 7 or more races, and includes entertainment for children, registration outside of the Terminovka.sk website, and the option to participate in the night run.

description: Marina Liptov RUN is a sports and recreational event set in the beautiful environment of the Marina Liptov resort near Liptovská Mara. This unconventional run offers a combination of nature and quality services in harmony with the four elements - fire, water, earth, and air. Runners can enjoy a peaceful and inspiring setting with views of the surrounding nature and the opportunity to relax after the run in the resort. Marina Liptov is an ideal place for athletes and families seeking an experience in nature.
course_highlights: The route runs through a natural environment near Liptovská Mara
Beautiful views of the surrounding nature, meadows, mountains, and forests
Peaceful and harmonious environment of the four elements of nature
additional: Marina Liptov offers accommodation, wellness, water activities, a boatyard, and a port, which can be utilized by runners before or after the race. The resort's opening hours are daily from 09:00 to 19:00. There are opportunities for hiking, cycling, skiing, and fishing nearby. The course is a 9 km trail with possible changes, registration is available online or on-site, and technical and medical support is provided.

description: The Run to Choč is a unique running event in the heart of Orava, testing your physical abilities as you run to the summit of Veľký Choč. The event is suitable for all lovers of running, sports, and nature who want to experience an exceptional atmosphere and enjoy quality refreshments and rewards. The run is also a tribute to Jožo Čajka, an athlete and friend with a big heart.

The race is organized within the Choč National Park and is suitable for runners of all levels.

description: The BMW BERLIN-MARATHON is one of the world's largest and most popular marathon races, taking place in Berlin on September 27, 2026. The race is famous for its record-breaking, extremely flat course that passes through the city's most beautiful sights. The event offers a unique experience not only for professional runners but also for running enthusiasts, thanks to its diversity and the city's unique energy. The race is part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors series, and participants can choose from several options, including charity runs, inline skating, and the Generali 5K run.
course_highlights: One of the flattest marathon courses in the world, with minimal elevation gain
The course passes through Berlin's most beautiful sights, such as the Brandenburg Gate
15 refreshment points along the course, as well as BRITA water refill stations
additional: On race day, clothing or valuables cannot be dropped off at the start area, but all finishers receive a warm, reusable poncho free of charge. Clothing drop-off can be booked for 5€, but in this case, no poncho is provided. The race packet can only be collected in person at the MARATHON EXPO with a photo ID and start number. Runners receive a 4-day public transportation ticket for the duration of the race. Runners can also place their own refreshments on the course with prior registration and labeling. The Generali 5K run starts on September 26 at 10:00 AM, with the start at Potsdamer Platz and the finish at Straße des 17. Juni near the Brandenburg Gate. The event also includes inline skating, a 5 km run, and charity opportunities. Details about the registration process, race day, and support options can be found on the official website.

name: Mariatálsky štvanec
description: The Marianka Run is a traditional race set in the beautiful scenery of the Little Carpathians, offering various disciplines for both hobby runners and competitive athletes. The event takes place in the village of Marianka with a family-friendly atmosphere and culminates in a stunning sunset. Participants can compete in categories of 6 km, 10 km, 15 km, in three-person teams over 3×6 km, or in children's races called Záhoráčik Run. The start and finish are at the football pitch, and the race is governed by the rules of the Slovak Athletic Federation.
course_highlights: Courses run through the Little Carpathians with beautiful nature
Family atmosphere with children's races Záhoráčik Run
Stunning sunset as the highlight of the event
additional: Registration and pickup of start numbers is available at the TUI branch in BORY MALL shopping center. The number of adult participants is limited to 500, children to 400. The number of teams is unlimited. Time limits are 1 hour for 6 km, 1:30 hours for 10 km, 2 hours for 15 km, and 1.5 hours for the 3×6 km relay. The event includes multiple courses, categories for adults, children, and relays, online and on-site registration, chip timing, refreshments and medals. The participant limit is 900.

name: MTBIKER Kylof Ľubietová
description: Kylof Ľubietová Running Race is a running event that combines history, nature, and good mood in the picturesque environment of central Slovakia. The race is held on three courses: 4.3 km hobby course for beginners and young people from 13 years old, 10 km main race for competitive and hobby runners, and children's runs over 850 meters for children aged 6 to 12. The course features climbs, beautiful views of the Low Tatras, and participants can compete for monetary prizes and valuable awards. After the race, participants can enjoy traditional granadír and an original medal belonging to the Marathon Tour.
course_highlights: 4.3 km hobby course with a nice loop and ascent
10 km course with views of the Low Tatras and a mining trail
Children's runs in the center of Ľubietová over 850 meters
additional: Children's runs start at 9:30 according to age categories, hobby course starts at 10:40, and the main race at 10:30. Each participant receives an original medal for the Marathon Tour. A granadír is prepared at the finish line. The fastest runners will receive vouchers and trophies, overall winners of the 10 km race will receive monetary prizes. All finishers are entered into a raffle for experience prizes such as a parachute jump or sightseeing flight. Trail running, registration, family event, historical themes, beautiful views.

name: Gréta Run
location: Koliba Gréta, Liptovská Sielnica, okres L. Mikuláš, Slovakia
description: Gréta Run is a traditional running race set in the picturesque environment of Kvačianska Valley and Liptovská Sielnica, offering courses of various lengths for children and adults. The race follows the yellow tourist trail and embankment, with the finish line at Gréta Cottage, where participants can enjoy refreshments and a cultural program. The event also features a rich accompanying program for families and children. Organized by the Olympic Club of Liptov, which ensures quality technical and medical services.
course_highlights: 7.4 km course from Kvačianska Valley along the yellow trail to Gréta Cottage
15 km course from Gréta Cottage through Kvačianska Valley and Prosiecka Valley back to Gréta Cottage
3 km course along the embankment to Liptovská Sielnica and back
additional: The first 200 registered participants will receive a starter pack with goulash, spaghetti, a T-shirt, and a medal. Transportation for runners to the 7.4 km start is provided by a bus at 15:30. After the race, goulash and results announcement will take place at Stodola Gréta, followed by a concert. Changing rooms and toilets are available at Gréta Cottage. The organizer is not responsible for personal belongings and luggage. There is an option for discounted accommodation directly on site. The course sections lead from Kvačianska Valley and Gréta Cottage, registration is possible online or on-site, and the registration fee includes goulash, a medal, refreshments, and other services. The race offers multiple categories, including children’s and veteran categories, with awards and prizes for winners.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné: 6,00 € (len kategória dospelí pri platbe online)

description: Šamorín Running League 2026 - Round 5 is a running event organized by the 3klub Šamorín in cooperation with the town of Šamorín. The race takes place in the pleasant environment of Lesopark Pomlé in Šamorín and is intended for various age categories from preschoolers to adults. The start for children's categories is at 10:00 AM, with the main race beginning at 10:30 AM. The event offers the opportunity to join the league and experience a sporting atmosphere in a community setting.
course_highlights: Races in the natural environment of Lesopark Pomlé
Categories for children and adults
Children's start at 10:00, main race at 10:30
additional: Categories: Preschoolers (0 - 6 years), Younger pupils (7 - 10 years), Older pupils (11 - 15 years), Adults (women, men). The organizer is 3klub Šamorín o.z. in cooperation with the town of Šamorín. Contact for the organizer: Juraj Nagy, phone: 0905 984 190. Routes on asphalt and forest trails, categories from preschoolers to adults, no performance or age limit.

name: JÁSZFÉNYSZARUI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.6 km, 0.3 km
organizer: Petőfi Sándor Művelődési Ház és Könyvtár Jászfényszaru
description: The 7th Jászfényszarui Running Festival is a leisure running event held in Jászfényszarú, at Szentcsalád Square. The race offers distances for multiple age groups, from preschoolers to adults, with asphalted and short dirt sections. The quarter marathon features chip timing, refreshment stations, and medals for participants, and the event is free for all distances. The aim of the event is to promote community sports and running, in memory of István Maróti.
course_highlights: Mostly asphalted route with short dirt sections
Multiple distances suitable for preschoolers to adults, tailored to age groups
Refreshment stations and chip timing for the quarter marathon
additional: On-site registration is available on race day from 13:00, closing 15 minutes before the start of the races. Finish packs and medals are provided for quarter marathon runners. The top 1-3 finishers in each age group and gender receive medals. The bib number must be worn visibly at the front. Each participant can only compete in one distance. Medical supervision is provided. The event offers various distances, with races on asphalt and dirt roads, with online and on-site registration. Organizers ensure medical supervision and refreshment stations.

name: MAPEI TIHANYI FÉLMARATON (XI.)   .
location: Club Tihany, Tihany, Veszprém County, Hungary
description: The MAPEI Tihany Half Marathon is a traditional running event held for the 11th time in Tihany, offering a variety of distances for beginners to advanced runners. The race's special features include the beautiful panorama of the Balaton Uplands and the challenging, diverse terrain that touches the most scenic parts of the peninsula. Many choose the half marathon distance as their first, as the course layout and spectacular sections provide an unforgettable experience. The event is family-friendly, with a baby run for the youngest participants, and all finishers receive a medal, refreshments, and a running shirt.
course_highlights: The half marathon course passes through Tihany's most beautiful, varied panoramic sections, including the Balaton shoreline and the northern tip of the peninsula
The 12 km 'Tihany Circle' offers a challenge with elevation changes and diverse terrain
The 3 km and 5 km distances are on asphalt, easy-to-complete routes, ideal for beginners and those restarting their running journey
additional: All distances include a finisher medal and a running shirt. The 3K race starts at 11:00, while the 5K, 12K, and 21K races start at 12:00, with the 21K having a staggered start. The 400-meter baby run takes place at the race center, with refreshments at the finish line. There are age group awards, and participants under 18 require parental consent. The field is limited to 1500 participants, excluding the baby run. The race takes place on paved roads of the Tihany Peninsula, featuring varied elevation and panoramic views. Distances: 400 m, 3 km, 5 km, 12 km, 21 km; the event will be held on October 3, 2026, at Club Tihany.

name: Jarabský polmaratón
description: Jarabský half marathon is a unique mountain trail race in the Low Tatras with a length of 22.1 km, offering a challenging route full of ascents, descents, and technical terrain. The race is intended for trail running enthusiasts and active recreation lovers who can enjoy beautiful views and the atmosphere of a community of runners from professionals to recreational athletes. The event has been held since 2015 and carries the spirit of a friendly running gathering "Go as you can around Jarabá." In 2025, it is included in the Slovak Skyrunning League, emphasizing its quality and challenge.
course_highlights: The route passes through pristine nature, forests, and mountain trails
Challenging trail terrain with ascents and descents
Beautiful views of the central ridge of the Low Tatras
additional: The course features elements of a true Sky Race and has been part of the Slovak Skyrunning League since 2025. The race is open to a broad community of runners from professionals to recreational athletes. In the past, the course has been adjusted several times depending on weather conditions; the current length is 22.1 km. The event has a friendly atmosphere and originates from an informal running gathering without timing. It is a demanding mountain trail with an elevation gain of 1240 meters, registration via the website, refreshment stations, marking, medical services, and technologies to enhance the experience.

name: Karpaty Run – Bratislava Trail Run
location: Malokarpatské Námestie 1, Bratislava - Lamač, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Karpaty Run - Bratislava Trail Run is the largest trail running festival in the Little Carpathians, offering routes of various lengths and difficulties for runners and hikers. The race takes place in a pleasant natural environment with an emphasis on nature conservation and a healthy lifestyle. The routes mainly pass through forest roads and trails with minimal asphalt surface, suitable for intermediate to advanced runners. The organizer is the civic association Hojta, which promotes sports and ecological values.
course_highlights: Routes pass 65% through forest roads and 33-35% through forest trails
Elevation gain ranges from 80 m to 876 m depending on the route length
Refreshments available on the course at multiple locations depending on the route length
additional: The start is 700 meters from Malokarpatské námestie in Lamač, with a transfer 20 minutes before the start. There is no time limit for most routes, except for the longest ones, where the limit is 5 or 7 hours. Refreshment stations are available along the course according to the route length. Refreshments can be purchased at Biely Kríž. The race takes place on October 3, 2026. Registration is possible through the official website. Race categories include various age groups. Most distances are without a time limit.

name: U.S.Steel Family Run – Minimaratón
description: U. S. Steel Family Run - Mini Marathon is a running event in Košice that is part of the traditional International Peace Marathon. Runners of all age categories are welcome without age restrictions. The event is governed by the rules of World Athletics and the Slovak Athletic Federation, with organizers ensuring quality preparation and organization. The start and finish are located on Main Street in Košice, allowing for an attractive city run.
course_highlights: The course runs through the city center of Košice along Main Street
The event is suitable for all age groups without age limit
Organized according to the rules of World Athletics and the Slovak Athletic Federation
additional: The start time cannot be moved to the next year. Moving the start to a new participant is possible under certain conditions. Registration and payment of the entry fee are checked online through the runner's account. Registration is open to all interested, with participants expecting a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to take part in a short but dynamic run in the heart of Košice.

name: Medzinárodný maratón mieru
description: The International Peace Marathon in Košice is a traditional running festival held on October 4, 2026, on Main Street. Organized by the Košice Marathon Club, it offers a marathon course, half marathon, and other disciplines, with start and finish lines located in the city center. The event is known for its long history and quality organization, including the Slovak Championships in the half marathon. Runners can expect professional timing and a rich accompanying program.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Main Street between DoubleTree by Hilton and Dargov Department Store
Slovak Championships in the half marathon are part of the event
The course is certified according to World Athletics and Slovak Athletic Federation rules
additional: Start and finish are on Main Street in Košice. The organizer provides professional timing. The event includes the Slovak Championships in the half marathon. There are age categories and special categories for relays and handbikes. Registration is available online, and payment can be made by card, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and registration code. The event features various categories including marathon, half marathon, relays, and inline disciplines, with the possibility of online registration and changing start times or disciplines within set deadlines.

name: 41. SPAR Budapest Maraton® Fesztivál
description: The 41st SPAR Budapest Marathon® Festival is a weekend-long running event held in Budapest on October 11. Participants can register for distances ranging from 5 km to 42.195 km, ensuring there is a challenge suitable for everyone. The event aims to provide an unforgettable experience for runners of all levels, from beginners to seasoned marathoners. Supported by prominent patrons and sponsors, the marathon is a true bucket-list challenge that takes runners through iconic locations in Budapest.
course_highlights: Varied distances from 5 km to the full marathon (42.195 km)
Route passing through Budapest's iconic sites
Weekend-long running festival with programs
additional: The race takes place over multiple distances, with races on Saturday and Sunday, including relay, 30 km, 14 km, 10 km, mini marathon, team relay, and school relay. The registration office is accessible, offering various registration options (guest registration, school registration, corporate registration). The event's main patrons are Budapest's mayor and the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade. Throughout the weekend, active programs, prize draws, and health consultations await runners. Registration is open for distances between 5 km and 42.195 km; registration for the marathon individual race is currently open, with other categories to follow soon.

name: SPAR MARATON FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The SPAR Budapest Marathon® Festival is a two-day running event scheduled to take place in Budapest on October 10-11, 2026. Participants will have the opportunity to run along Budapest's most beautiful UNESCO World Heritage sites, enjoying panoramic views of the city and enthusiastic cheering. The festival celebrates running, offering a suitable distance for everyone from 5 km to the marathon. Participants will receive a unique finisher medal and running shirt, and the event features numerous accompanying programs and musical experiences to make the weekend unforgettable.
course_highlights: Route along UNESCO World Heritage sites
Budapest's most beautiful panoramas and districts
Numerous bands and spectators creating a lively atmosphere
additional: Participants can choose from 18 different distances, from 5 km to the marathon, and can also register in pairs or relay teams. The event includes various accompanying programs, musical experiences, and a vibrant spectator atmosphere. Finishers receive a unique medal and running shirt. Registration office contact details and options for modifying registration are provided. Distances include: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, relay, walking, family run, city tour, and equality run; schedule, start list, results, online registration, team and school registration, and awards.

course_highlights: Mountain terrain of Javorníky with multiple control points
Finish in Lysej pod Makytou
Long time limit of 27 hours with several stage time limits
additional: Participant registration took place at the Cultural House in Čadca on Matičné Square on Friday evening and Saturday morning. The start is jointly from Čadca at 07:00. Organizers provide luggage transport and drop bags for control point K4. Medical assistance and safety are ensured during the event. Accommodation is available in Čadca, with a gymnasium of a primary school providing overnight rest for participants. The course includes 80% forest roads, 5% asphalt, and 15% meadows; mandatory equipment includes a headlamp, reflective elements, hydration, and first aid; registration closed on September 26, 2025.

description: GARMIN Run through the Suľov Rocks is a traditional running race set in the beautiful environment of the Suľov Rocks, offering three courses of varying lengths and difficulty. Runners pass through picturesque nature with views of rock formations and ridge trails, with refreshment stations along the route. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own categories and starts. The organizer is the Slovak Cycling Club CYKLO TOUR Suľov - Hradná, which ensures quality preparation and service for participants.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque Suľov Rocks with views of rock formations and ridge trails
Elevation gain of up to 850 meters on the longest 17 km course
Three refreshment stations on the route and separate children's categories with their own starts
additional: The participation limit is 1200 runners for the main race and 350 children for the children's race. The children's race is free of charge. Registration is valid only after the registration fee is paid. There is an option for personal registration and payment on the day before the start if the participation limit has not been reached. Starts for children's categories are scheduled between the main race starts. The route includes forest trails and short asphalt sections; registration is possible through the official website; the event is known for its beautiful nature and atmosphere.

name: Grand Prix – Cabaj-Čápor
price_range: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste, zadarmo pre deti a niektoré kategórie
description: Grand Prix Cabaj-Čápor is a traditional cross-country race set in a beautiful natural environment, taking place in the village of Cabaj-Čápor with the start at Salaš Cabaj. Runners can choose from several courses including 10 km, 3 km, and children's races of 600 m and 1000 m. The event is suitable for everyone who wants to experience the atmosphere of sport in nature, whether for competition or for the joy of movement. Registration is open and the number of participants is limited, so it is advisable to register early.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in the nature of Cabaj-Čápor
Courses of 10 km, 3 km, and children's races of 600 m and 1000 m
Start at Salaš Cabaj
additional: The presentation of competitors begins at 9:00 AM. The number of participants is limited. Participants of the main and hobby races receive participation awards. The event takes place on October 10, 2026. Registration is available online, and the race is suitable for all age groups and performance levels.

description: Autumn Run of Michalovce Residents is a traditional running race in Michalovce, offering an opportunity for participants of various age groups. The race takes place at the premises of 2nd Elementary School on J. Švermu 6 and includes a children's run over 400 meters and the main race over 3 kilometers. The event is suitable for families and runners who want to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and sports activities in a pleasant environment. Organizers provide refreshments and commemorative items for participants.
course_highlights: Children's run over 400 m for kids up to 9 years old
Main run over 3 km consisting of 3 laps of 900 m each
Start and finish at the premises of 2nd Elementary School, J. Švermu 6, Michalovce
additional: Participants will receive commemorative items and refreshments are provided. Registration for runners is from 08:00 to 09:15. Results announcement and medal awards are at 10:30. The children's run (500 m) starts at 9:30, the main run (3 km) at 9:45; registration on site; categories for adults, children, and seniors; the event is part of the autumn sports calendar.

name: Beh Myšľou
location: Archeoskanzene Nižná Myšľa, Nižná Myšľa, Slovakia
description: Vyšná Myšľa Running Race is a running event organized by the Vyšná Myšľa Running Club and the municipality of Vyšná Myšľa. The race takes place on the football field in the village of Vyšná Myšľa in the Košice okolí district. The start of the children's categories is at 14:00 and adults at 16:00. Men and women of various age groups can compete, including a relay race for pairs over 2 x 3 km. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere of running sport in the village.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the football field in the village of Vyšná Myšľa
Relay race for pairs over 2 x 3 km
Multiple age categories for men and women
additional: Registration fees are waived for Men E, Women I, members of BKO Vyšná Myšľa, residents of Vyšná Myšľa, and children. The children's race starts at 14:00, and the adult race at 16:00. The race features various distances from 350 m to 8 km, with online registration or on-site registration available. The event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Beh za zdravie – Kuchajda
description: Health Run - Kuchajda is a charitable running event taking place on October 11, 2026, in Bratislava at Kuchajda. This run combines sport with promoting health and community, aiming to help disadvantaged individuals and organizations through movement. Participants can run, walk at a slow pace, or stroll, creating a great atmosphere full of inspiring stories and solidarity. The Health Run is open to all age groups and fitness levels, and also supports charitable projects with a real impact.
course_highlights: Running event at Kuchajda in Bratislava
Supporting health and community through sport
Opportunity to participate regardless of age and fitness
additional: The event is charitable and supports disadvantaged individuals and organizations. Children, adults, and seniors can participate by running, walking at a slow pace, or strolling. Organizers offer the possibility to volunteer and contribute to the success of the event. The event takes place at Kuchajda in Bratislava, promoting health and socially disadvantaged groups. Registration details are not specifically provided.

name: Beh ulicami Krompách
organizer: Mesto Krompachy, Komisia kultúry a športu pri MsZ v Krompachoch

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné: 5,- € okrem žiakov, dorastencov a pretekárov nad  60 rokov

description: The street run in Krompachy is a traditional race in the town of Krompachy, offering categories for children, youth, juniors, men, and women in various age groups. The race takes place in front of the town hall building and is organized by the Town of Krompachy and the Culture and Sports Committee of the Municipal Council in Krompachy. The start is divided into children's and youth categories at 9:30 and adults at 11:00. The entry fee is symbolic, 5 € except for pupils, youth, and runners over 60 years old. The race is suitable for the general public and promotes sports life in the region.
course_highlights: Race runs through the streets of Krompachy
Start and finish in front of the town hall building
Categories for all age groups from children to seniors
additional: The start is divided into 9:30 for children's categories and youth, and 11:00 for adults. Categories are detailed according to age and gender, including several age groups for men and women. The organizer is the Town of Krompachy and the Culture and Sports Committee of the Municipal Council in Krompachy. The event takes place in October, with various categories starting from 9:00, and registration is possible through contact with the organizer. The course is likely urban and street-based.

name: Prešovská hodinovka na tartane
organizer: BK ZasRun, Olympijský klub Prešov, AK TJ Slávia Prešovská univerzita
description: Prešov Hour Run on tartan is a running race organized at the athletics stadium of Prešov University in Prešov. The competition is open to various age categories of men and women and offers a unique opportunity to test your endurance and speed on a tartan track. The organizers are BK ZasRun Šarišské Bohdanovce, Olympic Club Prešov, and AK TJ Slávia Prešov University. The race is suitable for runners who want to experience a quality athletic atmosphere and compete in a pleasant environment of the university stadium.
course_highlights: The race takes place on a tartan track at the Prešov University athletics stadium
Categories divided by age and gender (Men A, Men B, Women F, Women G)
Start and finish on a high-quality athletic surface in Prešov
additional: The event also includes online registration options, taking place on October 15, 2026, at the university's athletics stadium in Prešov.

name: PANORÁMA TRAIL
description: The Panorama Trail is a special trail marathon in the Zemplén Mountains, connecting the historic castles of Boldogkő, Regéc, and Füzér. The 45-kilometer route passes through varied, technical forest trails where nature and history meet. The race is not about time results but about experience and challenge, which can be completed individually or in teams of three. The event welcomes runners in October with premium organization and environmentally conscious approach, during ideal running weather.
course_highlights: 45-kilometer route passing three historic castles
Varied, technical terrain with rocky paths and stream crossings
Multiple refreshment points at Mogyoróskánál, Regéc, Telkibányánál, and Hollóházánál
additional: Race bib pickup is on Friday from 16:00 to 19:00 at the Füzer race center, and on Saturday from 7:30 to 8:45 at the Boldogkővár race center. Individual participants receive a green wristband for luggage transport from start to finish. The race route is well marked but features varied and technical terrain. At the finish, participants receive a medal and free entry to the three castles. After the awards ceremony, a bus departs at 18:00 back to the start. 45 km, three castles, forest and rocky sections, 1800m+ elevation gain, limit of 400 participants, online registration, team and individual categories.

name: VII. Panoráma Trail 45
description: The Panorama Trail is a 45-kilometer trail running race in the Zemplén Mountains, connecting the historic castles of Boldogkő, Regéc, and Füzér. The race is not about time results but about the experience and closeness to nature, where runners traverse rocky paths, cross streams, and run through forested environments. Entries can be made individually or in teams of three, allowing participants to share the challenge. The event offers a premium experience in every detail, from the race packet to the finisher’s medal received at the finish line.
course_highlights: 45-kilometer distance passing three historic castles
Varied, technical terrain with rocky paths and stream crossings
Multiple refreshment points along the course (Mogyoróska, Regéc, Telkibánya, Hollóháza)
additional: Race number pickup is on Friday from 16:00 to 19:00 at the Füzér race center, and on Saturday from 7:30 to 8:45 at the Boldogkővár race center. Individual participants receive a green wristband for baggage transport. The race route is well marked but features varied and technical terrain. At the finish, participants receive a medal and free entry to the three castles. After the awards ceremony, a bus departs at 18:00 back to the start. 45 km trail, 1800m+ elevation gain, 10% asphalt, connecting three castles, natural terrain.

name: Psotkov memoriál
location: Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, Prešovský kraj, Slovakia
description: Psotko's Memorial is a traditional mountain running race in the Tatra Mountains, held in Štrbské Pleso. The race offers two challenging routes - BASIC with a length of 25.3 km and an elevation gain of +1540 m, and EXTREME with a length of 37.9 km and an elevation gain of +2490 m. The routes pass through beautiful mountain scenery, including the surroundings of Kriváň, Jamské Pleso, and Furkotská Valley, and are intended for experienced runners with good fitness. The race is part of the Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia 2026 and is limited to 400 participants.
course_highlights: The route passes over Štrbské Pleso and below the summit of Kriváň
Refreshment stations at Tri Studničky and near the lower station of the cable car
Beautiful mountain trails along Jamské Pleso and Furkotská Valley
additional: Registration is limited to 400 participants (200 for BASIC and 200 for EXTREME). Members of the Slovak Mountaineering Association James receive a discount on the entry fee. The EXTREME route is run as a timed race. The time limit for BASIC is 6 hours, for EXTREME 8 hours. The start and finish are in the SNOW cross-country skiing area - Štrba, Štrbské Pleso. Registration is open from June 1 to September 30, 2025; limit of 400 participants; the registration fee includes refreshments, a commemorative badge, and trail security; course parameters and mountain insurance are included.

name: Podvihorlatský kros
location: Futbalové ihrisko (amfiteáter), Poruba pod Vihorlatom, Slovakia
description: Podvihorlatský cross-country is a running event held in Poruba pod Vihorlatom on a football field (amphitheater). The race offers starts for children's categories as well as the main category, with the course mainly running on field and forest paths with 30% asphalt surface. The organizer is Mgr. Ján Podstavský with the support of the municipality of Poruba pod Vihorlatom. The event is part of the Running League Michalovce - Sobrance 2025 and offers categories for various age groups and Nordic walking.
course_highlights: 70% field and forest path, 30% asphalt
Course runs through the natural environment of Vihorlat
Start and finish at the football field (amphitheater) in Poruba pod Vihorlatom
additional: The start of children's categories is at 9:00 AM, the main category starts at 11:00 AM. Categories are divided by age and gender, including Nordic walking. The event is supported by the municipality of Poruba pod Vihorlatom and is part of the Running League Michalovce - Sobrance 2025. Course: forest and asphalt paths, online registration until 16.10.2025, start times at 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM, categories for various age groups and performance levels, registration also includes a charitable contribution.

name: Extrém Maratón Oščadnica
organizer: Obec Oščadnica, Klub turistov Oščadnica, extremmaraton.sk
description: The Extreme Oščadnica Marathon is a mountain marathon set amidst the picturesque nature of Kysuce, mainly along mountain ridges offering beautiful views of Veľká Rača. The 42-kilometer course with an elevation gain of nearly 1700 meters tests endurance, strength, and love for the mountains. The event is not a race but an experiential run that emphasizes the joy of movement, friendship, and willpower. Organizers provide complete services including refreshments, a T-shirt, and a communal gathering after the run.
course_highlights: 42 km course with an elevation gain of nearly 1700 m
Mainly mountain ridges with views of Veľká Rača (1236 m.a.s.l.)
Refreshment stations approximately every 8 km
additional: The presentation of runners is on 17.10.2026 from 06:30 to 08:30 at the Cultural House in Oščadnica. The marathon has a time limit of 7 hours, with a 5-hour limit to reach Veľká Rača, after which the organizer does not guarantee refreshments. Registration is only possible online, or on-site if the start list is not full. Registration closes once the limit of 200 participants is reached. The registration fee includes a T-shirt, storage, showers, on-trail and finish line refreshments, a medal, and an after-party. Registration is possible online, with a participant limit of 200, and includes a T-shirt, refreshments, a medal, and an after-party.

name: Rozhanovská dvanástka
organizer: Obec Rozhanovce, Občianske združenie KŠK Rozhanovce
price_range: 15 € online pred 9.10.2025, 20 € po tejto dátume a na mieste
description: Rozhanovská dvanástka is a running race held at the amphitheater area in Rozhanovce. It offers two main categories - a short course of 6 km and a long course of 12 km, suitable for both men and women. The race is organized by the municipality of Rozhanovce and the civic association KŠK Rozhanovce and is suitable for runners of various levels. The race is scheduled to start on October 17, 2026, with children's races beginning at 10:45 AM and the main courses at 11:00 AM.
course_highlights: Course runs in the amphitheater area of Rozhanovce
Two categories: short course 6 km and long course 12 km
Races for men and women with children's races available
additional: Children's races start at 10:45 AM. The entry fee can be paid online or on-site. The organizers are the municipality of Rozhanovce and the civic association KŠK Rozhanovce. The contact person is Ing. Matúš Adamčík, phone: +421 908 909 779. The race also includes a children's run, starting at 10:45 AM, with the course likely outdoors around Rozhanovce.

name: II. Dél-Balatoni Csillagó Trail
location: Gutman Borpince, Kötcse, Somogy County, Hungary
description: The II. South Balaton Starry Trail is a scenic running race scheduled for October 18, 2026, in Kötcsé, near Gutman Winery. The race takes participants through the hills of Somogy, along panoramic routes around Starry Hill and its surroundings, with various distances including a half marathon and relay races. Participants can run among beautiful autumn vineyards, forests, and historic sites, while at the finish line they will receive a unique finisher's medal and gifts. The event's atmosphere is enhanced by the Starry Trail Festival wine glass, allowing runners to taste local wines alongside the running experience.
course_highlights: Panoramic summit of Starry Hill at 313.5 meters
Varied terrain through autumn vineyards and Somogy forests
Touch of Romantic White Stone Castle and Nezde Saka Golkota on the half marathon route
additional: The race takes place at Gutman Winery, a historic brewery site offering stunning Balaton views. The race kits include gifts and a Starry Trail Festival wine glass for participants. Multiple distances and age categories are available, including mini and junior races for preschoolers and children aged 7-10, as well as a virtual completion option. The event features trail running and hiking, wines, outdoor cooking, a family-friendly atmosphere, and views of the autumn Balaton landscape.

name: Veresegyház Futónap
description: The Veresegyház Running Day is a family-friendly running event held around the Búcsú Square in Veresegyház. Participants can choose from several distances, from a mini run to a half marathon, and can compete individually or in teams. The race is also a point collection station for the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to earn points and rewards. Team running is a separate category where teams of three compete, but each team member must complete the distance individually. The event is a friendly, community-oriented occasion that promotes the joy of running and a sporty lifestyle.
course_highlights: Distances: mini run (300 m), 3 km, 7 km, 14 km, 21 km
Team running with 3-person teams, not relay race
Race location: Búcsú Square, Veresegyház, urban park area
additional: Team running is free of charge, but only participants with valid individual registration can participate. Team registration must be submitted via email with the names, distances, and team name of the three runners. The race is a point collection station for the Ötpróba program; registration with a voucher is also possible, providing a discount of 5000 HUF for all distances except the mini run. The event features sponsorships, medical supervision, a health screening bus, refreshing massages, a raffle, and Ötpróba program point collection for participants.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 10. kolo
description: The 2-Mile Run Bratislava is a regular running competition on a 2-mile (3.218 km) course with categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. The race takes place in Bratislava at Kuchajda and is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. The start is traditionally at 10:00 AM, and there are also children's runs of approximately 200 meters. The 2-Mile Run Bratislava is part of a series of events held throughout the year, offering opportunities for runners of various age groups and performance levels.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.218 km)
Children run approximately 200 meters
The race takes place in the pleasant environment of Kuchajda in Bratislava
additional: Categories: children (13 years and under), juniors, women, men, veterans. Organizer: Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. Phone contacts: +421 2 444 542 61, +421 905 648 315. The race is held on a road surface in Kuchajda, registration is possible on-site, and the start is scheduled for 10:00 AM. The event includes categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans.

name: Challenge Airport Run
location: Vojenská letecká základňa v Prešove, Prešov, Slovakia
organizer: Prešov Running, v spolupráci s Vojenskou leteckou základňou v Prešove
price_range: 22 € až 25 € v závislosti od termínu registrácie, 12 € pre detský beh
description: Challenge Airport Run is a unique running experience at the Military Air Base in Prešov, combining sport with the atmosphere of military training. Runners can choose between a 5 km and a 10 km course, with each participant carrying a symbolic load-bearing backpack, emphasizing courage and endurance. The event offers an unparalleled atmosphere among helicopters and military equipment, which is rarely accessible to the public. Besides athletic performance, it is also a tribute to discipline and strength, with a rich accompanying program and original start packages.
course_highlights: The course runs through the premises of the Military Air Base in Prešov
Runners carry a load-bearing backpack symbolizing tradition and endurance
Atmosphere among helicopters and military equipment with an army style
additional: Start number with chip, medal in the shape of a dog tag, T-shirts with military design, accompanying program with raffle, possibility of children's races, hydration provided, start packages in army style. The event includes asphalt and panel roads, categories with military equipment, start from 9:00 to 9:15, participants can join with military gear or as civilian runners.

name: Slaňaki CUP – Beh do vrchu Dubník
location: Dubník, Zámutov, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
organizer: Klub otužilcov Vranovské Vydry, Obecný úrad Zámutov, Penzión Kondor Zámutov

price_tiers.distance: Slaňaki CUP – Beh do vrchu Dubník

description: Slaňaki CUP - Uphill Run Dubník is a traditional uphill race held in Zámutov, Vranov nad Topľou district. The course is 11.2 km long with an elevation gain of 600 meters, and the finish line is at the highest building in Slovakia, the Dubník transmitter at an altitude of 318 meters. The race is part of the Slovak Uphill Running Cup and is open to a wide range of male and female runners of various ages. Organizers include the Vranovské Vydry Cold Water Swimmers Club, the Zámutov Municipal Office, and Penzión Kondor Zámutov. The race offers a challenge for runners who want to test their endurance and strength in demanding mountain terrain.
course_highlights: Course length of 11.2 km with an elevation gain of 600 m
Finish at the highest building in Slovakia - Dubník transmitter (318 m)
Challenging mountain terrain suitable for uphill running
additional: Categories are divided by age and gender, including juniors, men, and women in various age groups. The start is in front of the Zámutov Municipal Office. Organizers are Vranovské Vydry Cold Water Swimmers Club, Zámutov Municipal Office, and Penzión Kondor Zámutov. The race takes place in October 2026, with online registration available. The event also includes refreshments and a commemorative run.

name: SZÁDVÁR TRAIL
description: The Compressport Szádvár Trail is an exciting trail running race that takes participants through the wild mountains and valleys of the Aggtelek Karst. Participants can discover deer hiding in the forest, a monastery ruin nestled among the trees, the challenging ascent of Szádvár, the panoramic view from Esztramos Mountain, and the charming wine cellar row near Bódvaszilas. This demanding race will be held in October in Szögliget, inviting adventure seekers.
course_highlights: Wild mountains and valleys of the Aggtelek Karst
Monastery ruin among the trees
Panoramic view from Esztramos Mountain
additional: The race takes place in October 2026, and the terrain is diverse, featuring mountains, valleys, and forests. Participants can register online, and during the race, they can enjoy the scenic landscape and the challenging course.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap Running Race is held in Dióskert, where participants can complete the half marathon distance in four laps. For those who wish to run fewer laps, there is an option to complete fewer rounds. The race operates with a voluntary registration fee of 500 HUF per lap, and registration takes place on-site. After the race, runners are welcomed with apples, hot tea, and mulled wine. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three male and female finishers receive a special medal. The award ceremony takes place at 12:00 PM.
course_highlights: The race route consists of 4 laps for the half marathon distance
Option to run fewer laps
Location: Törökbálint, Dióskert
additional: Registration is on-site, recommended voluntary registration fee of 500 HUF per lap. All participants are welcomed with apples, hot tea, and mulled wine. Award ceremony at 12:00 PM. The top three male and female finishers receive a unique medal. hilly terrain, 4 rounds for a half marathon, options for fewer rounds, refreshments provided, medals for all, awards for top finishers

name: Beh hrebeňom Čergova
description: The Čergov Ridge Run is the longest mountain race in the Čergov Mountains, designed for outdoor running enthusiasts and trained runners. The course runs from the village of Kamenica through the highest peaks of the range, such as Minčol, Dvoriská, Solisko, Veľká Javorina, Čergov, Lysá, and Sedlo Besná, with a length of 32 km and an elevation gain of 1413 meters. Runners can enjoy beautiful panoramic views and challenging terrain on hiking trails. The race takes place on October 24, 2026, starting at 9:00 AM at Farma Kamenica and finishing at Sedlo Besná near Hotel Šport Lysá.
course_highlights: 32 km mountain run with an elevation gain of 1413 m
Crossing the highest peaks of Čergov: Minčol, Dvoriská, Solisko, Veľká Javorina, Čergov, Lysá, Sedlo Besná
The course runs along marked hiking trails with blue and green signs
additional: A large bus will be provided for all participants, transporting them from the village of Drienica to Kamenica in the morning (departure at 7:15 AM from the parking lot near Hotel JAVORNÁ). The organizer also provides transportation for personal belongings from the start to the finish. Participant registration is from 7:00 to 8:30 AM on race day at Farma Kamenica. Results announcement and lunch are at Hotel Šport Lysá. The race is held on October 24, 2026, and is open to men and women of various age categories, with the opportunity to participate in mountain trail running in the beautiful environment of the Čergov Mountains.

name: Rajecká 12-minútovka
location: Ihrisko pri ZŠ na Lipovej ulici, Rajec, Slovakia
description: Rajecká 12-minute run is a dynamic race organized by the Rajec Marathon Club, held on the playground near the elementary school on Lipová Street in Rajec. This short, intense run is ideal for runners of all levels who want to test their speed and endurance within a limited time. The event is part of the regional running tradition and offers a pleasant atmosphere with support from the local community. Organizers ensure quality course preparation and a friendly environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Run on the playground near the elementary school on Lipová Street in Rajec
Intensive 12-minute time limit
Pleasant atmosphere with support from the local community
additional: Registration is conducted online with an option for late payment for an additional fee. The event is suitable for all age groups and running levels. Refreshments and results evaluation are provided on-site after the run. The race takes place on the playground near the elementary school on Lipová Street in Rajec, with the opportunity to improve personal records in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Beh vinicami Bojničiek a Hlohovca
location: Cultural center near the church, Bojničky, Trnava District, Slovakia
