description: Running race through the vineyards of Bojničky and Hlohovec is an athletic event organized by the Bojničky Athletic Club and the municipality of Bojničky. The race takes place at the cultural center near the church in Bojničky and offers categories for men, women, and Nordic walking over a 6 km course. The registration fee is available online and on-site, with a discount for students. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of various age groups.
course_highlights: Course runs through the vineyards of Bojničky and Hlohovec
Categories for men, women, and Nordic walking
Start at the cultural center near the church in Bojničky
additional: Categories: Men (M, M 40, M 50, M 60), Women (Ž, Ž 40, Ž 50), Nordic walking for men and women over 6 km. Registration can be paid online or on the day of the race. The event also includes Nordic walking, with online registration available. The venue is the cultural center near the church in Bojničky.

name: Ružínska desiatka
price_range: 15,-€ online, 20,-€ na mieste; detské preteky 5,-€ online, 7,-€ na mieste
description: The Ružín Ten is a running race organized by the Jaklovce Sports Club in cooperation with the Jaklovce municipality, held near the Ružín Dam. The course mainly runs on asphalt with a small portion of gravel, offering a fast and pleasant run. Men and women of various age groups can compete in 10 km and 5 km categories, with children's races also available. The main categories start at 11:00, and children's categories begin at 10:00. The race is suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all levels.
course_highlights: 90% asphalt surface, 10% gravel (macadam)
The route runs around the Ružín Dam in Jaklovce
Categories for men, women, and children of various age groups
additional: Children's categories start at 10:00, main categories at 11:00. Categories include various age groups of men and women, with absolute rankings and special awards for the oldest, youngest, and best Jaklovce residents. The course surface is mainly asphalt with a small portion of gravel. The race features 5 km and 10 km categories, children's races, a raffle, and a bouncy castle.

name: Račiansky kros – jeseň
location: Knižková dolina, Bratislava – Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Račiansky Cross - Autumn is a traditional running race held in Bratislava, in the Knižková Valley area, Bratislava - Rača. The race offers runners the opportunity to experience the autumn atmosphere in a pleasant environment of the amphitheater and its surroundings. Organizers OZ PERUN ensure quality preparation and refreshments for participants. The event is suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of various age groups.
course_highlights: Race in the natural environment of Knižková Valley
Start and finish at the Bratislava - Rača amphitheater
Autumn atmosphere and quality refreshments
additional: Registration and consent of the data subject are available on the website. The organizer is OZ PERUN. IBAN for payments: SK09 8330 0000 0025 0082 7935. The course consists of 80% forest paths and 20% asphalt; the race is intended for men, women, and children; registration is possible online and on-site with a limited number of starters; the event also includes children's races and refreshments after the race.

name: T1 Ring kros
location: Areál T1 ring, Vechec, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
description: T1 Ring Cross is a running race held at the T1 ring premises in Vechec, Vranov nad Topľou district. The race offers two main routes - 9 km with an elevation gain of approximately 210 meters and a 4 km route, including a non-competitive Nordic Walking discipline. Men and women of various age categories can compete, with children starting separately. The race is part of the Michalovce - Sobrance Running League 2025, starting at 13:00 for the main category and at 11:00 for children.
course_highlights: 9 km route with approximately 210 meters elevation gain
4 km hobby route and non-competitive Nordic Walking discipline
Race held at the T1 ring premises in Vechec
additional: Children start at 11:00. Categories for men and women by age. Part of the Michalovce - Sobrance Running League 2025. The race takes place at the T1 ring premises, with online registration available as well as on-site registration, entry fee from 8 to 20 euros, races start at 11:00 and 13:00.

name: Košickopolianska desiatka
description: Košickopolianska desiatka is a running event organized by the municipality of Košická Polianka, held in front of the cultural house in Košická Polianka. The main race starts at 1:00 PM, with children's categories beginning at 11:00 AM. The race is divided into several age categories for men, women, and children, allowing broad participation of runners of various ages. The organizers welcome all runners who want to enjoy a sports day in a pleasant village environment.
course_highlights: Start and finish in front of the cultural house in Košická Polianka
Multiple age categories for men, women, and children
Pleasant village environment in Košická Polianka
additional: Children's races start at 11:00 AM. Categories are divided by age from 0 years up to seniors. The organizer is the municipality of Košická Polianka, with contact phone numbers and emails available for those interested in information. The race is part of a series of annual events and offers the opportunity to participate in a 10 km course with various categories for all age groups, including children's races.

name: ÍROTTKŐ HEGYI FUTÓVERSENY
location: Kőszeg, Kincs pihenő, Kőszeg, Vas County, Hungary
description: The Írottkő Mountain Running Race is a special trail running event held in the wild landscapes of the Kőszeg Mountains. Participants can choose from several distances, from the short 7 km introductory run to the challenging 102 km ultra distance, which also extends into Austria. The race takes place on varied terrain, including steep ascents and forests, providing runners with an unforgettable experience of nature and panoramic views. A unique feature of the race is the team-based ultra distance, emphasizing shared experience and endurance.
course_highlights: 102 km ultra distance through the most scenic spots of the Kőszeg Mountains
The 23 km distance with 780 meters of elevation gain and panoramic views from the Írottkő peak
Varied terrain with steep climbs, descents, and technical sections
additional: The race is semi-self-sufficient, requiring runners to bring their own equipment, such as headlamps and rain jackets. Two refreshment points are available along the 23 km course. The event is environmentally conscious, with a zero waste program. Accommodation options are available in Kőszeg and nearby areas. An archive photo collection from previous races is available on the website. Participation requires online registration, and organizers also offer accommodation suggestions and environmentally friendly approaches.

name: FUSS EGY NAPOT!
description: The "Fuss egy napot!" is an ultramarathon event held at Benkó Zoltán Park in Kecskemét. The aim of the event is to promote a healthy lifestyle and create a community sports experience. Runners can test their strength over various distances in a friendly and supportive environment. The program includes carnival atmosphere and the joy of collective movement.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon around the Benkó hill
Natural, varied terrain
Community and carnival atmosphere
additional: Participants can choose from several distances; the registration deadline is November 5, 2025. There are limited facilities on-site for changing clothes and equipment, and access to the lake is not guaranteed during the run.

name: HALLOWEEN RUN
description: The Halloween Run 2026 is a special, exciting running event in Budapest, on the premises and cellar system of the former Kőbánya Brewery. Participants will run along a dark, eerie course with ghostly figures and spooky effects accompanying them. The races are held over various distances, from short tours to longer, multi-lap races, so everyone can find a suitable option. At the end of the race, music and celebration await the brave participants who have overcome the challenges.
course_highlights: Route through the premises and cellar system of the former Kőbánya Brewery
Dark, spooky visual effects and frightening effects
Varied distances, including a 21 km circuit race and tunnel running
additional: The race takes place in Budapest's X district, at Rottenbiller Park. Easily accessible by public transport, parking options are limited. The race program includes multiple runs, from the 2.5 km Halloween tours to the 21 km individual and relay races. Registration on site is possible until 45 minutes before the start of the race, provided online registration is not full. The awards ceremony begins at 15:40. Multiple races, themed dark atmosphere, various distances, location Budapest, Rottenbiller Park, online and on-site registration, award ceremonies.

name: VASKAPU TRAIL
organizer: Esztergomi Triatlon Kulturális és Szabadidősport Egyesület
description: The Vaskapu Trail is a nature-oriented trail running race in Esztergom, offering challenges on three different distances: 8 km, 16 km, and 22 km. The race route runs on trails and marked hiking paths, with minimal road sections, allowing participants to enjoy the beauty of nature and the varied terrain. The event is environmentally conscious, featuring cup-free refreshment stations and supported by the Green Forest program. The start and finish are at the Vaskapu Restaurant, at the Brilli Gyula shelter, where runners also have access to comfortable changing and luggage storage facilities.
course_highlights: Trail running on trails and marked hiking paths
Three distances: 8 km, 16 km, and 22 km with varying difficulty levels
Minimal road sections, close to nature experience
additional: The race uses chip timing, which can be rented for a deposit of 2000 HUF. The event is cup-free, so participants must bring their own water bottle or cup. Race packets are available on the race day at the race center; early pickup is not possible. Registration cancellations are accepted until October 15, 2026; afterward, registration can only be transferred to the next year. Separate female and male changing rooms and built-in toilets are available at the race center; there are no washbasins. Every finisher receives a medal, and the top three female and male overall finishers will receive special awards. Hydration equipment is mandatory for the race, and on-site changing and luggage storage services are provided. Environmentally friendly solutions are implemented to support participants.

name: Feldwar Trail 1 / 5 / 10 / 17 / 23
description: The Feldwar Trail is a friendly, family-oriented trail running race through the hills of Dunaföldvár, offering a stunning panorama and an impressive start/finish area at the Ispánház. Participants can choose from several distances, from children's races to the 23 km course, with separate awards for women and men categories. The routes mostly run on dirt roads with minimal paved sections, allowing participants to enjoy close contact with nature. The race operates as an eco-friendly event, and organizers ask runners to bring their own water bottles or cups to refreshment points.
course_highlights: Trail running routes through the hills of Dunaföldvár
Beautiful panoramic views of the southern Danube Bend from the Calvary and the ridge along the Danube
Mostly dirt roads with minimal paved sections
additional: On-site registration on November 8, 2026, Sunday from 9:00 to 10:00 (children at 9:45). Instant race opportunity available within one year after November 10, 2025, with prior arrangement, fee 3,000 HUF. Chip timing with Traxpace system, online partial results. The race is limited to 400 participants, including a maximum of 100 preschool and elementary school children. Disposable cups are not provided at refreshment points; participants are asked to bring their own water bottles or cups. The approximate cutoff time is for informational purposes; finishers will receive a medal regardless of whether they finish within the time limit. Distances: 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, 17 km, 23 km; refreshment points available for different distances; chip timing; instant race option; children's races; group or individual registration; awards in each category.

name: GARMIN WTF BUDA

description: The Garmin WTF BUDA is a special trail running race in the Buda Hills, offering both asphalt and trail distances. Participants can choose from trail distances of 7, 12, 21, and 32 km, as well as asphalt distances of 10 and 18 km. The race is part of a unique hybrid event series where trail and road runners start together and celebrate their achievements at the finish line. The time limit for all distances is 5 hours, with additional partial time limits for longer distances to ensure safe completion. The registration fee includes refreshments, timing, baggage storage, and custom medals.
course_highlights: Trail half marathon 21 km with 726 m elevation gain
Trail XL 32 km with 1037 m elevation gain, time limit 5 hours
Mixed trail and asphalt routes around Budapest Szépjuhászné railway station
additional: Refreshment stations, free event photos, baggage storage, changing rooms, and medical services are available at all distances. The top three days' registrants receive a running hydration vest as a gift. At the finish line, medalists can choose from current medals. Results will be announced at 12:30 and 14:00, and a raffle will be held for participants. Various distances and categories are available between the races, with participation including a medal, refreshment stations, photos, and a running pack. Registration opens on August 29, 2025, with early and late bird prices available.

name: Tanúhegyek Trail 7 / 21 / 42
description: The Tanúhegyek Trail is a trail running race organized by the Terepfutó Műhely Sportegyesület in one of the most beautiful parts of the Balaton Uplands National Park, in Badacsonytomaj. Participants can choose from 7 km, 21 km, and 42 km distances, each involving conquering 1, 3, or 5 Tanúhegy peaks, with stunning views of Lake Balaton and the surrounding landscape. The start and finish are at the Halászkert, and the race also serves a charitable purpose, with the timing chip deposit fee being donationable to the Ürömi Állatotthon. The shortest distance includes a dog-friendly race, and everyone is welcome to participate in the event scheduled for November 14, 2026.
course_highlights: Trail running in the Balaton Uplands National Park
Spectacular views of Lake Balaton and the autumn-colored landscape
Route conquering 1, 3, or 5 Tanúhegy peaks
additional: Timing is electronic, using a chip, with a deposit fee of 2000 HUF, which can be refunded or donated to charity. There may be unannounced control points along the route. A dog-friendly race is held on the shortest distance. The race does not close public roads, so traffic rules must be observed. Distances: 7 km, 21 km, 42 km; dog race on the 7 km course; charity event with the timing chip deposit fee.

name: Beh na Minčol
description: The Minčol Run is the most challenging uphill race in the nearby area, taking place through the beautiful surroundings of the Višňovská Valley. The route starts in the valley and continues with a steep ascent to the main ridge up to the summit of Minčol, offering stunning views of the Krivánska and Lúčanská parts of the Malá Fatra. Runners can look forward to a demanding profile with minimal rest opportunities and a final steep climb, where most will opt for brisk walking. After finishing, refreshments and participant evaluation with prizes for the best in each category are provided.
course_highlights: The route is marked with a blue tourist trail sign
Steep challenging ascents from start to finish
Beautiful views from Minčol's summit of Krivánska and Lúčanská parts of Malá Fatra
additional: The start is at the parking lot at the valley entrance, with the finish at the top of Minčol (1363 meters above sea level). Refreshments are available on the course at approximately 2 km and at the finish line. After the race, a meal (homemade cabbage soup and a drink) is served at the Holý Diel ski resort. Participants have the option to leave their belongings in a drop bag, which will be transported to the base area along with the results announcement. The top three in each category will be awarded if at least three runners start in that category. The event is part of the traditional running calendar in Malá Fatra, with online registration, refreshments on the course and at the finish, and awards for the fastest runners. After the race, a traditional cabbage soup and social program are prepared.

This race offers a unique experience connected with the cultural environment of the museum and the surrounding nature. The race is part of the Zemplínsky extrém series, which includes several events in the region. Runners can expect an interesting course with an autumn atmosphere and a touch of local history.
course_highlights: The course runs through the premises of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce
Autumn environment with a cultural touch
Part of the Zemplínsky extrém series with multiple events
additional: The event takes place on November 14, 2026, featuring several categories including children, and is held at the premises of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce.

description: The Jastrabské Vŕšky Run is the 3rd edition of the Ján Dobák Memorial, held in the village of Šarišské Jastrabie. The race offers categories for children and adults with various age groups and disciplines, including a 10 km run and a 5 km run for men and women, as well as Nordic walking. The start for children is at 12:30 PM and for adults at 2:00 PM. The organizers are the Municipality of Šarišské Jastrabie and the Elementary School with Kindergarten Šarišské Jastrabie, welcoming runners of all ages and levels.

Categories for different age groups and disciplines including Nordic walking

The event includes 5 km and 10 km routes, with registration available online and on-site; prices vary depending on the category and registration method. name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 11. kolo
description: The 2-Mile Run Bratislava is a regular running race over a distance of 2 miles (3.218 km), held at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. It is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team and is part of a series of races with scoring based on categories for men and women. Registration takes place directly on-site at the volleyball court from 9:30 AM, with the start at 10:00 AM. Competitors include children, juniors, women, men, and veterans, and participants can earn points for improving their times throughout the year.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.218 km)
Registration and start at the volleyball court within the Kuchajda swimming complex
Categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans

In case of a tie in points, the best time is the deciding factor, followed by shoe size. At the end of the year, the two months with the lowest points are canceled (amnesty). Registration can be done on-site; the event takes place in various rounds throughout the year, with each run approximately 2 miles (3.218 km) long.

description: Husárik Run is a traditional running race organized by the Kysucké Maratón Club Čadca, the town of Čadca, and the Husárik Mountain Hotel. This race is held in honor of Student Day and offers runners the opportunity to test their strength in a beautiful mountain environment. The start is always at 11:00 AM, and the race is known for its friendly atmosphere and the mayor's cup of Čadca as a prize for the winners. Husárik Run is suitable for the general public interested in sports and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain environment around Husárik Mountain Hotel
Race in honor of Student Day
Mayor's cup of Čadca for the winners
additional: Online registration has ended; registration is also possible on the day of the race with an increased entry fee of 8 EUR. The race takes place on November 15, 2026, with a start at 11:00 AM. Online registration is available. The course is hilly and trail-based, organized in Čadca near the Husárik Mountain Hotel.

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Strážske
organizer: Mesto Strážske, bežecký klub MBO Strážske
description: The Liberation Run of the town of Strážske is a traditional sporting event that commemorates the anniversary of the town's liberation each year. This 49th edition attracted runners of various age groups, from children to adults, competing on different distances. The atmosphere is sporty and friendly, with awards for the fastest runners and a rich history of winners. The organizer is the town of Strážske in cooperation with the MBO Strážske running club, which supports the development of running sports in the region.
course_highlights: Multiple categories by age and gender
Courses suitable for youth and adults
Historical tradition since 1970
additional: The event has a long-standing tradition with awards for the fastest runners in each category. After the run, prizes are awarded, including a raffle with valuable prizes such as a mountain bike. In the past, over 300 runners participated, including local and international athletes. The event includes several categories, and results and historical winners are publicly available. Registration is possible online, and the course details are not specified.

Participants run through the city streets along a course approximately 5.8 km long, consisting of several loops. After finishing, they can enjoy refreshments and receive a participant medal. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere with the opportunity for personal presentation on the race day.
course_highlights: Evening run through the center of Michalovce
Course length of 5.8 km, composed of loops of 1,450 m each
Refreshments and participant medal after finishing

After finishing, race numbers are returned and participants receive a medal. Results announcement is at 19:30 in the gymnasium of 8th Elementary School P. Horova. The course is shortened to 5.8 km, run on asphalt and stone surfaces. Registration is possible online or on-site, with an entry fee of 20 €, reduced for online registration until 19.11.2025.

The route goes along paved forest roads, trails, field paths, and asphalt, creating a pleasant and diverse running environment. The race is open to all age categories without division into age groups and is organized by the civic association Šemša v pohybe. The start is divided into two waves, with the longer route starting at 10:00 AM and the shorter routes at 11:00 AM. The event is suitable for runners seeking forest running with varying difficulty and trail lengths.

Three course lengths: 22 km, 11 km, and 5.5 km

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly, volunteer-organized running race in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint, which covers the half marathon distance by completing four laps. Participants can run as many laps as they wish, with a suggested registration fee of 500 HUF per lap to support the event costs. Every participant is greeted with an apple, hot tea, and mulled wine, and receives a commemorative medal; the top three male and female finishers also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and registration is on-site.
course_highlights: The course is located in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint
The half marathon distance is completed by running 4 laps
Participants can run as many laps as they wish
additional: Registration is on-site, with a recommended voluntary registration fee of 500 HUF per lap. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and the top three male and female finishers also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. After the race, warm tea, mulled wine, and apples are available for participants. 4 laps constitute a half marathon, but fewer laps can be run. Registration is on-site. Refreshments included.

name: ADVENTI JÓTÉKONY FUTÁS
description: The Advent Charity Run is a cozy, family-friendly running event in Bölcske, where participants can test their strength over a 3 or 6-kilometer distance. A portion of the registration fee goes to charitable causes, making the run not only a sport activity but also a helping initiative. The event is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners who want to participate in a pleasant winter running program.
course_highlights: Choose between 3 or 6 km distance
Family-friendly, charity-focused running event
In the natural surroundings of Bölcske
additional: 500 forints of the registration fee will be donated to charity. Participants can choose to run either 3 or 6 kilometers. There is also an option for a family registration on a 2 km course, with up to 4 participants. The event supports charitable causes; registration fee payment is mandatory. Participation is open to all age groups. The race takes place in Bölcske, Csorda út 1435/6.

name: ADVENTI KOCOGÓ
description: The Advent Jogging is a charity running event held at the Zoltán Benkó Leisure Center in Kecskemét. The purpose of the run is to raise funds to support children fighting Duchenne muscular dystrophy, including Marci Nemes, for the NM Muscles Healing Foundation. The event offers community solidarity and a sporty experience for participants while serving a noble cause. The organizers thank all runners and volunteers who contributed to its success.
course_highlights: The run takes place at the Zoltán Benkó Leisure Center
Charity event supporting children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy
Community and sporty experience for families and runners
additional: Volunteers also participate in the background work of the event. The run is organized for charity, supporting the local foundation and sick children. The event is part of the Advent preparations, with the run supporting the healing of sick children, and it is traditionally held every year to foster community unity.

name: STOP-MIKULÁS FUTÁS
description: The Stop Santa Run is a traditional, family-friendly running race in Tatabánya, which was held for the 33rd time in 2025. The race features three distances: 200 meters for young children, and 1900 and 5900 meters for adults and seniors. More than 200 participants took part in the event, each receiving a unique finisher medal, and Santa's gifts are also waiting for the youngest runners. The atmosphere of the race is family-like, with many prizes and special awards given out by the organizers, and participants can celebrate December birthdays with cake and pastries.
course_highlights: Three distances: 200 m, 1900 m, and 5900 m

Family-friendly atmosphere with Santa gifts for children

The main sponsors of the event are Tatabányai SC and Stop Cukrászda, which offer cake and pastries to participants. The oldest participant completed the longest distance at the age of 87. Community support, award ceremonies, gifts, and a joyful winter running celebration.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 12. kolo

The race is open to a wide range of categories including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on-site from 9:30 AM, and the start is at 10:00 AM. The competition is part of a series where runners earn points towards the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team's Traveling Cup, with finishing times converted according to coefficients based on the year of birth.

In case of a tie in points, the year of birth and the best time of the year are decisive. An amnesty is announced for two participations, during which the two months with the lowest points are canceled. The races have various rounds throughout the year, including the December 12th round. Registration is possible on-site; details about the price are not specified, and the course is mostly asphalt in an urban environment.

Traditional New Year's Eve run with a long-standing history

The race takes place in the village of Bojničky in front of the Cultural House and is part of the Nitrianska Running League 2026. Participants can include children, juniors, adults, and Nordic Walking enthusiasts, with categories based on age and gender. A new addition is a competition for three-member teams of men and women in 5000 m Nordic Walking. The race start is divided by categories from 9:45 AM to 12:15 PM.
course_highlights: The race takes place in front of the Cultural House in Bojničky

Categories for children, juniors, adults, and Nordic Walking

name: Timravine Ostrôžky Trail
description: Timravine Ostrôžky Trail is a mountain running race in Divína offering two challenging courses with beautiful views and significant elevation gain. The race is organized by OZ Ostrôžky and is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in nature. The Ostrôžky ultra course is 47 km long with an elevation gain of 2000 m, while the Langoš trail is shorter at 27 km with an elevation gain of 950 m. The race start is divided into two waves, with the longer course starting at 7:30 and the shorter at 9:00.

Langoš trail: 27 km with 950 m elevation gain
Mountain trails with beautiful views around Divína
additional: The race start is divided into two waves: the 47 km course starts at 7:30, the 27 km course at 9:00. The organizer is Lukáš Krnáč and OZ Ostrôžky. The registration fee varies according to the deadlines, with the highest fee on the day of the race. Trail races with various categories, online registration, race starts at 07:30 and 09:00, and in 2026 it will be held for the second time after the first edition in 2025.

description: The Liberation Run in Kálnica is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Kálnica in honor of the fallen Romanian soldiers during the liberation of the village. The race takes place on a route from Kálnica to Rakoľúby and back, with various distances for different age categories. The surface of the course is asphalt, flat with slight elevation and turns. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who can run accompanied by an adult. The start of the race is at the Cultural House in Kálnica.

Distances: 1500 m, 5500 m, and 11000 m
Asphalt surface with slight elevation of 36 m
additional: Online registration ends on 10.4.2025 at 23:55 or when the participant limit is reached. After this date, registration on-site on the day of the race is possible if the limit has not been exceeded. Paid entry fee is non-refundable but can be transferred to another person via the account on vysledkovyservis.sk or for a handling fee of 4 € without an account. The course is asphalt, flat with slight elevation; registration is possible online until 10.4.2025; the entry fee includes refreshments and a raffle; the race takes place on 11 April 2026.

name: Zvolenská Corrida
location: Námestie SNP, Zvolen, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia
organizer: Mesto Zvolen, Mišo s. r. o.
description: Zvolen Race is a running event held on the pedestrian zone of SNP Square in Zvolen. Participants run five laps of 1 km each on a flat course, totaling 5 km. The event also includes children's races and a family fun run with no registration fee. The event is part of the Zvolen Running League and offers professional organization and timing.
course_highlights: A 1,000 m loop on the pedestrian zone of SNP Square
Flat course suitable for all age groups
A total of 5 laps, i.e., 5 km for the main race
additional: Children's races are free of charge, with categories based on age and distances of 50 m, 250 m, and 500 m. The Mama/Oco Race is a family fun run with a length of 1 km, also free of charge. Registration for the main race is conducted electronically until capacity of 200 participants is reached; children's races and the Mama/Oco Race register on-site from 9:00 AM. The program includes a presentation, children's races starting at 10:00, the Mama/Oco Race at 10:30, the main race at 11:00, and awards at 12:00 with a raffle. The event features the main 5 km race, children's runs, and family runs, with online or on-site registration, medals for the first 170 participants, and the main race starting around 11:00 AM.

name: Furčiansky maratón – Memoriál Štefana Semana
description: The Furčiansky Marathon - Memorial of Štefan Semana is a traditional running marathon organized by the O5 Running Club Furča Košice. This 23rd edition will take place on April 11, 2026, in Košice and offers runners the opportunity to test their strength on a certified course. The marathon is known for its community atmosphere and support for running activities in the region. Organizers welcome all runners who want to experience a quality and well-prepared marathon.
course_highlights: marathon, relay categories
traditional event with history
location in Košice with excellent atmosphere
additional: Online results are available from 10:00 AM on the day of the race. Registration for the Furčiansky Marathon 2026 has closed. The organizer is O5 Running Club Furča Košice. The event includes a marathon, an extreme marathon, and relay races, with various age categories and registration fees. It also features a memorial to Štefan Semana and supports the running community.

name: Jarný beh Michalovčanov
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, Stredná odborná škola technická
price_range: 2 € dospelí, 1 € mládež do 18 rokov, 0 € muži nad 70 rokov a ženy nad 60 rokov
description: Spring Run of Michalovce Residents is a traditional running race held on Saturday, April 11, 2026, in Michalovce at V. Elementary School on Školská Street. Participants can look forward to competitions in various age categories, including children up to 9 years old, who run 400 meters. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere of a spring sports day with results announcement and medal awards.
course_highlights: Start and finish at V. Elementary School, Školská 2, Michalovce
Running courses for different age groups
Short race of 400 m for children up to 9 years old
additional: The event program includes the start of the 400 m race at 9:30 for boys' and girls' categories up to 9 years old and the results announcement with medal awards at 10:30. The children's race begins at 10:00, the main race at 10:15; registration fee covers various age categories; the venue is Michalovce, V. Elementary School, ŠKOLSKÁ 2.

name: ČSOB Bratislava marathon – desiatka, Minimaratón, deti, lezúni
description: ČSOB Bratislava Marathon is a family running event with a long-standing tradition held in Bratislava, attracting runners from Slovakia and abroad. It offers various disciplines from the marathon, half marathon, relay races, to the 10K, mini marathon, children's runs, and climbing competitions. The atmosphere is full of emotions, fair play, and camaraderie, where everyone who lines up at the start and surpasses themselves is a winner. The event also supports charitable activities and emphasizes the value of mutual help and solidarity.
course_highlights: Marathon course with a length of 42.195 km in the center of Bratislava
10K race with Mattoni and Garmin Run Series Mini Marathon as shorter disciplines
Children's runs and climbing competitions for the youngest runners
additional: The start of the 10K race with Mattoni is on Saturday, 11.04.2026 at 16:00, the Garmin Run Series Mini Marathon starts on Saturday, 11.04.2026 at 14:00, and children's runs begin on Saturday, 11.04.2026 from 10:00 according to age categories. Relay races have specific start numbers with chips for timing measurement. Participant limits are set for individual disciplines (e.g., 2000 for the 10K, 1500 for the mini marathon and children's runs). The races take place in Bratislava, with registrations open at various prices. The course includes city streets and the attractive environment of Eurovea Galleria.

name: Kysucká desiatka
organizer: Mestské kulturno-športové stredisko Kysucké Nové Mesto
description: Kysucká desiatka is a running race in Kysucké Nové Mesto offering courses for various age groups including pupils and adults. The race starts in the western part of Murgašova Street, with participants competing on a 1 km course for pupils or a 10 km course for adults and juniors. The event is organized by the Municipal Cultural and Sports Center of Kysucké Nové Mesto and features categories based on age and gender. The start for pupils is at 10:05 AM and for other categories at 10:30 AM. The race is suitable for a wide running community and promotes sports life in the region.
course_highlights: Course runs through the western part of Murgašova Street in Kysucké Nové Mesto
Available categories for pupils on 1 km and for adults on 10 km
Categories divided by age and gender including juniors and junior girls
additional: The start for pupils is at 10:05 AM, and for categories of men, women, juniors, and junior girls at 10:30 AM. The organizer is the Municipal Cultural and Sports Center of Kysucké Nové Mesto. Contact person: Renáta Kováčiková, phone: 0902 405 190. The start location for the 10 km race is in the western part of Murgašova Street. The race includes categories for children, juniors, men, and women, starting from 10:05 to 10:30; the course runs through the streets of Kysucké Nové Mesto, registration is possible online or on-site.

name: Majstrovstvá SR v maratóne mužov a žien, veteránov a veteránok (ČSOB Bratislava maratón 2026) (4.kolo BP SAZ)
description: Slovak National Championships in the marathon for men and women, veterans, and veteran women is a significant athletics event taking place in Bratislava. Competitors can look forward to a well-prepared course and professional organization under the auspices of the Slovak Athletic Federation. The event is part of a series of races and offers the opportunity to compete in various categories, including veterans. Registration is conducted online and is open to the broad running community.
course_highlights: Marathon course in Bratislava with a city character
Races for men, women, and veterans in various categories
Organized under the auspices of the Slovak Athletic Federation
additional: Registration is conducted online and must be completed by April 7, 2026, at 12:00 PM. Starting numbers are issued to team leaders during the registration at the race office. Warm-up is permitted outside the competition track. Changing rooms are available for boys and girls. Official results will be published on the Slovak Athletic Federation's website. The event is part of the ČSOB Bratislava Marathon 2026 and is intended for all age categories, including veterans.
sources: http://statistika.atletika.sk/admin/media/propozice/MAJSTROVSTVA SR v maratone - propozicie_12.4.2026, Bratislava akt..pdf

name: Trenčianská bežecká liga – 2. kolo
description: The Trenčín Running League is a series of nine running events organized since 2015 around Trenčín, intended for the general public including competitive runners and enthusiasts. Each month from March to November, one round takes place on various interesting and diverse routes. The races offer a friendly atmosphere, motivation, and an opportunity to meet people who support a healthy lifestyle. Results and scoring after each round serve as motivation for further training and performance improvement.
course_highlights: Course 8.95 km with an elevation gain of 130 m in Trenčianske Stankovce, mostly terrain with 20% asphalt
Routes pass through field roads, a dam around a pond, village roads, and hills
Start and finish at the football field in Trenčianske Stankovce
additional: Registration and check-in take place directly on site from 9:00 AM. The start fee is paid on site. Runners can contribute a voluntary donation to the United Boarding School in Trenčín. Running with a dog is allowed, but a runner with a dog receives 1 point for participation without scoring based on placement. The league round is held at the football field in Trenčianske Stankovce. The event promotes community and a healthy lifestyle, suitable for all age groups and running levels.
